title: Hong Kong unveils land sale plan for 3,845 private flats in Sha Tin and beyond
zh_title: 香港公布沙田及其他地区3,845个私人单位的卖地计划
summary: 香港政府当局宣布了一项新的土地出售计划，提供约3,845个私人住宅单位，其中包括沙田的960个单位的地块和市区重建局的1,050个住宅单位的项目。前三季度供应15,680套，超额完成全年目标12,600套。 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 2026 年 10 月 15 日 16:37 HKT · 2 分钟阅读政府公布了最新的季度土地出售计划，
content:
政府
香港当局宣布了一项新的土地出售计划，提供约 3,845 个私人住宅单位，其中包括沙田地块的 960 个单位和市区重建局项目的 1,050 个住宅单位。前三季度供应15,680套，超额完成全年目标12,600套。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

香港时间 2026 年 10 月 15 日 16:37 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

香港政府公布最新季度卖地计划，以招标方式推出沙田石门住宅用地，预计可提供约960个私人房屋单位。根据周四的公告，市区重建局还将在土瓜湾道推出重建项目，提供约1,050个单位。

私人土地发展及重建方面，有七个项目预计于第三季完成地契修改或换地，提供约1,835个单位。该计划下的所有项目总共将供应约 3,845 个单位。
发展局局长林汉海表示，加上本财政年度首两季，首三季将提供约15,680个私人房屋单位，超额完成全年供应目标12,600个单位。她强调，该目标不是一个硬性指标，因为年度住房供应数据可能会因宏观经济状况和政府协调之外的私人项目而波动，并补充说当局从广泛的角度评估总体供应趋势。

林恩表示，一些政府协调的项目，包括北部大都市的项目、铁路房地产开发和城市更新计划，都遵循与政策需求和地区发展相关的具体时间表。她表示，“政府不会仅仅因为达到了数字目标就放慢脚步。”她指出，今年市场情绪依然乐观，开发商对前景持乐观态度，成熟社区对地块的需求稳定。

当被问及第四季度是否继续出售土地时，林恩表示，政府将在发布公告之前审查市场和经济状况。关于粉岭北地区的招标，她表示，当局正在寻求城市规划委员会的重新分区批准，将住宅产量从2,000个单位增加到4,000个单位，并建议更改该地区的工业用地，目标是在年底前启动招标。
除住宅用地外，政府亦会在沙田小沥源提供一幅地块兴建大专学生宿舍，提供约600个床位。

【原文 English Original】
Government
Hong Kong authorities announced a new land sale programme offering about 3,845 private residential units, including a Sha Tin plot for 960 flats and an Urban Renewal Authority project for 1,050 homes. The first three quarters will supply 15,680 units, exceeding the annual target of 12,600.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

15 Oct 2026 at 16:37 HKT · 2 min read

The Hong Kong government has unveiled its latest quarterly land sale programme, offering a residential site in Shek Mun, Sha Tin, by tender, expected to supply about 960 private housing units. The Urban Renewal Authority will also launch a redevelopment project on To Kwa Wan Road, providing roughly 1,050 units, according to an announcement on Thursday.

For private land development and redevelopment, seven projects are set to complete land lease modifications or land exchanges in the third quarter, contributing about 1,835 units. In total, all projects under the programme will supply approximately 3,845 units.

Secretary for Development Bernadette Linn Hon-hoi said that combined with the first two quarters of the current financial year, the first three quarters will provide about 15,680 private housing units, surpassing the annual supply target of 12,600 units. She stressed that the target is not a rigid indicator, as annual housing supply figures may fluctuate due to macroeconomic conditions and private projects outside government coordination, adding that authorities assess overall supply trends from a broad perspective.

Linn said some government-coordinated projects, including those in the Northern Metropolis, railway property developments and urban renewal schemes, follow specific timelines tied to policy needs and district development. "The government will not slow down purely because the numerical target has been met," she said, noting that market sentiment remains positive this year and developers are optimistic about prospects, with steady demand for sites in mature communities.

Asked whether land sales would continue in the fourth quarter, Linn said the government would review market and economic conditions before making an announcement. On the Fanling North area tender, she said authorities are seeking rezoning approval from the Town Planning Board to increase residential output from 2,000 to 4,000 units, and are also proposing changes for industrial land in the area, with a target to launch the tender by the end of the year.

Apart from residential sites, the government will also offer a plot in Siu Lek Yuen, Sha Tin, for the construction of a tertiary student hostel providing about 600 bed spaces.

唐先生回应，询问来电者是保安局哪个单位。

# Hong Kong security chief exposes phone scam in viral video

Security Secretary Chris Tang shared a video of himself confronting a phone fraudster impersonating a government official, urging the public to stay vigilant. He stressed that the Security Bureau never demands assistance, money or account transfers over the phone.

[![Image 4: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

 By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

 15 Oct 2026 at 17:35 HKT · 1 min read

Secretary for Security Chris Tang Ping-keung has warned the public against phone scams after releasing a video of himself handling a fraudulent call from someone claiming to be a Security Bureau official.

In the video posted on Thursday, the scammer told Tang he was suspected of breaching mainland law and instructed him to report immediately to the 10th floor of the Central Government Offices to verify his identity and assist in an investigation.

Tang responded by asking which unit of the Security Bureau the caller belonged to, noting that he was already on the 10th floor and inviting the caller to come and find him instead.

Tang stressed that the Security Bureau would never call citizens to demand assistance with investigations, nor would it ask for money or account transfers. He warned that receiving such calls was a clear sign of a scam.

He added that these fraudulent calls impersonating government departments were typically designed to steal personal information or trick victims into transferring funds.

Tang reminded citizens to stay calm, verify information when receiving suspicious calls and avoid falling for such tactics.

2026/10/15 16:31（10/15 16:56 更新）

[](javascript:)[](javascript:)[](javascript:)[](javascript:)[](javascript:)[![Image 21](https://imgcdn.cna.com.tw/www/website/img/support.svg)](https://cna.com.tw/donate/)

中國國民黨新北市長參選人李四川（前右4）15日出席坪林區競選總部成立大會，近400名鄉親、里長到場力挺，場面熱烈。（李四川競辦提供）中央社記者曹亞沿傳真 115年10月15日

（中央社記者[曹亞沿](https://cna.com.tw/author/0192/)、黃旭昇新北15日電）中國國民黨新北市長參選人李四川今天說，將落實「青春山海線2.0」政策，以周遊券整合大眾運輸、景點、住宿、美食及消費優惠，串聯各地特色景點，創造坪林區商機。

李四川上午出席坪林競選總部成立大會表示，這樣可讓遊客一券暢遊新北，促進在地就業，讓更多年輕人留家鄉工作，而坪林孕育的茶葉是新北重要特色農產，如果當選，將整合交通、觀光及行銷資源積極推廣，讓新北好茶走向國際。

[![Image 23](https://imgcdn.cna.com.tw/www/website/img/ad300x223.jpg)](https://lin.ee/tPtHlLQ)

至於台北市長選戰近日為科技廊帶政見交鋒，李四川接受媒體聯訪表示，民進黨台北市長參選人沈伯洋不熟市政，如果民進黨新北市長參選人蘇巧慧也有相同認知，可能會讓國外大廠不敢投資雙北。

他說，交通與土地是人工智慧（AI）產業投資主要條件，有聚落才能聚集人才、建立平台，也才能讓國外大廠願投資。（編輯：李明宗）1151015

中国国有企业中石油（0857）的贸易部门是获得新加坡政府颁发的液化天然气加注许可证的八家公司之一，并且还拥有向船舶供应甲醇的许可证。吴邦国在新加坡国际邦克林大会上发表上述讲话

# PetroChina to launch first LNG bunker fuelling in Singapore

PetroChina International will bunker a vessel with liquefied natural gas in Singapore for the first time on Thursday, its chairman said, expanding alternative-fuel options at the world's top refuelling port. The company also completes a methanol bunker vessel acquisition on Friday amid rapid growth

PetroChina International will use liquefied natural gas (LNG) to bunker a vessel in Singapore for the first time on Thursday, Chairman Wu Junli said, widening the alternative-fuel options it can offer shipowners at the world's top refuelling port.

The trading arm of Chinese state major PetroChina (0857) was one of eight firms that received LNG bunkering licences from the Singapore government, and it also has a licence to supply methanol to ships. Wu made the remarks at the Singapore International Bunkering conference.

PetroChina will also complete the acquisition of a methanol bunker vessel on Friday, Wu said. Citing data from Clarksons, he said by the end of 2025, orders globally for alternative-fuel vessels had neared 2,000 ships, including more than 1,200 LNG-fuelled vessels.

However, infrastructure for emerging marine fuels significantly lags fleet development, he noted, with the number of existing and planned methanol bunkering ports remaining below 50 versus 220 LNG bunker ports worldwide.

PetroChina accounted for about 10 per cent of Singapore bunker sales last year, which exceeded 56 million metric tons. The company sold 7.95 million tons of bunker fuel globally last year and can supply 18 ports with 16 bunker vessels on time charter, he added.

Last year, PetroChina completed its first commercial LNG bunkering operation in Europe and secured methanol bunkering qualification in Rotterdam in the Netherlands. China has the capacity to produce 380,000 tons per year of green methanol, Wu said.

韩联社釜山10月15日电 中国留学生涉嫌在韩擅拍军事设施案二审15日宣判，两名被告人均被判有罪，法院维持原审判决。

釜山高等法院刑事审判第一庭当天就上述案件进行宣判，判处被告人A某有期徒刑1年半，判处被告人B某有期徒刑1年、缓刑2年。

A某和B某涉嫌于2023年3月至2024年6月使用中国制造的无人机和手机，未经许可共9次拍摄釜山海军作战司令部，以及为参加作战访韩的美国海军航母“西奥多·罗斯福”号。2024年6月25日，时任总统尹锡悦访问“西奥多·罗斯福”号时，两人使用无人机企图拍摄活动现场。

两名被告人均被指控违反《军事基地及军事设施保护法》，A某还被指控涉嫌一般利敌罪。原审法院认定检方对A某的两大指控均成立，但由于军舰和航母本身不属于军事设施，认定A某拍摄军舰和航母的行为无罪。二审法院指出，综合原审法院判处有罪的依据以及大法院有关一般利敌罪的判例，原审法院判处被告人有罪符合法理。（完）

# Hong Kong Space Museum launches new 3D dome film 'Explore the Stars 3D'

The Hong Kong Space Museum has launched a new 3D dome film, 'Explore the Stars 3D', tracing astronomy's past and future. The 28-minute show runs until 14 July 2027, with tickets priced at HK$30 and HK$40.

[![Image 4: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

 By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

 15 Oct 2026 at 12:52 HKT · 1 min read

Share:

[](https://wa.me/?text=Hong%20Kong%20Space%20Museum%20launches%20new%203D%20dome%20film%20%27Explore%20the%20Stars%203D%27%20https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Hong-Kong-Space-Museum-launches-new-3D-dome-film-Explore-the-196572 "WhatsApp")[](https://t.me/share/url?url=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Hong-Kong-Space-Museum-launches-new-3D-dome-film-Explore-the-196572&text=Hong%20Kong%20Space%20Museum%20launches%20new%203D%20dome%20film%20%27Explore%20the%20Stars%203D%27 "Telegram")[](https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Hong-Kong-Space-Museum-launches-new-3D-dome-film-Explore-the-196572 "Facebook")[](https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?url=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Hong-Kong-Space-Museum-launches-new-3D-dome-film-Explore-the-196572&text=Hong%20Kong%20Space%20Museum%20launches%20new%203D%20dome%20film%20%27Explore%20the%20Stars%203D%27 "X")[](mailto:?subject=Hong%20Kong%20Space%20Museum%20launches%20new%203D%20dome%20film%20%27Explore%20the%20Stars%203D%27&body=Hong%20Kong%20Space%20Museum%20launches%20new%203D%20dome%20film%20%27Explore%20the%20Stars%203D%27%0Ahttps%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Hong-Kong-Space-Museum-launches-new-3D-dome-film-Explore-the-196572 "Email")

The Hong Kong Space Museum has launched a new stereoscopic dome film, Explore the Stars 3D, which takes audiences on a journey through the past and future of astronomy with vivid, detailed imagery, the government announced on Thursday.

The film showcases how pioneering scientists reshaped humanity's understanding of the universe, gradually unravelling the mysteries of celestial motion. It covers the tracking of the relative positions of the Sun and the Moon along the ecliptic to predict solar and lunar eclipses, the shift from a geocentric to a heliocentric model, and the development of physical laws that help calculate spacecraft orbits.

These discoveries laid the foundation for modern space exploration and paved the way for humanity's ambition to land on Mars, according to the museum.

The programme runs for 28 minutes and will be screened until 14 July 2027. Weekday screenings are scheduled for 2pm and 6.30pm, while weekend and public holiday screenings take place at 12.30pm and 5pm.

Tickets are priced at HK$30 for front seats and HK$40 for rear seats. They are available at the Hong Kong Space Museum box office and through Urbtix (www.urbtix.hk). Details of the show can be found on the museum's website.

The Hong Kong Space Museum is located at 10 Salisbury Road, Tsim Sha Tsui, Kowloon. It is closed on Tuesdays except public holidays.

# Hong Kong releases kindergarten profiles for 2026/27 school year

The Education Bureau has published the online version of the 2026/27 Kindergarten Profile, listing basic information for about 930 kindergartens in Hong Kong to help parents choose schools.

[![Image 4: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

 By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

 15 Oct 2026 at 12:03 HKT · 1 min read

Share:

[](https://wa.me/?text=Hong%20Kong%20releases%20kindergarten%20profiles%20for%202026/27%20school%20year%20https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Hong-Kong-releases-kindergarten-profiles-for-2026-27-school-63c7bf "WhatsApp")[](https://t.me/share/url?url=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Hong-Kong-releases-kindergarten-profiles-for-2026-27-school-63c7bf&text=Hong%20Kong%20releases%20kindergarten%20profiles%20for%202026/27%20school%20year "Telegram")[](https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Hong-Kong-releases-kindergarten-profiles-for-2026-27-school-63c7bf "Facebook")[](https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?url=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Hong-Kong-releases-kindergarten-profiles-for-2026-27-school-63c7bf&text=Hong%20Kong%20releases%20kindergarten%20profiles%20for%202026/27%20school%20year "X")[](mailto:?subject=Hong%20Kong%20releases%20kindergarten%20profiles%20for%202026/27%20school%20year&body=Hong%20Kong%20releases%20kindergarten%20profiles%20for%202026/27%20school%20year%0Ahttps%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Hong-Kong-releases-kindergarten-profiles-for-2026-27-school-63c7bf "Email")

The Education Bureau on 15 October released the online version of the 2026/27 school year “Profile of Kindergartens and Kindergarten-cum-Child Care Centres” (www.chsc.hk/kindergarten), providing basic information on all kindergartens and kindergarten-cum-child care centres in Hong Kong. The bureau said the profile aims to enhance school transparency and help parents obtain more relevant information when choosing schools for their children.

The profile lists basic information on about 930 kindergartens across Hong Kong, including the list of schools participating in the 2026/27 kindergarten education scheme, approved school fees, the number of principals and teachers and their qualifications, student numbers, teacher-to-student ratios, curriculum information, reference prices for major educational supplies, application fees, registration fees and admission application details.

The profile also includes sections on “support for non-Chinese speaking students” and “support for students with special educational needs” for parents’ reference, the bureau said.

For kindergartens participating in the scheme, the profile shows the approved school fees after deducting government subsidies. Parents can also refer to the school’s fee certificate to check approved charges, including details of tuition and meal fees, the bureau said. All participating kindergartens are required to publicly disclose the proportion of expenditure in major spending areas in the profile.

All kindergartens in the scheme must undergo quality reviews to ensure standards. The profile indicates whether kindergartens that have completed quality reviews have met specified standards and provides links to the most recent quality review reports, according to the bureau.

# Hong Kong funding scheme backs nearly 150 smart production lines

Hong Kong's新型工業化資助計劃 has funded nearly 150 smart production lines, the innovation chief said. The government is boosting youth researcher support and building a national manufacturing innovation centre with pilot lines for third-generation semiconductors.

[![Image 4: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

 By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

 15 Oct 2026 at 11:11 HKT · 1 min read

The Secretary for Innovation, Technology and Industry, Professor Sun Dong, said the city's New Industrialisation Funding Scheme has subsidised nearly 150 smart production lines, as the government pushes to accelerate Hong Kong's advanced manufacturing development.

Speaking at an event on Thursday, Sun said innovation commercialisation requires understanding industry needs, managing intellectual property and expanding business outreach. He noted that the government's InnoHK initiative has brought together about 3,000 international researchers from around the world, who collaborate with local institutions to set up research centres and laboratories in Hong Kong.

The government will add a new category for young researchers under the Innovation and Technology Support Programme to strengthen support for early-career scientists, Sun added.

He also said the authorities are helping companies establish advanced manufacturing facilities in Hong Kong. The Microelectronics Research and Development Institute (MRDI) is preparing to set up the city's first national manufacturing innovation centre, with two pilot lines expected to begin operation this year, focusing on third-generation semiconductor research and trial production.

Sun expressed confidence that Hong Kong's advanced public service infrastructure, abundant testing platforms and international connections, combined with the Greater Bay Area's strong manufacturing capabilities and supply chains, would create significant opportunities for businesses.

# 台灣採購阿拉斯加天然氣 美學者：強化能源韌性縮減貿易順差

2026/10/15 09:26

[](javascript:)[](javascript:)[](javascript:)[](javascript:)[](javascript:)[![Image 17](https://imgcdn.cna.com.tw/www/website/img/support.svg)](https://cna.com.tw/donate/)

請同意我們的隱私權規範，才能啟用聽新聞的功能。

（中央社記者[侯姿瑩](https://cna.com.tw/author/0193/)華盛頓14日專電）美國總統川普稱台灣已同意在未來20年內採購阿拉斯加液化天然氣管線計畫30%天然氣。美學者今天向中央社記者分析，這有助強化台灣能源韌性、縮減對美貿易順差；台灣在美國出口市場的地位越重要，華府就越有意確保台灣安全。

川普（Donald Trump）昨天在阿拉斯加一場造勢集會上表示，台灣同意在未來20年內採購阿拉斯加液化天然氣管線計畫30%天然氣，還將額外投資44億美元用於該項計畫。他今天又在自家社群媒體「真實社群」（Truth Social）發文重申此事。

台灣經濟部指出，中油去年3月簽署「阿拉斯加液化天然氣買賣暨投資意向書」後，已與美方開發商協商取得重大進展，依目前規劃，開採後每年採購600萬噸液化天然氣，以及參與專案開發，預估投資金額最高44億美元。

針對這項天然氣採購及投資計畫，華府智庫「史汀生中心」（The Stimson Center）資深研究員孔明尚（Michael Cunningham）以電子郵件回覆記者詢問表示，這對台灣、美國及台美關係而言，都是有利的發展。若協議落實，將有助強化台灣能源韌性，同時也有助縮減台灣對美貿易順差，「這是華府非常在意的事項」。

根據台灣財政部統計，2025年台灣對美貿易順差約為1501億美元。

孔明尚指出，最重要的是，這類採購協議能提升台灣作為美國客戶的重要性。「台灣在美國出口市場的地位越重要，美國就越有意確保台灣維持安全」。

他認為，有鑑於阿拉斯加天然氣計畫預計2031年才會開始出口，川普所提及的20年採購時程意味著，至少就這項天然氣計畫而言，「台灣直到2050年代都將維持關鍵地位」。

另一方面，華府智庫哈德遜研究所資深研究員華特斯（Riley Walters）受訪表示，這項宣布意義重大，特別是在韓國對阿拉斯加液化天然氣計畫是否能獲利表達疑慮後。

華特斯分析，台灣承諾採購約1/3的產量，將有助確保這條天然氣管線的獲利能力。就美台關係而言，這項宣布也有助台灣朝向達成擴大對美投資承諾的目標邁進。

[![Image 18](https://imgcdn.cna.com.tw/www/website/img/ad300x223.jpg)](https://lin.ee/tPtHlLQ)

川普表示，韓國將投資500億美元推動阿拉斯加液化天然氣計畫。不過，外媒報導，韓國方面則說，唯有在這項計畫具備商業可行性的情況下才會推進。

經濟部表示，透過長期能源採購及專案投資，有助於增加天然氣供應來源，進一步強化台灣能源韌性。阿拉斯加液化天然氣計畫可透過太平洋航線直達台灣，有助分散天然氣運輸路線及地緣政治風險；若計畫順利推進，最快2032年可挹注國內天然氣供應。（編輯：田瑞華）1151015

summary: Wrongly Accused Abroad Help Me Afford Legal Defense and Survival. Hi to everyone, my name is Julian! I'm an Italian and American national, I used to work as a substitute teacher in an Italian high school. On 26th of August I went to China t
content:
Wrongly Accused Abroad Help Me Afford Legal Defense and Survival.

Hi to everyone, my name is Julian! I'm an Italian and American national, I used to work as a substitute teacher in an Italian high school.

On 26th of August I went to China to start traveling. Some weeks later, on September 28th, I arrived in Thailand. Since then, I had been traveling mostly in northern Thailand.

It was an incredible experience — honestly, probably the best of my life.

But then… something completely unexpected happened to me.

On Wednesday, November 26th, very early in the morning around 5:30 a.m., I booked a Grab taxi from where I was staying, in Nothanburi (a province northwest of Bangkok), to go to Suvarnabhumi Airport. I had a flight with Etihad Airways at 8:55 a.m. to Italy, where I live.

I arrived at the airport two hours before departure, as recommended by the airline. The check-in process went smoothly, and everything seemed normal until I reached immigration.

There were two sections: one with officers and one automatic lane. The automatic lane was moving faster, so I chose that. When it was my turn, I tapped my passport on the scanner, but a red message appeared. I tried again—same result.

A security guard came to help me and tried scanning my passport himself, but it still didn’t work. He then told me to go to the manual lane.

The immigration officer took my passport, typed something on her computer, smiled, and said, “Sorry, just wait here for a moment.” She left and returned a few minutes later with another officer who looked serious. They escorted me to the immigration desk and told me to wait.

At that moment I started to feel anxious. I thought maybe I had overstayed my visa. My visa was expiring that same day, November 26th, so I was worried I might be in trouble.

After about 15 minutes, I approached the desk to ask what was happening, but they just told me to sit down and wait. Ten minutes later, another officer came with a paper showing a photocopy of my passport and asked me to confirm that it was mine. I said yes.

Most of the staff did not speak English, which made everything more frightening.

Then, using a translation app on his phone, the officer showed me a message saying that I was being charged with possession of indecent content and distribution of that material on websites accessible to the public.

I was completely shocked and confused. I thought there must be a mistake.

There was no opportunity to explain anything. Two immigration officers escorted me to another office inside the airport.

Inside, I was told to sign many documents, all in Thai. No one explained them to me in English. They took photos of me with officers behind me. Later, they took more photos from the front, left, and right. That’s when I realized: they were taking a mugshot.

Everything felt surreal. I was exhausted because I hadn’t slept much the night before. It felt like a nightmare.

“Did you tell your family that you have been arrested?”

That was the moment it truly hit me. I had never imagined being arrested in my life, especially not in a foreign country. I was terrified and confused.

I called my embassy, but it was still closed. Later, they contacted me and explained the situation. The embassy told me that creating and distributing certain types of videos can be a crime in Thailand, as in many countries, and that if I believed I was innocent, the Thai legal process would take its course.

They asked me for two emergency contacts and sent me a list of lawyers, advising me to find legal representation.

Eventually, we arrived at a police station in Samut Prakan province, in a town called Khlong Dan.

At that point, I was officially placed under arrest and faced the risk of jail if I was unable to pay bail.

My Italian passport was confiscated by the police and is currently being held by them. This happened on November 26th.

I am writing this today, February 24, 2026. I am creating a YouTube channel to explain in more detail what is happening to me. I am currently safe and living in a hostel in Bangkok. The last three months have been the most stressful of my life.

In December, I struggled to obtain a visa extension, which I was finally able to secure on January 8, 2026. This visa must be renewed every 45 days.

I am asking for your help to raise funds for legal fees, living expenses, and possible bail that may be requested by the judge if the case goes to court. I cannot legally work in Thailand because that requires a work visa. My family is helping me at the moment, but they cannot sustain these expenses for much longer. I do not know when I will be able to return to my country, as I must wait for the Thai legal process to run its course.

**I want to state clearly that I have never uploaded any indecent content on the internet. The accuser, a woman, has claimed to provide “evidence” of this. At the police station, I was shown the alleged evidence, which consisted of screenshots from an OnlyFans profile belonging to a couple: a Thai woman and a Caucasian man. The man’s face was blurred, and I was accused of being that person.**

The case will soon be handed over to the prosecutor, and according to police officers at Khlong Dan Police Station, it will most likely proceed to court (that's what they said). This is extremely distressing, especially because my lawyer has told me that cases with weak evidence are usually dropped by the police or the prosecutor.

Thank you for taking the time to read my story. Any help or support during this very difficult time would mean a great deal to me.

Julian

# 1,336 people officially recognized as Siraya since July: CIP

10/14/2026 04:04 PM

[](jsvscript:)[](jsvscript:)[](javascript:void(0))[Listen](javascript:)

Siraya community members dancing at a ceremony, which marked the tribe's official recognition at the Executive Yuan in Taipei in July. CNA photo July 30, 2026

Taipei, Oct. 14 (CNA) A total of 1,336 people had completed registration as Indigenous Siraya people by the end of September, following the government's official recognition of the Siraya as Taiwan's 17th Indigenous group in July, the Council of Indigenous Peoples (CIP) said Wednesday.

Since the Plains Indigenous Peoples Status Act took effect in October 2025, the CIP has received applications for recognition from nine groups: the Siraya, Taivoan, Makatao, Taokas, Kaxabu, Pazeh, Papora, Babuza and Ketagalan.

The law, which was passed by the Legislature on Oct. 17, 2025, aims to give Plains Indigenous groups' the right to receive official recognition and maintain their collective identity.

According to the CIP's report to the Legislature on Wednesday, applications to be listed on the Siraya membership register and to register Indigenous status opened on Aug. 13.

By the end of September, 12,178 people had applied to be listed on the membership register, of whom 1,336 had completed registration and obtained officially recognized Plains Indigenous status as Siraya people, the CIP said.

Applications from the Pazeh, Kaxabu and Taokas are expected to proceed to review by a panel of experts and scholars, while a draft set of eligibility requirements for membership in the Taivoan group is expected to be released, the council said.

Premier Cho Jung-tai (back, center) and other officials poses for a group photo at the Executive Yuan in Taipei in July. CNA photo July 30, 2026

To qualify for Plains Indigenous status, applicants must provide supporting documentation. One important source is population census records from the Japanese colonial period, which identified their communities and defined the areas where they lived.

The Plains Indigenous people's movement for official recognition began in the 1990s. Before then, they were considered to have largely assimilated into the majority population under the Kuomintang government after it took power in 1945.

Before the Siraya's recognition, Taiwan officially recognized 16 Indigenous groups, generally classified as Mountain Indigenous.

(By Chang Hsiung-feng and Lee Hsin-Yin)

title: Workers rally in Taipei for pension reform, profit-sharing rules - Focus Taiwan
zh_title: 台北工人集会要求养老金改革和利润分享规则 - 聚焦台湾
summary: 中新社台北10月19日电 在台湾最近一波罢工和罢工授权投票浪潮中，数百名工人周一在总统府外集会，要求提高工资、增加雇主养老金缴款和更明确的利润分享规则。代表台湾各地数十个工会的参与者聚集在凯达格兰大道上，然后穿过附近的街道经过立法院，在午后的阳光下返回大道。 ##年金改革 台湾团结会主席何政家在集会前向记者发表讲话
content:
中新社台北10月19日电 在台湾最近一波罢工和罢工授权投票浪潮中，数百名工人周一在总统府外集会，要求提高工资、增加雇主养老金缴款和更明确的利润分享规则。

代表台湾各地数十个工会的参与者聚集在凯达格兰大道上，然后穿过附近的街道经过立法院，在午后的阳光下返回大道。

## 养老金改革

台联主席何政家在集会前对记者发表讲话时特别谈到了他认为过时的劳工养老金制度。

2005年7月推出的新劳动养老金制度由个人职工退休金账户组成，要求雇主每月向该账户缴存不少于雇员工资的6%。

员工可以自愿额外缴纳 6% 以增加储蓄金额。只要缴费至少15年，基金的累积总额就可以在退休时一次性领取或作为每月年金领取。

Ho 认为，现在是提高雇主 6% 最低义务的时候了，他说这个义务太低，无法确保足够的退休储蓄，而增加义务将有助于弥补 21 年来缴款不足的情况。
他说：“我们希望先提高到9%，然后逐步提高到15%。”他指出，在旧养老金制度下，雇主每名工人的年度退休费用估计约为工资的12%。

政府数据显示，截至 2026 年 7 月，约有 787 万名工人在新制度下缴款，而截至 2025 年 12 月，估计有 115,000 人完全在旧制度下缴款。

新的劳工养老金制度是台湾大多数工人有资格享受的两项退休计划之一。

另一个是劳动保险制度下的“养老待遇”。目前劳保费为工资的11.5%，每月上限为新台币45,800元，雇主缴纳70%。

由于工资上限相对较低，保险制度下的退休金一般限制在每月900美元以下。

这两个系统均由劳动部劳动保险局负责管理。

何先生还敦促修改《劳动标准法》第29条，为向员工分配公司利润制定更明确的要求，并表示经济收益应该惠及科技行业以外的工人。

## 劳工骚乱中的罢工投票

此前，玻璃制造商旭硝子和零食生产商快快公司的罢工最近结束，中华电信和美国存储芯片制造商美光科技公司桃园工厂的工会也进行了罢工授权投票。
中华电信工会主席邓克廉表示，桃园及高雄分公司已通过罢工授权投票，其他分公司将陆续举行投票。

该工会在滕称公司利润创纪录的情况下发起了要求加薪的投票，该工会在 26 个分支机构拥有约 20,000 名会员，几乎代表了公司所有员工。

滕说：“罢工只是一种手段，不是我们的目标。”他敦促管理层“积极回应”工人的要求，同时指出年底前不太可能发生罢工。

Paul Chen，中华电话

【原文 English Original】
Taipei, Oct. 19 (CNA) Hundreds of workers rallied outside the Presidential Office on Monday, demanding higher wages, increased employer pension contributions and clearer profit-sharing rules, amid a recent wave of strikes and strike authorization votes across Taiwan.

Participants representing dozens of labor unions from across Taiwan gathered on Ketagalan Boulevard before marching through nearby streets past the Legislative Yuan and returning to the boulevard under the afternoon sun.

## Pension reform

Speaking to reporters before the rally, Ho Cheng-chia (何政家), chairman of the Taiwan Solidarity Front Confederation of Trade Unions, focused specifically on what he felt was an outdated labor pension system.

Introduced in July 2005, the new labor pension system consists of retirement accounts for individual workers and requires employers to contribute at least 6 percent of an employee's salary to the account every month.

The employee can voluntarily contribute an additional 6 percent to increase the amount saved. The total built up in the fund can be collected in a lump sum or as a monthly annuity upon retirement as long as contributions have been made for at least 15 years.

Ho argued that it was time to increase the employer's minimum 6 percent obligation, saying it was too low to ensure adequate retirement savings and that an increase would help make up for 21 years of insufficient contributions.

"We hope to raise it to 9 percent first and then gradually to 15 percent," he said, noting that employers' annual retirement costs per worker under the old pension system were estimated at around 12 percent of wages.

Government figures show that about 7.87 million workers had contributions made under the new system as of July 2026, while an estimated 115,000 were exclusively under the old system as of December 2025.

The new labor pension system is one of two retirement plans that most workers in Taiwan qualify for.

The other is the "old-age benefits" under the labor insurance system. The current labor insurance premium is 11.5 percent of salaries, capped at NT$45,800 per month, with employers paying 70 percent.

Because of the relatively low salary cap, retirement benefits under the insurance system are generally limited to under US$900 a month.

Both systems are run by the Bureau of Labor Insurance under the Ministry of Labor.

Ho also urged amendments to Article 29 of the Labor Standards Act to establish clearer requirements for distributing company profits to employees, saying that economic gains should benefit workers beyond the technology sector.

## Strike votes amid labor unrest

The rally followed recently concluded strikes at glassmaker AGC Display Glass Taiwan Inc. and snack producer Kuai Kuai Co., as well as strike authorization votes by unions at Chunghwa Telecom and the Taoyuan operations of U.S. memory chipmaker Micron Technology Inc.

Chunghwa Telecom Workers' Union Chairman Teng Ke-lien (鄧克亷) said its Taoyuan and Kaohsiung branches had passed strike authorization votes, with other branches set to hold votes in succession.

The union, which launched the vote to demand higher pay amid what Teng described as record company profits, has approximately 20,000 members across 26 branches, representing nearly all company employees.

"Striking is just a means, not our goal," Teng said, urging management to "respond positively" to workers' demands, while noting that a walkout was unlikely before year-end.

Paul Chen, a Chunghwa Telecom engineer with more than five years' service, said he took leave to join the protest despite concerns about possible retaliation.

"I'm still a little worried, but I think we need to fight for our demands and let the company hear our real voices," Chen, who spoke under a pseudonym, told CNA.

Under Article 35 of Taiwan's Labor Union Act, employers are barred from retaliating against workers for participating in union activities or labor disputes.

## General strike call

Speaking at the rally, Taoyuan Confederation of Trade Unions Chairwoman Shih Shu-hua (施淑華) called for a nationwide general strike ahead of the 2028 elections if pension reform remained stalled.

"We must show these political parties that workers cannot be pushed around," she said.

Responding to the protest, the Ministry of Labor said it remained "open" to raising employer pension contributions but stressed that changes required "careful evaluation."

It also highlighted environmental, social and governance (ESG) assessment incentives for listed companies that voluntarily increase their contribution rates.

The ministry also pointed to minimum wage reviews and collective bargaining incentives to promote pay raises and profit-sharing, urging employers to consider raising existing employees' salaries as the monthly minimum wage increases from NT$29,500 (US$908.05) this year to NT$30,900 in 2027.

(By Sunny Lai)

# 港股因科技股上涨而上涨；联想股价反弹8%

# Hong Kong stocks rise on tech gains; Lenovo rebounds 8 per cent

Hong Kong shares closed higher on Friday, driven by tech stocks, with the Hang Seng Index up 0.52 per cent. Lenovo rebounded 8 per cent after a sharp fall, while Kuaishou rose on its new AI video model. Mainland indices also gained.

[![Image 4: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

 By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

 16 Oct 2026 at 16:35 HKT · 1 min read

Hong Kong shares ended higher on Friday, lifted by technology stocks, with the benchmark Hang Seng Index rising 124 points, or 0.52 per cent, to 24,186 points. Full-day market turnover reached HK$178.2 billion, according to exchange data.

The Hang Seng Tech Index advanced 1.16 per cent to 4,108 points. Lenovo rebounded 8 per cent at the close after slumping 14 per cent a day earlier, making it the best performer among blue-chip stocks.

Property developers also gained, with Longfor (0960) climbing 6.2 per cent and China Resources Land (1109) rising 3.3 per cent. Among tech heavyweights, Alibaba (9988) added 2.3 per cent, while Tencent (0700) closed flat.

Kuaishou (1024) once jumped over 6 per cent before closing 2.5 per cent higher, as the company released its latest video generation model, Kling 4.0.

On the mainland, the Shanghai Stock Exchange Composite Index rose 0.95 per cent to 3,742 points, and the Shenzhen Stock Exchange Component Index increased 1.19 per cent to 11,957 points.

title: Madlanga Commission witness nabbed at OR Tambo airport
summary: A suspect was arrested at OR Tambo International Airport as he was about to leave the country, and his travel plans now include heading to a court to face charges for failing to appear at the Madlanga Commission of Inquiry. The police have
content:
A suspect was arrested at OR Tambo International Airport as he was about to leave the country, and his travel plans now include heading to a court to face charges for failing to appear at the Madlanga Commission of Inquiry.

The police have not yet named the suspect, and this detail will be added to this developing story once he has been in court.

He was expected to appear in the Pretoria Magistrate’s Court on Friday, 16 October 2026.

### ‘International flight’

According to a South African Police Service (SAPS) statement, the suspect, 49, was taken into custody late on Thursday, “moments before he was due to board an international flight”.

The SAPS statement read: “The suspect was arrested for failing to appear before the Madlanga Commission of Inquiry.”

He was detained by the Commissions Recommendations Task Team, which is following up on and probing matters arising from the Madlanga Commission, which is investigating accusations that a cartel has infiltrated the state.

While the police have not named the suspect, there have been several issues with witnesses not appearing before the commission.

### Carrim’s Cape Town visit

About two months ago, in August, it emerged that the Madlanga Commission would lodge criminal complaints against North West ANC member and businessman Suliman Carrim after he repeatedly failed to appear before it.

Carrim’s legal team had put forward medical reasons why he could not testify. But Carrim refused an independent medical assessment, which sparked questions around his condition.

Before that, it emerged that Carrim had been at a shop and an eatery in Cape Town – even though a doctor had deemed him medically unfit to testify before the commission.

Carrim had also wanted an application to postpone his testimony at the commission heard in camera – in other words, to be heard in private.

Businessman Suliman Carrim testifies at the Madlanga Commission of Inquiry on 10 March 2026. (Photo: Gallo Images / Frennie Shivambu)

Earlier this year, when Carrim initially failed to obtain a ruling that his testimony be heard in camera, he was questioned about his ties to various individuals.

He admitted to having dealings with organised crime accused Vusimuzi “Cat” Matlala, who faces accusations that he colluded with corrupt police officers and is a member of a drug cartel known as the Big Five. (This is the cartel that is alleged to have infiltrated the state.)

### Khan and the criminal charges

Another Madlanga Commission witness who has failed to appear before it is former Crime Intelligence officer Feroz Khan.

He was initially meant to have testified before the commission at the start of July, but just days before he was wounded in a shooting in Houghton, Johannesburg.

Khan’s lawyer had also said that his medical condition had prevented him from appearing on a few occasions.

Former Crime Intelligence officer Feroz Khan appears in the Kempton Park Magistrate’s Court on 11 May 2026. (Photo: Gallo Images / OJ Koloti)

Last month, after Khan again did not appear despite a subpoena, the commission announced it would lodge criminal complaints against him.

He was again expected to testify privately earlier this month, but on the eve of that, [his uncle, Preggy Padayachee, was murdered](https://www.dailymaverick.co.za/article/2026-10-06-feroz-khans-commission-testimony-postponed-after-uncle-murdered/) in a shooting in Gauteng.

Padayachee’s murder meant Khan’s testimony did not go ahead as planned. **DM**

_This is a developing story. Daily Maverick has a team at the court and will update this story as details become available._

香港政府周五刊宪《2026年税务（修订）（知识产权开支税务扣除）条例草案》，落实2025-26及2026-27年度财政预算案公布的措施，进一步完善香港知识产权税制，降低知识产权交易成本。

商务及经济发展局发言人表示，该法案旨在“优化本地知识产权的扣税安排”和“降低知识产权交易成本”，从而促进更多知识产权交易活动，支持香港知识密集型产业的发展。
该法案建议放宽知识产权的税务扣除规则，允许企业就三类资本支出申请扣除：从集团附属公司等联营公司购买合资格的知识产权，以鼓励跨国公司在香港集中管理知识产权；购买合格的知识产权供香港以外的被许可人使用，前提是特许权使用费收入被视为产生于香港并须缴纳利得税；以及根据使用合格知识产权的许可安排支付的预付特许权使用费。

该修正案将适用于 2026 年 4 月 1 日或之后签订的购买合格知识产权或使用权的合同。

为保护香港的税基并防止滥用扣除安排，该法案包括一系列保障措施。其中包括从关联人购买知识产权的主要目的测试、从在香港经营业务的关联人购买知识产权时的可扣除金额的计算方法，以及当从香港境外关联人购买的合资格知识产权或从关联人获得的许可的资本支出超过指定阈值时，要求提供独立的第三方评估报告以支持扣除申请。
发言人补充，政府一直积极推动香港知识产权贸易及融资的发展。继“专利盒”优惠税率实施后，该法案将进一步完善香港的知识产权税收生态系统，吸引更多本地和海外企业利用香港作为跨境技术转移和知识产权融资的平台，符合香港在“十五五”规划中成为国际创新科技中心和区域知识产权交易中心的目标。

该法案将于10月28日提交立法会一读和二读。

Government
Hong Kong has gazetted a bill to broaden tax deductions for intellectual property expenses, covering purchases from affiliated firms, overseas licensing and prepaid royalties. The government says the move will cut IP trading costs and support the city's goal of becoming a regional IP trade hub.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

16 Oct 2026 at 11:30 HKT · 2 min read

The Hong Kong government gazetted the Tax (Amendment) (Tax Deduction for Expenditure on Intellectual Property) Bill 2026 on Friday, implementing measures announced in the 2025-26 and 2026-27 budgets to further improve the city's tax regime for intellectual property (IP) and reduce the cost of IP transactions.

A spokesman for the Commerce and Economic Development Bureau said the bill aims to "optimise the tax deduction arrangements for local intellectual property" and "reduce the cost of intellectual property transactions", thereby promoting more IP trading activities and supporting the development of knowledge-intensive industries in Hong Kong.

The bill proposes to relax tax deduction rules for IP, allowing enterprises to claim deductions for capital expenditure incurred on three categories: purchasing qualifying IP from associated companies, such as group affiliates, to encourage multinational corporations to centralise IP management in Hong Kong; buying qualifying IP for use by licensees outside Hong Kong, provided the royalty income is deemed to arise in Hong Kong and is subject to profits tax; and prepaid royalties paid under licensing arrangements for the use of qualifying IP.

The amendments will apply to contracts entered into on or after April 1, 2026, for the purchase of qualifying IP or the right to use it.

To protect Hong Kong's tax base and prevent abuse of the deduction arrangements, the bill includes a series of safeguard measures. These include a principal purpose test for purchases of IP from associated persons, a calculation method for the deductible amount when buying IP from associated persons carrying on business in Hong Kong, and a requirement for independent third-party valuation reports to support deduction claims when capital expenditure on qualifying IP bought from associated persons outside Hong Kong, or on licences obtained from associated persons, exceeds specified thresholds.

The spokesman added that the government has been actively promoting the development of IP trading and financing in Hong Kong. Following the implementation of the "patent box" preferential tax rate, the bill will further improve Hong Kong's IP tax ecosystem, attracting more local and overseas enterprises to use Hong Kong as a platform for cross-border technology transfer and IP financing, in line with the city's goal under the 15th Five-Year Plan to become an international innovation and technology centre and a regional IP trading hub.

The bill will be introduced into the Legislative Council for first and second reading on October 28.

title: Zoning in – African countries pair factories, logistics and ports to boost investment
summary: African special economic zones (SEZs) are becoming larger industrial bets as governments and investors bring ports, factories, processing and logistics into the same development. New projects in Kenya and Nigeria are putting major industria
content:
African special economic zones (SEZs) are becoming larger industrial bets as governments and investors bring ports, factories, processing and logistics into the same development.

New projects in Kenya and Nigeria are putting major industrial facilities alongside maritime infrastructure, while operating zones in Togo and South Africa are showing how the model can support processing, exports and manufacturing.

In Kenya, construction has begun on the planned Dangote East Africa Petroleum Refinery in Lamu, part of a proposed $16-billion complex combining refining, petrochemicals and power generation.

The project is being developed in the Lamu Port-South Sudan-Ethiopia-Transport Corridor, linking the planned industrial complex to a wider transport and logistics network serving regional markets.

In Nigeria, DP World, Ogun State and the Ogun Deep Sea Port Company have signed agreements to explore a 10,000ha development combining a proposed deep-sea port with a SEZ. The projects reflect a shift in the business case for SEZs, from providing land and incentives to reducing the cost and complexity of producing and moving goods.

### Investing in Africa

“For us, that’s what successful SEZs are about – capturing more value in Africa, creating jobs, increasing exports and really building globally competitive African industries,” said Osam Iyahen, senior director and head of infrastructure at the Africa Finance Corporation (AFC).

Iyahen was speaking during an Invest Africa webinar on the role of SEZs in building competitive industries in Africa that was held on 1 October.

The AFC invests in power, transport, logistics, natural resources and heavy industry, making integrated zones attractive because they bring several of these requirements together. “SEZs are quite important to us because they bring all these sectors together,” Iyahen said.

The AFC invested $150-million in Arise Integrated Industrial Platforms in 2020 to support its expansion into Benin and Togo.

Iyahen said the platform has helped countries to move from exporting raw commodities towards local processing and manufacturing, attracting additional investment and creating jobs.

Togo provides a concrete example. Togo Soja, a soybean processing company based at the Adétikopé Industrial Platform, shipped its first export of processed shea butter on 1 October, opening the country’s 2026 export season for the product.

The shipment followed the ramp-up of a plant that has been operating since 2023.

The Adétikopé Industrial Platform says the operation is developing an integrated chain from raw-material supply and industrial processing to packaging and international markets.

“This shipment reflects the industrial dynamic developed on the platform and its ability to support companies from the transformation of raw materials to opening up to international markets,” said Idiola Sandah, general administrator of the platform’s coordination authority.

Togo introduced export taxes on cashew nuts, soybeans and shea nuts from January 2026 as it seeks to encourage more processing inside the country. The quantity of shea butter in the first shipment was not disclosed, but the move illustrates the commercial logic behind integrated industrial platforms: export more processed products rather than raw commodities.

### Warehouses and ports

Logistics is another part of that equation. Agility Global is building warehouse parks in African cities, providing ready-to-use facilities for companies entering new markets. “

We’re building large-scale, first-world warehouse parks across the main cities in the continent,” said Geoffrey White, CEO of Agility Africa.

The company has opened facilities in five countries and some are already fully occupied, White said.

Its customers include e-commerce companies, agro-processors, manufacturers, vehicle assemblers and fast-moving consumer goods distributors. About 65% of its tenants are multinationals and 35% are small and medium-sized businesses.

“Our concept is to remove, for companies moving into Africa, the risk of land tenure and project execution, and to remove the capital burden of going into the African marketplace,” White said.

Ports are becoming another piece of the industrial proposition. At the Lagos Free Zone, Nigeria’s Lekki Deep Sea Port sits inside an industrial development designed to combine manufacturing, logistics and maritime access.

Tejaswi Avasarala, director of commercialisation at the Lagos Free Zone, said the project had been shaped by the more than five decades of manufacturing experience in Nigeria of Tolaram, a multinational conglomerate with diversified businesses. The company has a “very deep and first-hand understanding” of the challenges facing investors trying to build deeper value chains and local supply chains, Avasarala said.

“We are trying to bring all that into the way we have conceptualised and delivered Nigeria’s first deep-sea port,” he said.

The same model is now being explored on a larger scale in Ogun State. The proposed Ogun development remains at the planning stage, so its projected investment and employment figures have yet to become operating results.

Kenya is pursuing a similar port-industrial model in Mombasa. DP World and GulfCap Africa signed a shareholders agreement in September for the planned 222ha Mombasa Industrial Park. The first phase is expected to cover 40ha, and more than 60 local and international companies have expressed interest. The completed park is projected to support more than 20,000 direct and indirect jobs.

At Dongo Kundu, the Kenyan government has allocated about $572-million for infrastructure supporting a 3,000-acre SEZ that includes industrial parks, logistics facilities and a free port.

Further south, the Coega SEZ in South Africa shows what the model can look like after years of development. The zone, next to the Port of Ngqura in the Eastern Cape, had 67 operational investors and more than 11,000 operational jobs by the end of the 2024 financial year. – Bird Story Agency/**DM**

title: Shein and Temu ban: Cosatu backs call to save local jobs
summary: The Congress of South African Trade Unions (Cosatu) backed a motion put forward by the Southern African Clothing and Textile Workers’ Union (Sactwu) for the government to ban international e-commerce platforms [Shein](https://www.dailymaver
content:
The Congress of South African Trade Unions (Cosatu) backed a motion put forward by the Southern African Clothing and Textile Workers’ Union (Sactwu) for the government to ban international e-commerce platforms [Shein](https://www.dailymaverick.co.za/article/2024-09-22-shein-fast-fashion-sacred-cows-and-an-ai-turbocharge/) and [Temu](https://www.dailymaverick.co.za/opinionista/2024-04-09-dont-be-fooled-by-shopping-platform-temus-childlike-interface/), citing a 2025 study which estimated that the platforms could jeopardise up to 34,000 local jobs by 2030.

Sactwu made a presentation on day three of Cosatu’s 15th National Conference, held on Wednesday, 15 October, at Emperor’s Palace in Johannesburg, where members displayed placards showing illustrations of handbags, carpets and other textiles on the front with the numbers of local jobs under threat in each industry on the back.

The placards showed estimated job losses based on current employment numbers in existing factories, ranging from seven to 304 across textile, clothing, leather, and cosmetics industries, amounting to a total of 34,000.

“Comrades, Shein and Temu now sell more products than other global retailers in South Africa,” said Sactwu president Susan Khumalo.

“It is causing job losses, it is also pushing down wages, pushing our benefits and our working conditions, as the clothing and textile workers union and the other workers [competing] with the cheap imports. If nothing is done, comrades, to change this, our city and our families will lose 34,000 jobs by 2030 as clothing and textile [industries], including the retailers,” she said.

### ‘They’re selling cheaper and faster’

South African Clothing and Textile Workers’ Union members display placards on 14 October, 2026, showing the potential number of jobs lost by 2030 in the clothing, textile, and manufacturing industries due to the proliferation of international e-commerce platforms. The Cosatu 15th National Congress is being held at Emperor’s Palace, Johannesburg. (Photo: Naledi Mashishi)

Shein, a Chinese-founded and Singaporean-headquartered e-commerce platform, first entered the South African market in 2020 and became the [most downloaded shopping app](https://personal.nedbank.co.za/learn/blog/shein-temu-taxes-south-africa.html) by 2023. Chinese-owned Temu entered the market in 2024. Both companies were able to take advantage of low overheads due to a lack of brick-and-mortar stores, aggressive marketing, high shipment volumes and tax loopholes to undercut local retailers.

In the second quarter of 2024, the Bureau for Economic Research found that confidence among semi-durable goods retailers of products such as textiles, clothing, footwear and leather goods fell to 38% from 68% in the first quarter, [adding](https://www.ber.ac.za/Documents/ViewMode/1212272a-f33b-4dee-b74f-6e7a2660f6d3) that retailers such as Shein “may also strain domestic clothing retailers”.

By the end of 2024, the companies [captured R7.3-billion](https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/shein-temu-outpace-global-retail-giants-south-africas-fashion-market-2025-08-05/) in sales, amounting to 37.1% of South Africa’s retail, clothing, textile, footwear and leather e-commerce market.

Previously, clothing retailer Shein made a somewhat slower, but still impressive, splash using a concept of retail and marketplace sales from China.

“These companies have taken off in South Africa. They are selling cheaper and faster than anyone else. But it is putting enormous pressure on workers and our local manufacturers, including retailers and workers in the public sector as well. It’s only four years of Shein and other online shopping, but it took a huge chunk of our clothing, textile, footwear and leather, including the retail market,” said Khumalo in her presentation.

Cosatu resolved to back the call and urged all other members to delete their Shein and Temu apps and commit to only sourcing goods from local retailers, in solidarity.

### Shein’s growth slowed to 11%

Members of the South African Clothing and Textile Workers Union hold up placards showing the number of jobs that could be lost by 2030 in the clothing, textile and manufacturing industries. (Photo: Naledi Mashishi)

However, Shein and Temu are already undergoing significant sales downturns. This is because in 2025, the South African Revenue Service (SARS) cracked down by removing tax exemptions on imported goods priced below R500. Shein, which previously grew between 30% to 50% annually, slowed to just 11% in 2025, while Temu recorded average monthly declines of 42% in the same period.

Independent economic strategist and board adviser Refilwe Moloto told Daily Maverick that the 34,000 figure might be outdated, given that it was calculated before the SARS tax amendments were in place. She warned an outright ban on the apps could be an uncompetitive approach that could have negative trade-offs.

> “Protectionist measures of that nature are likely to encourage, below the table, irregular and non-regulated trading. And what you really do want is for the taxpayer to be able to collect accordingly for value-added products and you’d also want to not have nefarious dealings across the border.”

She said South Africa was not unique in its predicament. Shein and Temu have had a larger impact on the US, French, and Latin American markets. In the US, Shein ranks as the third-largest online retailer.

In addition, the local textile industry has struggled to remain competitive due to local conditions such as high energy prices, the collapse of rail transportation and administrative costs.

“Those are structural issues that will impact the retailers themselves and the margins that they’re able to claim. It is not Shein’s fault that they operate in a country that makes their inputs cheaper, and that’s something that the government may need to address,” she said. **DM**

title: Hong Kong to mandate price transparency for private healthcare providers
zh_title: 香港强制要求私营医疗服务提供者价格透明
summary: 香港政府计划要求所有持牌私营医疗服务提供者公布双语价目表，针对私营医院的措施最早将于 2027 年 8 月生效。违规者将面临医院最高 10 万港元的罚款，诊所最高 25,000 港元的罚款。 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 2026 年 10 月 15 日 21:33 HKT · 2 分钟阅读香港计划通过附属立法强制私营医疗保健提供者的价格透明度，
content:
政府
香港计划要求所有持牌私营医疗服务提供者公布双语价目表，私营医院的措施最早将于 2027 年 8 月生效。违规者将面临医院最高 10 万港元的罚款，诊所最高 25,000 港元的罚款。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

2026 年 10 月 15 日 21:33 香港时间 · 阅读 2 分钟

政府于 2026 年 10 月 15 日宣布，香港计划通过附属立法强制私营医疗保健提供者实行价格透明度，首批针对私营医院的措施预计最早将于 2027 年 8 月生效。

卫生局向立法会提交文件，概述规定所有持牌私营医疗机构必须按规定格式提供双语价目表。清单必须按类别列出收费，包括病房、手术室或手术室、药物及消耗品，并以固定金额或范围表示价格，例如“每次300港元”或“300港元至500港元”。

该报称，如果费用取决于患者个人情况，机构必须在价目表中注明将在提供服务之前提供费用，并向患者提供印刷或电子形式的信息。
私人医疗保健提供者必须在工作时间内在所有接待和付款柜台、入院柜台和护士站展示打印或电子形式的价目表。私立医院也必须在其网站上公布名单。对价目表的任何修改必须在生效前至少 7 天宣布，并向卫生部报告。

该规定还要求所有持牌私立医院提供接受指定治疗和手术的患者的费用估算。对于以固定金额估价的情况，如果最终费用超出估价20%或以上，医院必须提供书面解释。

根据该局的文件，违反规定的私立医院可能会被处以最高 10 万港元的罚款，而日间医疗中心和诊所则可能会被处以最高 25,000 港元的罚款。

政府计划于2026年底前向立法会提交规例，并制定实务守则，并于2027年下半年开始分阶段实施。

[![图片3：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

【原文 English Original】
Government
Hong Kong plans to require all licensed private healthcare providers to publish bilingual price lists, with measures for private hospitals taking effect as early as August 2027. Violators face fines of up to HK$100,000 for hospitals and HK$25,000 for clinics.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

15 Oct 2026 at 21:33 HKT · 2 min read

Hong Kong plans to mandate price transparency for private healthcare providers through subsidiary legislation, with the first measures targeting private hospitals expected to take effect as early as August 2027, the government announced on 15 October 2026.

The Health Bureau submitted a paper to the Legislative Council outlining regulations requiring all licensed private healthcare institutions to provide bilingual price lists in a prescribed format. The lists must itemise charges by categories including wards, operating theatres or procedure rooms, drugs and consumables, with prices expressed as fixed amounts or ranges such as "HK$300 per time" or "HK$300 to HK$500".

If fees depend on individual patient circumstances, institutions must indicate in the price list that the charges will be provided before the service is delivered, and supply the information in print or electronic form to patients, the paper said.

Private healthcare providers must display price lists in print or electronic form at all reception and payment counters, admission desks and nurse stations during business hours. Private hospitals must also publish the lists on their websites. Any amendments to price lists must be announced at least seven days before taking effect and reported to the Department of Health.

The regulations will also require all licensed private hospitals to provide fee estimates for patients receiving designated treatments and procedures. For cases where the estimate is given as a fixed amount, hospitals must provide a written explanation if the final charge exceeds the estimate by 20 per cent or more.

Violations of the requirements could result in fines of up to HK$100,000 for private hospitals and HK$25,000 for day medical centres and clinics, according to the bureau's paper.

The government plans to submit the regulations to LegCo by the end of 2026 and draw up a code of practice, with measures to be implemented in phases starting in the second half of 2027.

# Taipei mayoral candidates Chiang, Shen to debate Oct. 31

10/15/2026 08:56 PM

Taipei Mayor Chiang Wan-an (right) and Democratic Progressive Party lawmaker Puma Shen. CNA file photo

Taipei, Oct. 15 (CNA) Taipei Mayor Chiang Wan-an (蔣萬安) of the Kuomintang (KMT) and his challenger, Democratic Progressive Party (DPP) lawmaker Puma Shen (沈伯洋), agreed Thursday to hold their first televised debate on Oct. 31.

The debate will be held from 12 p.m. to 2 p.m. that day at the TVBS studio, TVBS and SET News, the event's co-hosts, said in a joint statement following a meeting attended by representatives of both campaigns.

The debate format will include opening statements, cross-examination between the candidates, questions from the media and closing statements, the hosts said.

Wu Szu-yao (吳思瑤), a DPP lawmaker and campaign manager for Shen, said the two sides had differing views on the date and time, although Shen's campaign remains flexible.

Wu said her side had also proposed holding more debates, but Chiang's campaign did not respond favorably to the proposal.

KMT Legislator Lo Chih-chiang (羅智強), representing Chiang, said Chiang's campaign is open to holding more debates and has accepted invitations from other media outlets.

The debate date coincides with this year's Taipei Pride march, which is scheduled to begin at 2:05 p.m. at Taipei City Hall Square and pass through the commercial area in Taipei's eastern district, following a rally starting at noon.

Wu said Shen will take part in the march, while Lo said Chiang will also join the event, as both have done in previous years.

(By Yeh Chen-yun and Shih Hsiu-chuan)

title: Taiwan president urges Micron, unions to negotiate 'sincerely' ahead of possible strike
zh_title: 台湾总统敦促美光科技与工会在可能的罢工之前“真诚地”进行谈判
summary: 台湾商界总裁赖清德呼吁美光科技及其台湾员工就可能导致罢工的奖金纠纷进行真诚谈判。他在美光新工厂发表讲话时敦促建立和谐的劳资关系，而美光表示 2027 年产能已售罄。 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 2026 年 10 月 15 日 13:44 HKT · 2 分钟阅读台湾总统赖清德周四呼吁美国内存芯片制造商美光科技
content:
商务
台湾总统赖清德呼吁美光科技及其台湾工人就可能导致罢工的奖金纠纷进行真诚谈判。他在美光新工厂发表讲话时敦促建立和谐的劳资关系，而美光表示 2027 年产能已售罄。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

香港时间 2026 年 10 月 15 日 13:44 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

台湾总统赖清德周四呼吁美国存储芯片制造商美光科技及其工人在该公司台湾工会可能举行罢工之前“真诚地”进行谈判。

上周，代表美光科技工人的台湾工会表示，已获得其成员的授权，可以就该公司奖金计划的争议进行罢工，导致该芯片制造商最大制造中心的劳资冲突升级。美光科技在台湾拥有约 15,000 名员工，并表示其在台湾的投资超过 1.6 万亿新台币（494 亿美元）。
黎智英在台中一家新的美光先进组装和测试工厂的开业典礼上发表讲话时表示，他希望政府和私营部门能够共同努力，促进劳资之间加强沟通。我们也希望劳资双方秉持鱼需要水、水需要鱼的精神，继续真诚协商，凝聚最广泛共识。” “只有营造和谐劳动关系，才能双方共赢，让员工安心工作，让企业走得稳、走得更远。”

赖表示，他赞赏美光科技对台湾的承诺，并希望美光科技继续扩大在台湾的投资，并补充说美光科技已获得政府对高带宽内存（HBM）研发的支持。台湾是美光 DRAM 和 HBM 芯片的重要生产中心，这些芯片用于人工智能服务器。

美光科技总裁兼首席运营官曼尼什·巴蒂亚 (Manish Bhatia) 在赖智发表讲话前不久发表的评论中没有提及可能采取的罢工行动。他表示：“我们已经售出了该工厂将在 2027 年建造的所有产能，我们预计到 2028 年，高带宽内存的增长速度将比 DRAM 行业的其他产品增长得更快。”
美光台中工会告诉路透社，期待该公司与他们进行“更实质性的对话和谈判”。美光及其位于桃园的其他工会都没有立即回应对赖的言论发表评论的请求。

上周，代表美光桃园和台中工厂员工的两个工会表示，希望公司能够为员工提出具体的利润分享提案。与桃园工会的调解于9月未能达成协议，而台中工会仍在谈判中。工会鼓励会员在 10 月 19 日休息一天，参加在台北举行的集会，他们表示这不会是罢工。

[![图片3：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

主编

负责 CLB.org.hk 报道和编辑标准的主编。

【原文 English Original】
Business
Taiwanese President Lai Ching-te called on Micron Technology and its Taiwan workers to negotiate sincerely over a bonus dispute that could lead to a strike. Speaking at a new Micron facility, he urged harmonious labour relations, while Micron said 2027 capacity is already sold out.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

15 Oct 2026 at 13:44 HKT · 2 min read

Taiwanese President Lai Ching-te called on Thursday for US memory chipmaker Micron Technology and its workers to negotiate "sincerely" ahead of a possible strike by the company's union in Taiwan.

Last week, a Taiwanese union representing workers at Micron said it had secured authorisation from its members to strike over a dispute concerning the company's bonus scheme, escalating a labour conflict at the chipmaker's largest manufacturing hub. Micron employs about 15,000 people in Taiwan and has said it invested more than T$1.6 trillion ($49.4 billion) on the island.

Speaking in Taichung at the opening of a new Micron advanced assembly and testing facility, Lai said he hoped the government and private sector could work together to promote stronger communication between labour and management. "We also hope both labour and management will uphold the spirit that fish need water and water needs fish, continuing to negotiate sincerely and in good faith to build the broadest possible consensus," he added. "Only by creating harmonious labour relations can both sides win, allowing employees to work with peace of mind and businesses to move steadily and go further."

Lai said he appreciated Micron's commitment to Taiwan and hoped it would continue expanding investment on the island, adding that Micron had secured government support for high-bandwidth memory (HBM) research and development. Taiwan is a crucial production hub for Micron's DRAM and HBM chips, which are used in AI servers.

Manish Bhatia, Micron's president and chief operating officer, made no mention of a possible strike action in his comments delivered shortly before Lai's. "We have already sold out all the capacity for 2027 that this factory will build and we expect high-bandwidth memory to grow faster than the rest of the DRAM industry all the way through 2028," he said.

Micron's Taichung union told Reuters that it looked forward to the company engaging in "more substantive dialogue and negotiations" with them. Neither Micron nor its other union, in Taoyuan, immediately responded to requests for comment on Lai's remarks.

Last week, the two unions representing workers at Micron's Taoyuan and Taichung operations said they hoped the company would put forward a concrete profit-sharing proposal for employees. Mediation with the Taoyuan union ended without agreement in September, while the Taichung union remains in negotiations. The unions are encouraging members to take a day off on October 19 to join a rally in Taipei, which they said would not be a strike.

content:
3小时前

萨琳·哈贝希安

](https://ichef.bbci.co.uk/news/480/cpsprodpb/7c7f/live/f7333c90-c838-11f1-b2e8-93da8301514e.jpg.webp)盖蒂图片社

白宫正在为其新任新闻秘书凯蒂·扎卡里亚辩护，因为她面临着对其法律资历的审查。

唐纳德·特朗普总统上周宣布任命扎卡里亚为律师时，她将自己描述为律师。

但周二，当一名记者问她在哪个州通过了成为美国律师所需的律师考试时，她站在总统身边说：“当我搬到中国时。”

她似乎没有在她居住过的任何州的律师协会注册。白宫通讯主管史蒂文·张 (Steven Cheung) 表示，扎卡里亚“具有独特的资格和聪明才智，可以帮助向美国人民通报情况”。

在回答有关她的资质的问题时，扎卡里亚在本周的一份声明中表示：“我从事国际交易法工作，拥有所有适当的资质。”

周三，监督组织“问责运动”向加州律师协会提出投诉。

他们正在寻求调查扎卡里亚是否“一再向公众声称自己有权在没有执照的情况下执业，加州法律将这种行为视为犯罪”。

加州佩珀代因大学证实，这位 42 岁的政治战略家 2011 年毕业于该大学法学院。
法律学位并不是在美国执业的许可证。

这位新任白宫新闻秘书周三告诉《纽约时报》，当她第一次开始出现在有线电视新闻中时，她曾问佩珀代因应该如何表明自己的身份。

她说，大学校长建议她可以称自己为律师，但不能称自己为律师。

据《华尔街日报》报道，扎卡里亚从法学院毕业后在加州参加了律师资格考试，但没有通过。加州的律师考试被广泛认为是美国最难通过的律师考试之一。

一位直接了解此事的人士告诉媒体，扎卡里亚参加考试的时间大约是在她计划婚礼并准备与未婚夫搬到中国的同时。

由于丈夫在一家美国私募股权公司工作，她搬到了北京。扎卡里亚表示，她在那里研究“国际交易法”。

她的 LinkedIn 个人资料显示，她于 2011-13 年间在北京中伦律师事务所担任律师。

在中国，只有中国公民才有资格获得律师执业资格。外籍雇员可以在律师事务所担任其他职务。

去年2月，扎卡里亚在保守派广播节目《克莱·特拉维斯和巴克·塞克斯顿秀》中表示，她在中国期间曾担任国际金融公司（IFC）和世界银行的外部顾问。

BBC 已联系世界银行和国际金融公司征求意见。
据了解，世界银行集团有时会聘请外部律师事务所，由这些律师事务所决定将哪些律师分配到任何工作的哪些部分。

根据扎卡里亚的 LinkedIn 个人资料，她还担任 Fix California 的总法律顾问，这是一个由特朗普盟友里克·格雷内尔 (Ric Grenell) 创办的保守派非营利组织。

3 hours ago

Sareen Habeshian

](https://ichef.bbci.co.uk/news/480/cpsprodpb/7c7f/live/f7333c90-c838-11f1-b2e8-93da8301514e.jpg.webp)Getty Images

The White House is defending its new press secretary, Katie Zacharia, as she faces scrutiny over her legal credentials.

President Donald Trump described Zacharia as an attorney when announcing her appointment last week and she has referred to herself as a lawyer.

But when she was asked on Tuesday by a reporter in which state she had passed the bar exam required to be an attorney in the US, she said standing alongside the president: "When I moved to China."

She does not appear to be registered to the bar in any state where she has lived. White House communications director Steven Cheung said Zacharia is "uniquely qualified and whip smart to help inform the American people".

Responding to questions about her credentials, Zacharia said in a statement this week: "I practised international transaction law, with all the appropriate credentials."

On Wednesday, a watchdog group, Campaign for Accountability, filed a complaint with the California State Bar Association.

They are seeking an investigation into whether Zacharia "repeatedly held herself out to the public as entitled to practise law without a licence to do so, conduct California law treats as a crime".

The 42-year-old political strategist graduated from law school at Pepperdine University in California in 2011, the university confirmed.

A law degree is not a licence to practise law in the US.

The new White House press secretary told the New York Times on Wednesday that when she first began appearing on cable news, she had asked Pepperdine how she should identify herself.

She said she was advised by the university president that she could call herself a lawyer, but not an attorney.

Zacharia took the bar exam in California after graduating from law school but did not pass, according to the Wall Street Journal. California's bar exam is widely regarded as one of the hardest in the US to pass.

A person with direct knowledge of the matter told the outlet that Zacharia took the exam around the same time that she was planning a wedding and preparing to move to China with her husband-to-be.

She moved to Beijing because of her husband's job at an American private equity firm. Zacharia has said she worked on "international transaction law" there.

Her LinkedIn profile states that she worked as an associate at Zhong Lun Law Firm in Beijing from 2011-13.

In China, only Chinese citizens are eligible to obtain a licence to practise law. Foreign employees may work at law firms in other roles.

In February last year, Zacharia said on conservative radio programme The Clay Travis and Buck Sexton Show that she had worked as outside counsel for the International Finance Corporation (IFC) and the World Bank during her time in China.

The BBC has contacted the World Bank and IFC for comment.

It is understood the World Bank Group sometimes retains outside law firms, and that those firms decide which of their lawyers are assigned to which parts of any work.

Zacharia has also served as general counsel for Fix California, a conservative non-profit started by Trump ally Ric Grenell, according to her LinkedIn profile.

title: Ilocos Region health officials make push for improved stroke care coordination
summary: HEALTH officials and medical professionals in the Ilocos Region are seeking better coordination among hospitals and health care facilities to address delays in stroke treatment, particularly for patients in remote communities, as stroke rem
content:
HEALTH officials and medical professionals in the Ilocos Region are seeking better coordination among hospitals and health care facilities to address delays in stroke treatment, particularly for patients in remote communities, as stroke remains the region’s leading cause of death.

The issue was discussed during a multi-stakeholder roundtable organized by UHC Watch and supported by Boehringer Ingelheim, where participants examined ways to improve stroke prevention, emergency treatment, referrals and rehabilitation across Region 1.

In La Union, stroke has remained among the causes of death over the past three years, according to Dr. Ivy Ico of the Provincial Department of Health Office in La Union.

*   [Laguna mayors rally behind Aragones](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/14/regions/laguna-mayors-rally-behind-aragones/2444954)

“Stroke is not only a major health problem. It also places a significant financial burden on patients, families and communities,” Ico said.

[![Image 1: FACEBOOK/UHC WATCH](https://manilatimes.net/manilatimes/uploads/images/2026/10/14/1260041.jpg)](https://manilatimes.net/manilatimes/uploads/images/2026/10/14/1260041.jpg)
FACEBOOK/UHC WATCH

Sign up for The Manila Times newsletters

By signing up with an email address, I acknowledge that I have read and agree to the [Terms of Service](https://manilatimes.net/terms-of-service "Terms of Service") and [Privacy Policy](https://manilatimes.net/privacy-policy "Privacy Policy").

She cited the need to improve referral pathways, specialist availability, public awareness and coordination among health care providers.

For patients in remote municipalities, traveling to facilities equipped to provide specialized stroke care can take two to four hours, potentially exceeding the 4.5-hour treatment window for certain interventions.

*   ![Image 2: Arroyo hails Nobel Peace Prize winner](https://miopia.newsroom.bi/statics/i/ps/manilatimes.net/manilatimes/uploads/images/2026/10/14/1259931.jpeg?width=113&crop=113:85)
[Arroyo hails Nobel Peace Prize winner](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/15/news/national/arroyo-hails-nobel-peace-prize-winner/2445857)

Dr. Mary Grace Fabia-Mistica, stroke program head of the Ilocos Training and Regional Medical Center Brain and Spine Center and the La Union Medical Center, said delays in recognizing symptoms and coordinating referrals contribute to patients arriving at hospitals beyond the critical treatment window.

“Some families still mistake stroke symptoms as a temporary episode of high blood pressure or initially seek treatment at home. Every delay can affect a patient’s chances of survival and recovery,” Mistica said.

Health care professionals also cited uneven access to neurologists, rehabilitation providers and long-term follow-up services, particularly in geographically isolated communities.

To address referral delays, stakeholders are advancing StrokeLiNCS LU, or Stroke Linking Institutions for Network Care, toward a Stronger La Union. The initiative aims to connect health care facilities through a hub-and-spoke system.

*   ![Image 3: ‘Our soldiers are not troublemakers’](https://miopia.newsroom.bi/statics/i/ps/manilatimes.net/manilatimes/uploads/images/2026/10/14/1260179.jpg?width=113&crop=113:85)
[‘Our soldiers are not troublemakers’](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/15/news/our-soldiers-are-not-troublemakers/2445870)

Under the proposed model, designated hospitals, including the Ilocos Training and Regional Medical Center and the La Union Medical Center, would provide specialized stroke services, while smaller facilities would focus on recognizing symptoms, stabilizing patients and arranging referrals.

The proposed system would also use standardized protocols, hospital pre-notification, workforce training, telemedicine support and a shared stroke registry to improve coordination from emergency treatment through rehabilitation.

“The model does more than move patients,” Mistica said. “It helps bring expertise closer to where patients are.” The initiative is aligned with the Department of Health’s National Policy Framework on the Prevention, Control and Management of Acute Stroke, which seeks to establish coordinated stroke care under the Universal Health Care Act.

Ico said the framework covers prevention, acute treatment, rehabilitation and long-term recovery, supported by stronger health care networks, data systems, training and financing.

*   ![Image 4: Pangilinan seeks reversal of ruling on Duterte’s dropped charges](https://miopia.newsroom.bi/statics/i/ps/manilatimes.net/manilatimes/uploads/images/2026/10/14/1258438.jpg?width=113&crop=113:85)
[Pangilinan seeks reversal of ruling on Duterte’s dropped charges](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/14/news/pangilinan-seeks-reversal-of-ruling-on-dutertes-dropped-charges/2445025)

At the provincial level, the La Union government and local stakeholders are working to incorporate dedicated stroke referral pathways into the next version of the province’s health care provider network referral manual.

Plans for a Level II general hospital and a neurological rehabilitation center have also been included in the proposed La Union Medical Hub.

Alvin Manalansan, co-convenor of UHC Watch, said improving stroke care requires cooperation among government agencies, hospitals, health care professionals, civil society groups and private organizations.

Participants called for continued coordination across the full range of stroke care, from public awareness and emergency response to treatment, rehabilitation and long-term follow-up.

## 中共眼中的3件大事 [北京](https://www.secretchina.com/news/gb/tag/%E5%8C%97%E4%BA%AC)草木皆兵

法广报导，中共五中全会将在本月底举行，自10月中旬起，中国各地政府对访民的维稳已经启动，许多访民在北京或在当地出行受阻。为躲避维稳，一些访民提前离开本地。

前中共总书记赵紫阳的生日也来到，因同情“六四”学运而被迫下台的赵紫阳，生于1919年10月17日，2005年1月17日去世。“六四”事件之后，赵紫阳和“六四”话题在[中国](https://www.secretchina.com/)大陆一直被禁忌。

还有，今年10月13日是北京四通桥事件4周年纪念日。中国公民彭立发（网名彭载舟）2022年10月13日在北京四通桥公开抗议中共党魁[习近平](https://www.secretchina.com/news/gb/tag/%E4%B9%A0%E8%BF%91%E5%B9%B3)。此后当局就招募大批“看桥员”在市区行人天桥上看守。近日北京多条天桥上有“看桥员”（守桥员）在“站岗”。

报导指，上述三件事聚集在一起，致使全北京维稳升级。

## 高瑜连续多日被当局派来人员上岗监控

10月13日，北京资深媒体人高瑜在其X帐号上贴图并发帖说：“刚结束长假就把岗哨派来了，去年还租一辆7座别克，今年就让人在露天坐着，刮风下雨躲得地儿都没有。天不亮就来了，有人送饭。下午换岗。”

高瑜10月16日又发帖称：“今天才明白，11—14日的4天被上岗，两个原因，其中之一是[四通桥](https://www.secretchina.com/news/gb/tag/%E5%9B%9B%E9%80%9A%E6%A1%A5)事件4周年；我还没有接到警方正式通知，但是听说17—19日全北京继续站岗，17日是赵紫阳107岁诞辰，18日是他的下葬纪念日，昌平天寿园将是警察重防之地。”

高瑜写道：“明天开始，我当然随时准备拍小视频。除非让我在楼头和院子里看不见蹲守的人影。回忆2019年10月18日紫阳和夫人合葬，国保和警察开着蓝牌车给我站岗，那真是一段精彩的故事。留待以后再叙。”

高瑜还表示，决定监视行为的不是他们，“我要骂，就骂他们的领导”。如果他们妨碍自己的行动自由而引发争执，“我会录像、拍照，他们的领导最怕曝光。因为会扣奖金、工资，跟浦志强的就被扣过”。

## 北京[维权](https://www.secretchina.com/news/gb/tag/%E7%BB%B4%E6%9D%83)人士和两位80多岁老人被囚禁在家不给饭吃

10月14日，北京维权人士赵永红与80多岁高龄老父母被恩济庄派出所囚禁在家两天没有饭吃，多次报警求助换来的不是救助，而是警察一声令下：看好，不让她出去！赵永红无奈被迫半夜开窗呼救，控诉被非法囚禁不给饭吃。13日，北京维权人士叶红霞、林春芬应邀与维权朋友外出就餐，遭到政府人员和黑保安粗暴围堵。
