title: HKTB reviews Peak light plans after public concerns
zh_title: 因公众担忧，旅发局检讨高峰灯光计划
summary: 香港 在居民和环保人士强烈反对后，香港旅游发展局承诺检讨在太平山顶安装装饰灯饰的计划。在发布更新计划之前，董事会将进行更广泛的磋商并评估所有建议。 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 2026 年 10 月 18 日 21:03 HKT · 2 分钟阅读《香港报》旅游发展局（旅发局）承诺进行更广泛的公众咨询并审查其计划
content:
香港
在遭到居民和环保人士强烈反对后，香港旅游发展局承诺检讨在太平山顶安装装饰灯饰的计划。在发布更新计划之前，董事会将进行更广泛的磋商并评估所有建议。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

2026 年 10 月 18 日 21:03 香港时间 · 阅读 2 分钟

鉴于当地居民和环保人士日益关注，香港旅游发展局（旅发局）承诺进行更广泛的公众咨询，并审查在太平山顶安装装饰照明的计划。

旅游局在一份官方声明中表示，在采取行动之前，他们仍然致力于平衡可持续旅游业、保护自然环境和满足附近居民的需求。

该倡议旨在沿着热门的卢吉路和哈勒克路步行道的选定部分安装小型低眩光照明装置。景观增强计划与即将到来的香港冬季节的新灯光和声音表演一起推出，作为传统“幻彩咏香江”壮观的现代替代品，以提高城市的夜间经济吸引力。
在开发过程中，董事会征求了多个利益相关者和监管部门的反馈。四月，代表们向中西区民政事务专员和当区区议员介绍创意概念。该委员会于5月5日、9月2日和9月24日向附近住户直接发出书面通知，让社区了解施工时间表和临时交通安排。它还于5月19日和8月5日召开了两次跨部门会议，以协调安全、物流和基础设施法规。

项目参数共咨询了十个公共机构，包括渔农自然护理署、消防处、民政事务总署、香港警务处、路政署、地政总署、康乐及文化事务署、运输署、土木工程拓展署及水务署。
根据最初的提案，低眩光灯设计为每天晚上 7 点至 10 点按受控时间表运行，所有装置均远离住宅区，以保护当地隐私。该试验项目最初计划运行 12 个月的试点阶段。为了最大限度地减少生态足迹，该委员会聘请了注册树艺师和相关部门来监督环境安全。安装的每个方面——包括选择合适的树木、悬挂方法、保护性缓冲、承重限制和物理附着技术——都需要专业树艺师的正式签字，他们还负责对树木的健康状况进行例行的后续检查。

认识到公众和居民反馈的强烈程度，旅游局确认将仔细评估所有建议，审查总体运营安排，并在稍后发布更新计划。

[![图片3：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

主编

主编主持

【原文 English Original】
Hong Kong
The Hong Kong Tourism Board has pledged to review its plan to install decorative lighting on the Peak after strong opposition from residents and environmentalists. The board will hold wider consultations and assess all suggestions before publishing updated plans.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

18 Oct 2026 at 21:03 HKT · 2 min read

The Hong Kong Tourism Board (HKTB) has pledged to carry out wider public consultations and review its plans to install decorative lighting on the Peak, following mounting concerns from local residents and environmental advocates.

In an official statement, the tourism authority said it remained committed to balancing sustainable tourism, protecting the natural environment and addressing the needs of neighbourhood residents before moving forward.

The initiative sought to place small, low-glare light installations along selected portions of the popular Lugard Road and Harlech Road walking trails. The scenic enhancement was scheduled to launch alongside a new light and sound show for the upcoming Hong Kong WinterFest, acting as a modern replacement for the traditional "A Symphony of Lights" spectacular to boost the city's night-time economic appeal.

During the developmental process, the board sought feedback from multiple stakeholders and regulatory departments. In April, representatives introduced the creative concepts to the District Officer (Central and Western) and local district councilors. The board sent direct written notices to nearby households on 5 May, 2 September and 24 September to keep the community informed of construction timelines and temporary traffic arrangements. It also convened two cross-departmental meetings on 19 May and 5 August to coordinate safety, logistics and infrastructure regulations.

A total of ten public bodies were consulted on the project parameters, including the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department, the Fire Services Department, the Home Affairs Department, the Hong Kong Police Force, the Highways Department, the Lands Department, the Leisure and Cultural Services Department, the Transport Department, the Civil Engineering and Development Department, and the Water Supplies Department.

Under the original proposal, the low-glare lights were designed to operate on a controlled schedule from 7pm to 10pm daily, with all installations positioned away from residential properties to safeguard local privacy. The trial project was initially intended to run for a pilot phase of 12 months. To minimise the ecological footprint, the board engaged registered arborists and relevant departments to oversee environmental safety. Every aspect of the installation—including the selection of appropriate trees, hanging methods, protective cushioning, weight-bearing limits, and physical attachment techniques—required formal sign-off from professional arborists, who were also tasked with conducting routine follow-up inspections on the trees' health.

Recognising the intensity of public and resident feedback, the tourism board confirmed that it will carefully assess all suggestions, review the overall operational arrangements, and publish updated plans at a later date.

[![Image 3: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

content:
## 俄罗斯境内反普京破坏行动的隐秘世界

*       *   Author, 莫妮卡·加恩西（Monica Garnsey）
    *   Role, BBC之眼（BBC Eye）调查团队

*   Published 4 小时前

*   阅读时间: 5 分钟

两名秘密为乌克兰情报部门工作的俄罗斯男子罕有地讲述了他们声称参与的行动。这些行动以俄罗斯境内的军事资产和军事人员为目标。

其中一名男子——我们称他为伊凡（Ivan）——声称曾在俄罗斯境内参与乌克兰针对其本国领土上战略轰炸机和军需工厂的无人机袭击行动。

他出现在BBC国际部（BBC World Service）一部有关俄罗斯破坏分子隐秘世界的纪录片中。

这部纪录片由波兰独立记者马尔钦·马蒙（Marcin Mamon）制作，另一名受访者是我们称为福马（Foma）的男子，他是一名流亡波兰的俄罗斯人。

福马表示，他在俄罗斯境内运作一个秘密志愿者网络，监视国防部情报总局（GUR）——乌克兰的军事情报机构——正在考虑列为目标的高级军官。他强调，他们从未直接参与袭击行动本身。

他也对其监视对象守口如瓶，但在去年12月莫斯科发生法尼尔·萨尔瓦罗夫中将（Lt Gen Fanil Sarvarov）遇刺事件后，福马承认曾向乌克兰方面提供有关他的情报。

图像来源，Getty Images

图像加注文字，法尼尔·萨尔瓦罗夫中将（Lt Gen Fanil Sarvarov）于去年在莫斯科遇害，凶手使用藏在其汽车底部的爆炸装置将其炸死。

此前曾有媒体报道俄罗斯破坏小组的存在，但能接触到像伊凡这样在当地行动，并讲述其涉嫌参与活动的人士，十分难得。

GUR已向BBC证实，伊凡和福马均为该机构工作。但GUR亦承认无法掌握全部情况。当BBC追问伊凡的联络人是否能够信任他时，对方回答说：“除了我自己，我不确定任何人。”

而GUR以及两名男子对于愿意透露多少细节都相当谨慎，因此无法核实他们声称参与过的行动。

不过，伊凡和福马所描述的大致策略，已获乌克兰当局承认。基辅曾谈及其协同发动无人机攻击的策略，以其所称位于俄罗斯境内的合法军事目标为对象，并承认为此动用了秘密特工。

目前难以证实究竟有多少俄罗斯人在为乌克兰从事这类工作。根据福马的说法，人数约为300至500人，但这一说法无法独立核实。

伊凡和福马表示，他们反对的不仅是俄罗斯对乌克兰的战争，也反对俄罗斯总统普京（Vladimir Putin）所建立的政治体制，并认为普京的政治未来取决于这场战争的结果。

“目前⋯⋯我认为如果这场战争失败，（普京）政权可能会垮台⋯⋯而透过我们的行动，我们正试图加速这一进程。”伊凡说。

他告诉马蒙，自己的工作包括监视军事设施，以及寻找可藏匿无人机零件的地点，为未来可能针对俄罗斯军事目标发动的袭击做准备。

“当这些（无人机）零件被组装起来后⋯⋯就会成为一种威力强大的武器，只需一次打击，就能摧毁价值数以千万美元计的目标。”伊凡说。

他向马蒙提供了一段影片，其中显示他似乎正在俄罗斯一处军用机场附近藏匿爆炸物。

如果被捕，他将被控犯有恐怖主义罪，并面临数十年的监禁。

福马的工作则有所不同。他透过远端方式运作，在网上培训身处俄罗斯的志愿者。马蒙曾目睹他进行其中一次培训，内容是如何跟踪一名被列入监视名单的高级军官。

图像加注文字，福马解释说，他如何教导其卧底志愿者跟踪俄罗斯军官。

“你会从我或我的同事那里收到一份档案⋯⋯里面会有拟定目标的资料。档案将包含（目标人物的）照片、个人资料、详细资讯、出生日期、年龄，以及对他的描述。如果他有车，还会有关于其车辆的资讯。当你接近目标时，不要携带手机。”他这样告诉自己的志愿者。

福马表示，他曾是俄罗斯精英阶层的一员，因此拥有独特的人脉网络和源源不绝的内部消息来源。

他在笔记型电脑上向马蒙展示，自己如何绘制军事目标分布图。

“这里显示的是一个资料库⋯⋯包括储存仓库的位置以及军事单位所在位置。将军们住在哪里⋯⋯轰炸乌克兰的战略轰炸机飞行员又住在哪里。

“若想瓦解这个体系，你就必须了解它如何运作。然后你就能瞄准它的弱点。”

他表示，其网络约有“30多人”，分布于俄罗斯、乌克兰及欧洲其他地区，而俄罗斯境外成员则负责后勤支援，例如追踪目标的数位足迹。

福马强调，受监视目标由GUR提出建议，但他和团队会自行核实这些人是否应被视为战争罪犯。

“通常⋯⋯我们也会核查（该人士的）资料⋯⋯只有在完成核查后，我们才会决定是否接受这项工作。”

但他认为，自己团队的行动具有正当性。

“我希望那些代表普京和俄罗斯在乌克兰做出可怕事情的人⋯⋯明白自己终将付出代价。我希望他们感到害怕。”

福马强调，他只是向乌克兰方面提供情报，其网络本身并未参与任何暗杀行动。

谈及于2025年12月遭杀害的萨尔瓦罗夫将军，他后来发讯息告诉马蒙：“追踪他花了不少工夫。他轮流住在情妇和同事家中，不断掩饰行踪，且经常改变行程安排。”

不过，福马并未事先向马蒙和BBC透露任何行动计划。

相比之下，伊凡即使在行动结束后，对自己参与过的工作仍然守口如瓶。

福马则自行调查过伊凡。

在向乌克兰和俄罗斯两地的军事情报联络人核实后，他认为伊凡很可能参与了去年6月针对俄罗斯最大军用无人机工厂之一、位于叶拉布加（Yelabuga）的袭击计划。据报该事件造成一人死亡。

伊凡强调，行动目标始终是尽可能避免伤及平民。

对伊凡而言，这些行动显然也充满风险。

“最惊险的一次，是我的汽车被拦下接受检查，而我身上正带着自制炸药。风险非常高，但正如你所见，我并没有被发现。”他说。

他表示，为降低身分暴露的风险，这类工作“没有明确的组织架构”，并补充说，自己从未见过、也不知道其他一同参与行动者的真实身分。

福马对其行动人员也采取同样的原则。

“一旦开始把人集中成群、建立群组聊天⋯⋯在网路上留下痕迹，整个团体极有可能很快就会被逮捕或瓦解。”他说。

伊凡则强调，俄罗斯境内已经没有多少适合从事这类工作的人。

“大多数有理想信念的人，不是已经离开这个国家，就是已经身陷囹圄。”他说。

BBC了解到，正因如此，许多在俄罗斯本土参与破坏行动的人，往往是在不知情的状况下卷入其中，例如不知道自己运送货物已遭人动手脚的卡车司机；另一部分则是受金钱驱使的人。

另一方面，伊凡表示，自己从事这项工作是出于理念信念。他过去曾是政治反对派成员，因此其行踪理应受到俄罗斯当局密切监控。

正因如此，他能够频繁离开俄罗斯又顺利返回，令人感到意外。

图像加注文字，马蒙在乔治亚等待与伊凡会面。我们对伊凡显然能够自由出入俄罗斯感到意外。

马蒙说服伊凡开车载他前往格鲁吉亚的荒漠地带，以便能够自由交谈，并问他乌克兰方面如何能够信任他。

“你会前往第三国⋯⋯在那里与（乌克兰的）特工会面⋯⋯并接受测谎。”伊凡告诉他。

马蒙请伊凡安排他与一名身在乌克兰的GUR联络人取得联系。这名男子随即打电话给伊凡，并开启扩音功能，似乎藉此证明伊凡确实替他工作。两人以暗语交谈，提到“学校的维修工程”。

但后来，这名联络人承认，他无法排除伊凡同时也在为俄罗斯工作，不论是出于自愿还是胁迫之下。

福马认为，伊凡能够自由出入境，本身未必就是可疑讯号。

“（这个国家的治理体系）到处都有漏洞，如果你知道这些漏洞在哪里，或者只是运气好，那你就能钻过去⋯⋯并在这个体制里生存。就像乳酪里的一只老鼠。”他告诉马蒙。

或许更有说服力的是，如果伊凡同时也在替俄罗斯联邦安全局（FSB）从事间谍活动，那么他很可能会把自己所知的乌克兰袭击计划透露给俄方。早在乌克兰逾100架无人机发动毁灭性袭击的一年多前，伊凡就曾告诉马蒙，俄罗斯各地军用机场的战略轰炸机将遭遇一次大规模攻击，但他从未透露具体时间或地点。

马蒙问伊凡，他如何承受这份工作的压力。

“恐惧始终存在，”他说。“它如影随形。即使你什么都不做，你依然会害怕。这里是俄罗斯。”

但他对最终的改变抱持乐观态度。

他说：“普京不会永远活着。”

# Taiwan Railway to ban political advertising in stations from 2027

10/19/2026 05:18 PM

[](jsvscript:)[](jsvscript:)[](javascript:void(0))[Listen](javascript:)

[Link](javascript:)[Whatsapp](javascript:)[Reddit](javascript:)[Line](javascript:)[Email](javascript:)

To activate the text-to-speech service, please first agree to the privacy policy below.

CNA file photo

Taipei, Oct. 19 (CNA) State-owned Taiwan Railway Corp. (TR) on Monday said it would ban political advertisements in its stations with effect from next year, following criticism that such ads violated administrative neutrality.

The issue stems from a Threads post last week, in which a user shared photos of a campaign poster for Kuomintang (KMT) Yunlin County magistrate candidate Chang Chia-chun (張嘉郡) displayed next to ticket gates at Douliu Railway Station.

The user noted that TR prohibits the rental of station facilities for "political activities" such as campaign rallies. They argued that the ban likely also applied to political advertising, but was not being enforced.

In a statement on Monday, Taiwan Railway said that according to interpretations by the Central Election Commission and Ministry of Civil Service, advertising spaces at TR stations leased to third parties are considered commercial leases, and do not violate administrative neutrality regulations.

A caricature of ruling Democratic Progressive Party's Keelung mayoral candidate Tong Tzu-wei is displayed inside the Keelung Station on Monday. Photo courtesy of a local reader for illustrative purposes

The railway added that it exercised oversight by requiring the fair treatment of candidates from all political parties, and limits the size of such advertisements.

However, "out of consideration for public perception and a commitment to administrative neutrality," the company said, it had decided to discontinue political and election-related ad space rentals in its stations from Jan. 1, 2027.

Political advertisements already posted will not be affected by new policy, it added.

Taiwan's 2026 local elections will be held on Nov. 28.

(By Yu Hsiao-han and Matthew Mazzetta)

# Wipe Away Su Lee's Tears from her Composing Nights

Dear friends, music lovers, and new music supporters,It’s me, Su Lee, and I am currently working on my dissertation concert (for my Ph.D. in composition) which will be held on Sept. 9th 2019 Monday at 7:30pm in Lippes Concert Hall in Slee Hall at University at Buffalo.The title of my dissertation composition and concert is Die Radikalen Tasten (The Radical Keys) in terms of aesthetics, Klang (sound), and theme.I am writing a concerto for organ with keyboard ensemble, namely for our own tremendous Fisk Op.95 organ at UB. It will involve organ soloist with 1 assistant, 2 pianos (1 quarter-tone flat piano), 2 harpsichords (1 quarter-tone flat harpsichord), and 2 vibraphones which is a very rare instrumentation for microtonal new music. The 1st half of the program features significant keyboard works from the 20th century such as Messiaen's solo organ work and Ives's quarter-tone piano pieces. As a special request from Dr. Fuller, who was in charge of the installation of the Fisk Op.95 organ at UB, I'm playing my very first organ transcription of Wagner's orchestral work.The 2nd half of the program features my own 'radical' politically inspired compositions including a choral piece with organ accompaniment (dedicated to the UUCB Choir family) and my dissertation organ concerto. Both works are based on the Korean Democratic Uprising in May 1980 and the protest song written for the victims of the subsequent Gwangju massacre - a song that has became widely popular for activists and protesters, including those participating in the on-going Hong Kong protests.Overall, it is a very colorful and unique combination and a rare program which is a you-don’t-want-to-miss concert.I am modestly asking you for a little or big help in making my dissertation concert happen smoothly, especially given my financial struggles in not being able to even work legally for money off campus in America due to my visa status.Your generous donation will be spent towards, (besides helping me wipe away all my tears and whining from composing numerous nights over the past few months and rehearsing in the upcoming days and nights):Nine Musicians’ Performance Fee, about $3,000 – 3,300Rent/Labor for Lippes Concert Hall in Slee Hall, about $1,000Other concert related costs; buying performing materials, copying/binding score/parts, printing poster/program book, audio/video recording, photographing, tuning, reception, etc. about $1,200 – 1,500In Total $5,200 – 5,800Fortunately, I got awarded the MDRF (research fund) for $3,000 at UB so that I can be reimbursed afterwards, but I need money upfront now to pay first, and possibly more, to pay my dream team musicians fairly and to cover other costs.Your genuine help means SO MUCH to me being an international Ph.D. student with many restrictions on earning money (3 months summer break without job, seriously!), as it will lighten my financial burdens and psychological anxiety when I absolutely need to focus more on my creative activities. Simply speaking, you are contributing to a potentially "fabulous" new music piece, stimulating my further musical activities and making me believe that life (and the world) is so beautiful!Every single one of your names will be acknowledged in my concert program book, and to thank you all, but not nearly enough, I like to give you in return as below:$1~$49: a thank-you-card with a cover of a handwritten excerpt of my score$50~$99: a thank-you-card like above AND a dvd of my dissertation concert (after my concert)$100~$199: a thank-you-card AND a dvd like above, PLUS the autographed full score of my dissertation composition$200~$299: EVERYTHING above AND one additional dvd of my Masters organ recitals (your choice of “Über den Namen B-A-C-H” or “Celebrating Lou Harrison’s 100th Birth-Year at Thunder Night”)$300 or more: EVERYTHING above, PLUS a gift pack of Korean snacks/sweets/tea etc.Please write me an email with your home address!I am really excited to prepare my dissertation concert. Though I feel like this is sadly going to be my last self designed concert during my time in Buffalo (at UB), so I cannot wait to see many of you there!Thank you so much for reading this and considering your donation. I promise to pay you back with my "fabulous" new compositions and my performance, with the great help of my dream team of musician fellows!Please feel free to spread the link to your social pages like Facebook, Instagram, or Twitter, or to emails, to help get the word out! FYI, I am collecting your donations from now till October and GoFundMe takes 2.9% for transaction fee plus $0.30 PER Donation. Or you can donate by sending me a check to my place (email me for asking my address please!)Fondly,Su Lee

title: China moves to tighten controls on AI exports, citing national security risks
summary: Key takeaways 1. China proposed export controls on 40 advanced technologies, including 23 tied to artificial intelligence. 2. The draft covers major AI models, AI agents, and large computer systems used to train AI. 3. Foreign users could s
content:
Key takeaways

1.    China proposed export controls on 40 advanced technologies, including 23 tied to artificial intelligence.
2.    The draft covers major AI models, AI agents, and large computer systems used to train AI.
3.    Foreign users could still access Chinese AI services through websites, apps, and online software platforms.
4.    Open-source tools and public research would generally stay outside the proposed restrictions.

Key Takeaways by [nexos.ai](https://nexos.ai/), reviewed by Cybernews staff.

**China is weighing new export controls on its advanced technology, including AI, potentially expanding restrictions to 40 technologies amid intensifying competition with the US.**

On October 16th, China's Ministry of Commerce and Ministry of Science and Technology published a draft document proposing to ban or restrict exports of 40 technologies spanning solar power, AI, chip design, and biomedicine. Of these, 23 are AI-related, including advanced large language models, AI agents, and computing clusters.

Under the proposal, China would control exports of AI models containing restricted technologies, but access through application programming interfaces (APIs), websites, apps, and software-as-a-service platforms would be exempt from the restrictions.

This would let people abroad keep using Chinese AI services from companies like DeepSeek even with the new rules in place.

[![Image 1: elon muskss face with black hat, looking up with blurry flads in the back](https://media.cybernews.com/images/thumbnail/2025/06/elon_musk_blurry_flags.jpg)](https://cybernews.com/ai-news/musk-ai-and-robots-us-debt-fix/)

[![Image 2: Robot hands on a keyboard](https://media.cybernews.com/images/thumbnail/2026/01/robot_hands_keyboard_ai.jpg)](https://cybernews.com/ai-news/rogue-ai-agents-hacked-into-indian-companies/)

[![Image 3: jenna-ortega-marrakech](https://media.cybernews.com/images/thumbnail/2025/12/jenna-ortega.jpg)](https://cybernews.com/ai-news/jenna-ortega-deepfake-tiktok/)

[![Image 4: Arthur Mensch, founder of Mistral AI, at the World Economic Forum in Davos](https://media.cybernews.com/images/thumbnail/2026/05/arthur-mensch-vassal.jpg)](https://cybernews.com/ai-news/mistral-europe-surrender/)

[![Image 5: Accenture](https://media.cybernews.com/images/thumbnail/2024/06/Shutterstock_2419193795.jpg)](https://cybernews.com/ai-news/accenture-ai-spending-limits/)

[![Image 6: Voice actor Masako Nozawa alongside Dragon Ball character Goku.](https://media.cybernews.com/images/thumbnail/2026/10/masako-nozawa-goku.jpg)](https://cybernews.com/ai-news/dragon-ball-goku-ai-voice-clone/)

Covered exports [would include](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-10-16/china-proposes-export-controls-on-ai-models-chips-and-agents) technology for AI models with at least 2 trillion parameters, such as Kimi K3 and Alibaba's Qwen3.8-Max, as well as models ranking among the world's top 10 in performance, usage, or safety.

AI models trained on China’s “core data”, defined as “data concerning national security, the lifeline of the national economy, key public livelihoods, and major public interests”, would also be banned from export. The proposal also covers 12 solar power-related technologies, as well as five biomedicine technologies.

However, open-source technologies and research already in the public domain would generally be excluded from the restrictions.

A spokesperson for the Commerce Ministry said the export rules are aimed at ensuring “the safety and controllability” of AI technology, [adding](https://www.mofcom.gov.cn/zcfb/dwmygl/art/2026/art_61446ab4beee4f63973d4d0ab3097648.html):

“The Chinese government’s necessary management of these technologies aims to solidify the security baseline, prevent misuse and abuse, ensure that AI remains under human control, and promote international governance of AI.”

In September 2026, the US and China made progress towards establishing a formal dialogue on AI risks following talks between Donald Trump and Xi Jinping in Washington. Another round of AI-related discussions is planned for November.

At the same time, the US has restricted China's access to advanced semiconductor technology, and China now appears to be tightening its own controls on exports of advanced AI tech.

China has already imposed a temporary registration requirement for companies to register exports of the technologies covered by the proposal. The measure took effect on Friday.

title: Tshwane needs better freight rail to become SA’s automotive capital
summary: There was a blue, oval-shaped void on the show floor at SA Auto Week 2026 in Durban this week. Ford Motor Company Africa’s president, Neale Hill, was on the speakers’ list, but it had no representation as a brand with a stand. Into this vac
content:
There was a blue, oval-shaped void on the show floor at SA Auto Week 2026 in Durban this week. Ford Motor Company Africa’s president, Neale Hill, was on the speakers’ list, but it had no representation as a brand with a stand.

Into this vacuum stepped Chery, latest tenant of the Nissan factory in Rosslyn, Pretoria, and its neighbour in the not-so-special automotive economic zone, BMW.

The Eastern Cape can say what it wants, but Gauteng hosts 200 automotive component firms alongside major assembly plants, and generates 34.4% of South Africa’s total GDP. And Pretoria serves as the country’s central hub for automotive research, development and technical skills, making a powerful case for it serving as the strategic inland platform for vehicle assembly and export into broader African markets.

Tony Liu, chief executive of Chery SA, says that as a new investor coming to the country, the company is in it for the long run. “We are here in South Africa for the people and are also becoming a South African citizen. So, we are part of the economy, part of this country’s economic development.”

But there are barriers that all businesses and even citizens fully understand, and Liu knows he will have to grapple with them. “Infrastructure-cost competitiveness, including water and electricity – those are basic things. Logistics cost – that is also going to be adding a lot of weight onto our competitiveness across Africa and even globally,” he tells Daily Maverick.

BMW’s Rosslyn plant exports most of its production volume. Operating far inland from coastal export ports creates structural logistics vulnerabilities that require reliable rail infrastructure and stable municipal grid connections.

“It’s the wrong place, to be honest, because we export 96% of our volume… So that’s always been an issue, and our biggest challenges have been logistics,” admits Peter van Binsbergen, chairperson and chief executive of BMW Group SA.

### The Transnet curse

One of the benefits of moving into Rosslyn is that a railway line runs by it, but this has not always been the benefit it should have been.

“We’ve had a lot of logistics challenges in the time when Transnet was shaky,” says Van Binsbergen. “Post-Covid, when railway lines and power cables were being stolen, we had a lot of problems getting our cars and our parts in and out of Rosslyn. So we even brought in containers via Mozambique and things like that.

“We have a rail line that comes right to our siding at the vehicle distribution centre, but that rail line has just been notoriously unstable.”

Chery SA chief executive Tony Liu. (Photo: Supplied / Chery South Africa)

So, Daily Maverick was not surprised to spot both Van Binsbergen and Liu in conversation with Transnet group CEO Michelle Phillips on day two of the conference.

“We managed to clear up ... as the motor industry meeting with Transnet that we want to actually put more on rail instead of on trucks,” the BMW chief disclosed. “Trucks are not our wish… But you need to balance your line so that it’s full going down to the port and full coming back. Having Chery in Rosslyn might, or will, give us a bit more muscle to balance that line a bit better.”

### Special zone, special treatment

One Pretoria carmaker that also has a railway line running right by it, Ford, was actually promised improved logistics when it sank R15-billion into Silverton.

“There has been progress in the broader rail reform process, including the rail access framework and onboarding of private operators, as well as some progress at ports,” Ford wrote in reply to questions. “However, rail is one part of an interconnected logistics value chain, and the entire ecosystem needs to operate in unison.

“For Ford, the key issue is how this translates into reliable, commercially viable services that support automotive manufacturing and exports.

“This requires a rail system that runs on time, has suitable rolling stock, and provides dependable connections between manufacturing hubs and ports so that incoming goods and export vehicles reach their destinations on schedule, and support our wider business operations.

Neale Hill, president of Ford Motor Company in Africa, at a function on 10 April 2024 when the Nelson Mandela Foundation recognised the company as a Legacy Champion, the highest tier of donors to the foundation. (Photo: Supplied)

“Access agreements and reform milestones are important, but the real measure will be dependable operational services across the logistics chain.”

Ford’s castle is in the heart of the Tshwane Automotive Special Economic Zone (Tasez), an empire that spans 162.6ha in Silverton and holds pride of place as Africa’s first automotive city. It is backed by direct funding and a multi-
tiered government partnership between the De­­partment of Trade, Industry and Com­petition, the Gauteng provincial gov­­ernment and the City of Tshwane.

As part of the privilege of re­­ceiving Cyril Rama­phosa’s blessing during his 2019 presidential campaign, the Tasez has been integrated into a VIP energy grid to protect tenants against municipal power interruptions, alongside dedicated rail sidings connecting Rosslyn and Silverton factories straight to export ports.

### Break in the chain

Transnet’s CEO has actively engaged with automotive leaders during industry forums to build collaboration channels between the state-owned logistics provider and primary vehicle manufacturers.

“We will talk to the automotive industry about how best we can support them going forward, both on port and rail, and engage with them on collaboration initiatives and how they can support us to make sure that we do what is required for the industry,” Phillips told Daily Maverick after her conversation with Liu.

Transnet group CEO Michelle Phillips at the Africa Rail Expo that was held at the Sandton Convention Centre on 7 July 2026 in Johannesburg. (File photo: Fani Mahuntsi / Gallo Images)

“We are in this business because we know that it’s difficult, actually, and that there are problems to be solved. I think in the logistics space, if you don’t have a problem, then you have a problem... Look, we are trying hard together with the teams to support the industry as much as we can.”

To be fair to Transnet, it is on the right track to reform in two important ways. First, manufacturers acknowledge a marked improvement in Transnet’s willingness to communicate openly, resolving misunderstandings regarding rail usage versus road freighting.

And second, Phillips’s engagement with Rosslyn manufacturers on bi-directional corridor efficiency addresses line balancing – using inbound trains for imported components or vehicles and outbound trains for export vehicles – and has seemingly set clear objectives.

However, there is still an execution gap. Although leadership dialogue is welcomed, manufacturer evaluations – particularly from Ford – still show that reform milestones, access frameworks and private sector onboarding must rapidly translate into on-time rail schedules, sufficient rolling stock and seamless port handling to protect manufacturing competitiveness.

Van Binsbergen reveals a possible policy direction that could salvage the ailing industry. “If we really want to get economies of scale, we’ve got to actually agree that [we need to] specialise in South Africa … in wiring harnesses, car glass, tyres,” he suggests.

“And then we have to be able to talk to each other without breaking competition law to say, ‘Okay guys, these are the topics we’re going to focus on. We’re going to give enough ­volume to the producer so they can get their economies of scale in place and we can develop like pools of competence.’ ”

There must be something in the water on the west side of Tshwane because Liu was singing a similar tune of collaboration and united industrial action. Now, if only that message can spread. **DM**

title: Chiang touts first-term results; Shen denies cash gift rumors - Focus Taiwan
zh_title: 蒋宣扬第一任期的成果；沉否认送礼传闻 - 聚焦台湾
summary: 中新社台北10月18日电 台北市市长蒋万安周日宣扬其政府的成就，而他的民进党竞争对手沈伯洋则承诺，如果在即将到来的市长竞选中当选，将保留台北市给老年人的礼金，有传言称他可能会废除这一政策。正在寻求连任国民党候选人的蒋介石在其松山区支持者协会的成立仪式上发表讲话时表示，自 2022 年 12 月上任以来，他通过改善交通基础设施、加强医疗保健服务和
content:
中新社台北10月18日电 台北市市长蒋万安周日宣扬其政府的成就，而他的民进党竞争对手沈伯洋则承诺，如果在即将到来的市长竞选中当选，将保留台北市给老年人的礼金，有传言称他可能会废除这一政策。

正在寻求连任国民党候选人的蒋介石在松山区支持者协会的成立仪式上发表讲话时表示，自 2022 年 12 月上任以来，他通过升级交通基础设施、加强医疗保健服务和吸引更多游客来促进当地商业发展，改善了松山区的状况。

他还表示，他最近宣布的降低城市更新计划资格门槛的政策将促进松山和台北各地老化建筑的重建。

蒋介石强调了他第一个任期内的关键儿童保育举措，包括将台北的儿童保育中心数量从上任前的四个增加到 45 个。他敦促选民再给他四年任期，以保持这座城市向前发展。

与此同时，周日晚上，沉在松山区和信义区举行了竞选车队，随后在民权公园举行了集会。

车队出发前，沉在信义区五分埔公园接受记者采访时表示，网上有传言称，如果他当选市长，他将取消台北市政府给老年人的礼金，这是不实的谣言。
这些礼物是在重阳节分发的，这是一个尊敬老人的传统节日。

沉表示，他会保留这些款项，但会努力让它们“更有意义、更有趣”。他引用其他国家的做法，建议在领取礼金时邀请长辈为年轻一代录制留言。

45 岁的台北居民 Sharlene Weng 是一名在五分埔公园参加活动的人，她在科技行业工作。她告诉中央社，她特别喜欢沉先生开发北投士林科技园的方法。

翁赞扬了沉对部分地下变电站为科技园供电的支持，称它可以比完全地下设施以更低的成本提供稳定的电力，同时纳入公共设施，例如为当地居民提供公园。

台湾定于11月28日举行的2026年地方选举也被称为“九合一”选举，因为该国22个市县的选民将选出九种地方政府职位的官员，包括市长、县长、市县议员。

其他竞选职位包括乡镇长、直辖市原住民区长、乡镇和原住民区议员、区长和村长。

此次选举总共将填补地方政府各级职位11,051个。

（叶志雄、黎阳）

Enditem/sfj

【原文 English Original】
Taipei, Oct. 18 (CNA) Taipei Mayor Chiang Wan-an (蔣萬安) touted his administration's achievements on Sunday, while his Democratic Progressive Party rival, Puma Shen (沈伯洋), pledged to keep the city's cash gifts for senior citizens if elected in the upcoming mayoral race, amid rumors he might scrap the policy.

Speaking at the launch of his supporters' association in Songshan District, Chiang, who is seeking reelection as the Kuomintang candidate, said he had improved the district since taking office in December 2022 by upgrading transportation infrastructure, strengthening health care services and attracting more tourists to boost local businesses.

He also said his recently announced policy to lower the eligibility threshold for the city's urban renewal program would facilitate the redevelopment of aging buildings in Songshan and across Taipei.

Chiang highlighted key childcare initiatives from his first term, including increasing the number of childcare centers in Taipei from four before he took office to 45. He urged voters to give him another four-year term to keep the city moving forward.

Meanwhile, Shen held a campaign motorcade in Songshan and Xinyi districts on Sunday evening, followed by a rally at Minquan Park.

Speaking to reporters at Wufenpu Park in Xinyi District before the motorcade set off, Shen dismissed as false online rumors that he would cancel the Taipei City government's cash gifts for senior citizens if elected mayor.

The gifts are distributed for the Double Ninth Festival, a traditional holiday honoring the elderly.

Shen said he would keep the payments but seek to make them "more meaningful and interesting." Citing practices in other countries, he suggested inviting seniors to record messages for younger generations when collecting the cash gifts.

Among those attending the event at Wufenpu Park was Sharlene Weng, a 45-year-old Taipei resident who works in the technology sector. She told CNA she particularly liked Shen's approach to developing the Beitou-Shilin Technology Park.

Weng praised Shen's support for a partially underground substation to supply electricity to the technology park, saying it could provide stable power at a lower cost than a fully underground facility while incorporating public amenities, such as a park for local residents.

Taiwan's 2026 local elections, scheduled for Nov. 28, are also known as the "9-in-1" elections because voters in the country's 22 cities and counties will elect officials to nine types of local government posts, including city mayors, county magistrates, and city and county councilors.

Other positions up for election include township chiefs, chiefs of Indigenous districts in special municipalities, township and Indigenous district councilors, and borough and village chiefs.

In all, the elections will fill 11,051 posts at all levels of local government.

(By Joseph Yeh and Sunny Lai)

title: Hong Kong leader hails Girl Guides carnival as 110th anniversary events roll on
zh_title: 香港领导人赞扬女童军嘉年华，庆祝 110 周年活动如火如荼地进行
summary: 香港 在西九龙为期两天的“Chill Fun WestK嘉年华”开幕式上，文化体育及旅游局局长赞扬女童军总会110年的传承。该活动有 4,000 名会员、主题区和即将举行的活动，包括 12 月的国际营。 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 主编 [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 2026 年 10 月 18 日香港时间 15:25 · 2 分钟阅读文化、体育及旅游，杨子豪先生，10月2日18日
content:
香港
在西九龙为期两天的“Chill Fun WestK嘉年华”开幕式上，文化体育及旅游局局长赞扬女童军总会110年的传承。该活动有 4,000 名会员、主题区和即将举行的活动，包括 12 月的国际营。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

香港时间 2026 年 10 月 18 日 15:25 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

文化体育及旅游局局长杨润雄于2026年10月18日出席香港女童军总会举办的为期两天的「Chill Fun WestK嘉年华」开幕礼，庆祝该会成立110周年。杨先生在WestK艺术公园发表讲话时指出，该场地融合了自然景观、海港景观和文化氛围，称其为此次活动的“城市绿洲”。

嘉年华汇聚了近 4,000 名女童军和青年制服团体成员，以及许多公众游客。场地分为三个主题区：尝试新兴运动的冒险区、以舞台表演为特色的休闲区以及提供文化活动的艺术区。游戏摊位介绍香港各区的特色，旨在让参与者与城市建立联系。
杨先生感谢协会领导和会员的努力，并赞扬女孩们在组织活动、经营摊位和表演方面的能力。他赞同该协会主席梁贝蒂女士强调新时代女性的“非凡”才能。

国务卿还概述了周年纪念计划中即将举行的活动。 7月至8月举办暑期三峡交流游，让导游领略三峡自然风光和文化遗产。协会将于12月下旬在启德青年旅舍举办“宇宙之灵·女性之旅”国际营，参与者将探讨香港的怀旧游戏、非物质文化遗产和全球问题。

杨先生表示，这些活动将教育与体验结合起来，帮助年轻人了解国家发展、拓宽国际视野。他表示，这符合香港作为中外文化交流枢纽的地位、国家“十五五”规划青年发展战略和香港第一个五年规划目标。

杨先生将女童军描述为香港最大的女性青少年制服团体，并赞扬其 110 年来培养负责任领导人的记录。他感谢协会为社区带来欢乐，为城市带来活力，预祝嘉年华圆满成功，同时鼓励年轻人继续服务社会。
[![图片3：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

主编

负责 CLB.org.hk 报道和编辑标准的主编。

【原文 English Original】
Hong Kong
At the opening of the two-day 'Chill Fun WestK Carnival' in West Kowloon, the Secretary for Culture, Sports and Tourism praised the Girl Guides Association's 110-year legacy. The event features 4,000 members, themed zones, and upcoming activities including an international camp in December.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

18 Oct 2026 at 15:25 HKT · 2 min read

The Secretary for Culture, Sports and Tourism, Mr. Kevin Yeung, on 18 October 2026 attended the opening ceremony of the two-day "Chill Fun WestK Carnival" organised by the Hong Kong Girl Guides Association, marking the association's 110th anniversary. Speaking at the WestK Art Park, Mr. Yeung noted the venue's combination of natural landscape, harbour views and cultural atmosphere, calling it a fitting "urban oasis" for the event.

The carnival brings together nearly 4,000 Girl Guides and members of youth uniformed groups, along with many public visitors. The grounds are divided into three themed zones: an adventure zone for trying emerging sports, a chill zone featuring stage performances, and an arts zone offering cultural activities. Game booths introduce the distinctive features of various Hong Kong districts, aiming to connect participants with the city.

Mr. Yeung thanked the association's leaders and members for their efforts, praising the girls for their skills in organising activities, running booths and performing. He echoed the association's president, Mrs. Betty Leong, in highlighting the "extraordinary" talents of women in the new era.

The Secretary also outlined upcoming events in the anniversary programme. A summer exchange trip to the Three Gorges was held from July to August, allowing Guides to appreciate the country's natural scenery and cultural heritage. In late December, the association will host the "Spirit of the Universe · Women's Journey" international camp at the Kai Tak Youth Hostel, where participants will explore Hong Kong's nostalgic games, intangible cultural heritage and global issues.

Mr. Yeung said these activities combine education with experience, helping young people understand national development and broaden their international outlook. He said they align with Hong Kong's role as a hub for Chinese and foreign cultural exchange, the national 15th Five-Year Plan's youth development strategy, and the city's first five-year plan goals.

Describing the Girl Guides as Hong Kong's largest female youth uniformed group, Mr. Yeung praised its 110-year record of nurturing responsible leaders. He thanked the association for bringing joy to the community and vitality to the city, and wished the carnival success while encouraging young people to continue serving society.

特朗普说：“整件事是一种耻辱，因为如果可能的话，我希望实现无核化。” “我们实际上正在与俄罗斯讨论这一问题，我们正在与中国讨论无核化问题。”
他指出，中国似乎不愿意解除武装，但表示谈判仍在继续。据 Newsmax 报道，特朗普与中国国家主席习近平就此事进行了交谈，但没有透露有关与俄罗斯或中国会谈的更多细节。

（半岛电视台）

根据斯德哥尔摩国际和平研究所 (SIPRI) 的数据，俄罗斯拥有世界上最大的[核弹头]库存(https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/6/8/nuclear-risks-rise-as-powers-expand-and-modernise-arsenals-study-finds)，美国紧随其后。

据估计，两国拥有全球核武器总数的 86%。

据 SIPRI 称，中国拥有第三大核武库，去年已将其核弹头数量扩大至 620 枚。

特朗普的主张是在《削减战略武器条约》到期后不久提出的，该条约是美国和俄罗斯之间旨在限制其核武库的军备控制协议。

该条约到期一个月后，法国总统马克龙宣布了“前沿威慑倡议”，因为俄罗斯在乌克兰战争期间的核武力威胁令欧洲感到恐慌。

根据您的兴趣获取即时警报和更新。成为第一个知道重大事件发生的人。

澳大利亚前外交部长加雷斯·埃文斯告诉半岛电视台，世界对核武器风险的兴趣已经减弱。
他说：“世界……对核战争的风险已经变得令人震惊地自满，每一项主要的核军控协议都已失效、垂死或处于生命维持状态，而长期存在的禁止威胁或使用核武器的禁忌也逐渐消失。”

# Warm weather to persist across Taiwan through Saturday: CWA

10/16/2026 11:08 AM

CNA file photo

Taipei, Oct. 16 (CNA) Mostly cloudy to sunny skies and warm weather are forecast across Taiwan on Friday and Saturday, although brief showers are possible in northern and northeastern Taiwan on Friday, according to the Central Weather Administration (CWA).

Daytime highs are forecast to reach 29-31 degrees Celsius in Keelung and the eastern half of Taiwan and 31-34 degrees elsewhere, the CWA said.

Showers are possible along the coast of Keelung City and in Yilan County in northeastern Taiwan and Hualien County in the east on Friday, the agency forecast.

Independent meteorologist Wu Der-rong (吳德榮) said daytime temperatures would remain relatively high, a pattern known locally as an "autumn tiger," or a lingering fall heat wave.

Some parts of Taiwan could see highs of up to 35 degrees Celsius, Wu predicted.

Partly cloudy skies with occasional brief showers can be expected in the eastern half of Taiwan through Oct. 20, while mostly sunny and stable weather is likely for other parts of the island during that time, he said.

Based on the latest forecasting models, Wu said northeasterly winds would strengthen on Oct. 21, bringing rain and lower temperatures across parts of Taiwan.

CWA graphic

As for Tropical Storm Champi, Wu said the latest CWA forecast showed the storm east of Guam and moving in a west-northwesterly direction.

The latest European model simulations suggest Champi could make a large turn northeast over waters south of Japan in the coming days, he said, but noted that its path remained uncertain.

(By Huang Chiao-wen and Ko Lin)

# TSMC evaluating Texas production, cooperation with Terafab

10/15/2026 07:51 PM

[](jsvscript:)[](jsvscript:)[](javascript:void(0))[Listen](javascript:)

[Link](javascript:)[Whatsapp](javascript:)[Reddit](javascript:)[Line](javascript:)[Email](javascript:)

To activate the text-to-speech service, please first agree to the privacy policy below.

A TSMC fab in Arizona. CNA file photo

Taipei, Oct. 15 (CNA) C. C. Wei (魏哲家), Chairman and CEO of Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. (TSMC), said Thursday that the chipmaker is evaluating the possibility of collaborating with Elon Musk's Terafab project in Texas.

Speaking at an investor conference, Wei said that while cooperation with Terafab was possible, any fab should be run by TSMC to control production.

[●TSMC raises 2026 sales growth forecast to 44%, leaves capex unchanged](https://focustaiwan.tw/business/202610150018)

He emphasized that the possible cooperation with the Terafab project was at the discussion stage.

Wei's remarks came after Musk said on social media that it was possible TSMC could sublease part of Terafab "but nothing more than that."

Wei said TSMC is working hard to expand its capacity in the United States and the expansion is necessary as its major American clients have asked the chipmaker to raise production to meet their demand. He added that the U.S. government has provided necessary assistance to TSMC for expansion.

He added that on the back of strong demand for smartphones, high-performance computing devices and artificial intelligence applications, TSMC's production capacity using its latest-generation 2-nanometer process will more than double from a year earlier in 2027.

CNA graph

Meanwhile, Wei said TSMC is developing the A14 process and trial production is slated for 2027 before mass production is scheduled to begin in 2028.

Compared with the 2nm process, the A14 process is expected to offer a 10-15 percent speed improvement at the same power, or a 25-30 percent power reduction at the same speed, while the new process is expected to boost logic density by almost 20 percent, according to TSMC.

According to Wei, nearly 20 fab projects worldwide are currently underway, including three new 3nm fabs.

In Taiwan, a 3nm fab in Tainan is expected to begin mass production in the first half of 2027, while another 3nm fab is also planned in Tainan and will start commercial production in the first half of 2028, Wei said.

In Arizona, a second fab using the 2nm process will start mass production in the third quarter of 2027, he added.

(By Chang Chien-chung and Frances Huang)

# Army to open Chengkungling base to public Oct. 24

Chengkungling military base in Taichung. CNA file photo

Taipei, Oct. 15 (CNA) The Army will open its Chengkungling base to the public on Oct. 24, showcasing new equipment including M1A2T tanks and HIMARS rocket systems, while offering rides in eight-wheeled armored vehicles and other hands-on military experiences, the Ministry of National Defense (MND) said Thursday.

The event, part of the military's efforts to promote public understanding of national defense, will run from 8 a.m. to 3 p.m. and is free, said Maj. Gen. Wang Chun-chin (王俊欽), chief of staff of the 10th Army Corps, at an MND press briefing.

Visitors are required to bring a photo ID for identity checks. Foreign spouses must be accompanied by their Taiwanese spouses, while foreign caregivers must be accompanied by their care recipient, and present valid documents, Wang said.

The static display will feature 24 types of ground equipment, including M1A2T tanks and HIMARS systems, as well as the Navy's mobile missile launchers and the Air Force's Patriot and Tien Kung air defense missile systems.

The program will also include an aerial formation by AH-1W Cobra helicopters, fast-rope descents from UH-60M Black Hawk helicopters, helicopter-borne assault demonstrations using CH-47SD helicopters, drone displays, mixed martial arts demonstrations and a precision parachute landing by the Army's Shen Long parachute team.

Visitors can also ride in eight-wheeled armored vehicles and try pulling the firing mechanism of a towed 155mm howitzer. Other activities include military recruitment booths, civil defense education, air rifle shooting and a fair.

No private vehicles will be allowed inside the base, and traffic controls will be implemented on nearby roads. Free shuttle buses will run between the venue and designated stops at Chengkung Station, Xinwuri Station, Shuinan Transit Center, the Jingmao 6 free parking lot and Chengkung military supply station.

With the Nov. 28 local elections approaching, Wang reminded visitors that military events must remain politically neutral. Election-related clothing and the distribution or posting of campaign materials will be prohibited. Military officials said they would also urge visitors not to display campaign sashes worn as hair accessories or other ornaments.

(By Wu Su-wei and Sean Lin)

CTF Media & Entertainment (CTFME), formerly known as i-CABLE Communications, unveiled its new corporate logo on Thursday as it moves to expand its entertainment business and build an integrated media and entertainment ecosystem.

The company plans to invest in major overseas music and sporting events to tap into the fan economy, including merchandise sales beyond ticket revenue, it said. Its investment in the Korean edition of the electronic dance music festival EDC drew 100,000 attendees in early October, according to the company.

Locally, CTFME expects to open a live house at Kai Tak Sports Park by the end of this year to discover and nurture emerging Hong Kong musicians.

Chief executive and executive director Ivy Wong said the group also plans to venture into e-commerce and offer integrated marketing solutions.

The new logo combines the letters “M” and “E” for media and entertainment, reflecting the company’s “Screen-to-Experience” strategy to connect audiences through digital platforms and real-world experiences.

CTFME’s five business pillars are telecommunications, media, entertainment experiences, retail and e-commerce, and integrated marketing. Its businesses include i-CABLE’s broadband services and HOY’s television channels and OTT platform.

summary: 6 小时前 埃维岛和朱莉安娜·汗 新鸭绿江大桥全长 3 公里（1.9 英里），从中国边境城市丹东到朝鲜新义州 据中国官方媒体报道，随着邻国之间贸易关系的改善，一座拖延已久的连接中国和朝鲜的公路大桥已经开通。中国是朝鲜最大的贸易伙伴，也是应对国际社会因平壤核武器计划而实施严厉制裁的生命线。新鸭绿江大桥全长 3 公里（1.9 英里），从中国边境城市丹东到朝鲜新义州，将成为朝鲜的主要陆路通道。
content:
6 小时前

埃威岛和

朱莉安娜·汗

新鸭绿江大桥全长 3 公里（1.9 英里），从中国边境城市丹东到朝鲜新义州

据中国官方媒体报道，随着邻国之间的贸易关系改善，一座拖延已久的连接中国和朝鲜的公路大桥已经开通。

中国是朝鲜最大的贸易伙伴，也是应对国际社会因平壤核武器计划而实施严厉制裁的生命线。

新鸭绿江大桥全长3公里（1.9英里），从中国边境城市丹东到朝鲜新义州，将成为两国之间贸易的主要陆路通道。

该项目最初定于 2014 年启动，但由于与北京的关系变得冷淡，朝鲜停止了道路和海关设施的建设，因此被无限期推迟。

中国国务院总理李强在周四的视频讲话中表示，这座大桥是“象征中朝传统友谊的新地标”，两国关系正在“翻开新的篇章”。

新鸭绿江大桥是具有数十年历史的中朝友谊大桥的替代方案，该大桥建于 1937 年至 1943 年日本帝国占领该地区期间。

中国外交部发言人毛宁周三表示，这座新大桥是两国之间“互联互通的重要设施”，并补充说这条路线将“进一步便利贸易和人员往来”。
去年，双边贸易额达到 27 亿美元，标志着恢复到大流行前的水平，这主要是由中国对朝鲜的出口推动的。

韩国外国语大学中国研究教授康俊英告诉英国广播公司，由于联合国对朝鲜的制裁仍然有效，跨境贸易“不太可能”突然增加。

“平壤还对突然涌入的中国进口产品保持警惕，这将大大扩大中国对其国内市场的影响力，”他补充道。

“中国很清楚这些担忧，因此贸易更有可能逐步增长。”

北京和平壤是长期盟友，双方签署了共同防御条约，这是中国与任何国家签署的唯一条约。这种关系经常被形容为“唇齿相依”，这是中国前领导人毛泽东首先提出的一句话。

但联盟并非没有紧张。

2010年代的大部分时间里，由于北京对平壤核武器计划的耐心逐渐减弱，两国关系一直处于冷淡状态。金正恩于 2017 年进行了核试验，此后加大了对被禁弹道导弹的试验力度，所有这些都增加了美国的警惕性，并加强了其与韩国和日本的军事联盟。

中国的态度最近发生了转变。
牛津大学讲师爱德华·豪厄尔（Edward Howell）告诉英国广播公司（BBC）：“虽然仅仅十年前，北京还公开批评朝鲜核化，甚至呼吁平壤无核化，但现在中国对此几乎没有说什么。”

观察人士称，原因之一是朝鲜因乌克兰战争而与俄罗斯走得更近。

至少 2,300 名朝鲜士兵[据信已死亡](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/clypr5985ejo) 在乌克兰为俄罗斯作战。作为回报，俄罗斯向朝鲜提供石油，这违反了联合国的制裁。据估计，2024 年俄罗斯已向平壤输送了[超过 10 亿桶石油](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cjr4pr0gyyzo) 作为平壤武器和战略物资的付款。

Koh Ewe and

Julianna Khan

The New Yalu River Bridge spans 3km (1.9 miles) from the Chinese border city of Dandong to Sinuiju in North Korea

A long-delayed road bridge linking China and North Korea has opened, Chinese state media report, as trade ties improve between the neighbours.

China is North Korea's largest trading partner and a lifeline against heavy international sanctions over Pyongyang's nuclear weapons programme.

The New Yalu River Bridge spans 3km (1.9 miles) from the Chinese border city of Dandong to Sinuiju in North Korea, and is set to become the main land route for trade between them.

Its launch, initially slated for 2014, had been indefinitely postponed after North Korea halted construction of its roads and customs facilities, as relations with Beijing turned frosty.

Chinese Premier Li Qiang, in a video address on Thursday, said the bridge was a "new landmark symbolising the traditional friendship between China and North Korea", and that the two countries were "opening a new chapter" in bilateral ties.

The New Yalu River Bridge is an alternative to the decades-old Sino-Korean Friendship Bridge, which was built between 1937 and 1943 during Imperial Japan's occupation of the region.

The new bridge is an "important facility for connectivity" between the two countries, Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesperson Mao Ning said on Wednesday, adding that the route would "further facilitate trade and people-to-people exchanges".

Last year, bilateral trade reached $2.7bn, marking a recovery to pre-pandemic levels, mostly fuelled by Chinese exports to North Korea.

A sharp and sudden increase in trade across the border is "unlikely" as the UN sanctions on North Korea remain in effect, Kang Jun-young, a professor of Chinese studies at the Hankuk University of Foreign Studies, tells the BBC.

"Pyongyang is also wary of a sudden flood of Chinese imports that would greatly expand China's influence over its domestic market," he adds.

"China is well aware of these concerns, so trade is more likely to grow gradually."

Beijing and Pyongyang are long-standing allies with a mutual defence treaty, the only one that China has with any country. The relationship is often described "as close as lips and teeth", a remark first made by China's former leader Mao Zedong.

But the alliance is not without tension.

Ties were frosty for much of the 2010s as Beijing's patience over Pyongyang's nuclear weapons programme wore thin. Kim Jong Un conducted a nuclear test in 2017 and has since ramped up tests of banned ballistic missiles - all of which increased US wariness, and strengthened its military alliances with South Korea and Japan.

China's attitude has shifted more recently.

"Whilst only a decade ago, Beijing was overtly critical of North Korea's nuclearisation - and indeed calling for Pyongyang's denuclearisation - China is now saying little, if anything, to this effect," Edward Howell, a lecturer at the University of Oxford, tells the BBC.

Observers say one reason is that North Korea has grown closer to Russia because of the Ukraine war.

At least 2,300 North Korean soldiers are [believed to have died](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/clypr5985ejo) fighting for Russia in Ukraine. In return, Russia supplies North Korea with oil, in violation of UN sanctions. In 2024, Russia was estimated to have sent [more than a billion barrels of oil](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cjr4pr0gyyzo) as payment for Pyongyang's weapons and troops.

Last month, North Korea and Russia opened their first road bridge, which Russian state media said would allow the movement of up to 300 vehicles and more than 2,000 people every day.

So Beijing is believed to be trying to reassert its sway over Pyongyang by rekindling ties.

Air China resumed direct flights between Beijing and Pyongyang in March after a six-year hiatus triggered by the pandemic. The two countries [reopened passenger train services](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cdxz8v58xvyo) the same month.

Chinese President Xi Jinping's first state visit of this year, in June, was to Pyongyang, where he met North Korean leader Kim Jong Un.

"The opening of the New Yalu River Bridge demonstrates bilateral relations are improving and that Xi Jinping's June visit to North Korea was more than symbolic," says Leif-Eric Easley, a professor at Ewha University in Seoul.

"But the long delay, including North Korea's pandemic self-isolation and domestic socioeconomic crackdowns, shows what a difficult partner Pyongyang can be for Beijing."

# Taipei hospital highlights long-term medical work in Eswatini

King Mswati III (center) poses for a photo during his visit to Taipei Medical University Hospital on Thursday. photo courtesy of the Taipei Medical University Hospital Oct. 15, 2026

Taipei, Oct. 15 (CNA) The Taipei Medical University Hospital (TMUH) said Thursday it has been providing medical services in Eswatini since 2009, following a visit by King Mswati III to the hospital on Oct. 12.

In a news release, TMUH said Mswati was received by hospital superintendent Shih Chun-ming (施俊明).

Eswatini's absolute monarch arrived in Taiwan last week to attend the Republic of China's National Day celebrations.

Shih said the partnership has expanded from clinical care to medical personnel training and healthcare system development over the past 17 years, helping strengthen Eswatini's medical system.

Shih said TMUH had provided more than 50,000 person-visits of teaching and training services in Eswatini. Through long-term on-site services and the sharing of professional expertise, the hospital has also helped strengthen the country's healthcare capacity.

TMUH Vice Superintendent Wang Wei (王偉) said the hospital's TAIP-X smart healthcare platform has been introduced at Manzini Government Hospital in Eswatini, helping the hospital transition from paper-based operations to digital outpatient services and improve efficiency.

Wang said TMUH and the medical teams there have also established telemedicine services in pediatrics, hematology and oncology, endocrinology, rheumatology and immunology, nephrology, and dermatology.

Taiwanese specialists work with Eswatini resident physicians to provide real-time remote consultations, helping strengthen local specialist care and clinical skills, he added.

Looking ahead, Shih said TMUH will continue to expand medical cooperation with Eswatini by drawing on its clinical expertise and smart healthcare technologies, as well as through professional exchanges and personnel training, to help strengthen local healthcare capacity and raise the international profile of Taiwan's medical expertise.

(By Shen Pei-yao and Ko Lin)

title: Hong Kong police bust agarwood investment scam syndicate, arrest six
zh_title: 香港警方破获沉香投资诈骗集团，拘捕六人
summary: 香港警方捣毁了一个与沉香树投资诈骗有关的跨国犯罪集团，逮捕了六人，并扣押了与该计划有关的 1,400 万港元。大部分受害者为长者，损失介乎3万至190万港元。 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 2026 年 10 月 15 日 16:08 HKT · 2 分钟阅读香港警方捣毁了一个与沉香树投资骗局有关的跨国犯罪集团，
content:
香港
香港警方捣毁了一个与沉香树投资诈骗有关的跨国犯罪集团，逮捕了六人，并查获了与该计划有关的 1,400 万港元。大部分受害者为长者，损失介乎3万至190万港元。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

香港时间 2026 年 10 月 15 日 16:08 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

香港警方捣毁了一个与沉香树投资诈骗有关的跨国犯罪集团，逮捕了六人，并查获了与该计划有关的 1,400 万港元。受害者多为长者，每人损失介乎3万至190万港元。

被捕人士为两男四女，年龄介乎52至66岁，怀疑是负责招募投资者及推广投资计划的核心成员。他们面临包括通过欺骗手段获取财产等指控。警方正在调查每名嫌疑人的角色，并相信该犯罪团伙的主谋是持有外国护照的人。
商业罪案调查科总督察朱明伦表示，自上个月以来，警方已接获21名市民举报。受害者表示，自2017年起，他们参与了当地一家公司“好好集团”提供的投资计划。据称，该公司利用各种借口，逃避按照投资合同约定支付承诺的利息和返还本金。

该公司声称在全球设有办事处，并表示在马来西亚经营多个沉香树种植园，生产和销售装饰品和精油等产品。据称，该公司拥有强大的盈利能力，甚至还安排投资者参观种植园。

过去几年，该公司推出了至少四项投资计划，其中一项投资计划为投资者以1万港元购买一棵沉香树，每月保证回报300港元，三年后可全额偿还本金。去年，该公司推出了一项计划，允许投资者成为授权经销商，拥有推广公司产品的权利和责任，并保证25%的回报。该公司后来推出了自己的加密货币，声称可以将沉香树代币化，但自推出以来该货币已贬值超过 99%。

警方表示，该公司利用各种借口拖延投资者的提款请求，逃避还款义务。
[![图片3：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

主编

【原文 English Original】
Hong Kong
Hong Kong police have dismantled a transnational syndicate linked to agarwood tree investment fraud, arresting six people and seizing HK$14 million in connection with the scheme. Most victims were elderly, with losses ranging from HK$30,000 to HK$1.9 million.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

15 Oct 2026 at 16:08 HKT · 2 min read

Hong Kong police have dismantled a transnational criminal syndicate linked to an agarwood tree investment scam, arresting six people and seizing HK$14 million in connection with the scheme. The victims, mostly elderly, suffered losses ranging from HK$30,000 to HK$1.9 million each.

The arrested individuals, two men and four women aged 52 to 66, are suspected of being core members responsible for recruiting investors and promoting the investment plans. They face charges including obtaining property by deception. Police are investigating the role of each suspect and believe the syndicate's mastermind is a person holding a foreign passport.

Chief Inspector Chu Ming-lun of the Commercial Crime Bureau said police have received reports from 21 citizens since last month. The victims said they had participated in investment plans offered by a local company, "Good Good Group", since 2017. The company allegedly used various excuses to avoid paying promised interest and returning principal amounts as agreed in the investment contracts.

The company claimed to have offices worldwide and said it operated multiple agarwood tree plantations in Malaysia, producing and selling products such as ornaments and essential oils. It allegedly boasted strong profitability and even arranged for investors to visit the plantations.

Over the past few years, the company launched at least four investment plans, including one where investors could buy an agarwood tree for HK$10,000, with a guaranteed monthly return of HK$300 and full principal repayment after three years. Last year, it introduced a plan allowing investors to become licensed distributors, with the right and responsibility to promote the company's products, guaranteeing a 25 per cent return. The company later launched its own cryptocurrency, claiming to tokenise agarwood trees, but the currency has depreciated by more than 99 per cent since its launch.

Police said the company used various excuses to delay investors' withdrawal requests, evading repayment obligations.

title: 美前太平洋司令称中国灰色地带策略“空洞”，促台湾强化战时拒止能力
summary: 华盛顿 — 美国前国家情报总监、海军退役四星上将丹尼斯·布莱尔(Dennis Blair)星期三(10月14日)表示，中国在台湾周边持续进行海空演习及灰色地带行动，主要目的在于制造恐惧并迫使台湾作出政治让步。他称这种依赖台湾“不战而降”的策略是“空洞的”，台湾真正需要强化的是战时阻止解放军取得制海权和制空权的能力，同时防范中国将军事演习突然转为攻击行动。 曾任美军太平洋司令部司令的布莱尔当天通过视频，在台湾海洋委员会主办的“2026海线安全国际会议”上发表主题演讲。会议聚焦中
content:
华盛顿 —

美国前国家情报总监、海军退役四星上将丹尼斯·布莱尔(Dennis Blair)星期三(10月14日)表示，中国在台湾周边持续进行海空演习及灰色地带行动，主要目的在于制造恐惧并迫使台湾作出政治让步。他称这种依赖台湾“不战而降”的策略是“空洞的”，台湾真正需要强化的是战时阻止解放军取得制海权和制空权的能力，同时防范中国将军事演习突然转为攻击行动。

曾任美军太平洋司令部司令的布莱尔当天通过视频，在台湾海洋委员会主办的“2026海线安全国际会议”上发表主题演讲。会议聚焦中国灰色地带行动、海上封锁威胁及台湾的海线安全韧性。所谓灰色地带行动，一般是指低于公开武装冲突门槛、但旨在逐步改变现状或对对手施压的军事及准军事活动。

**“目标是恫吓台湾”**

布莱尔说，中国通过军机、军舰及其他政府船只在台湾周边活动，试图让台湾民众和领导人相信，由于中国拥有更大的体量和军事实力，北京最终吞并台湾是不可避免的。

“这场海空行动的总体目标就是恫吓--恫吓台湾民众及其领导人，”布莱尔说。“中国试图制造一种印象：仅凭它更大的体量和实力，就必然能够吞并台湾。”

他表示，北京希望借助这种压力促使台湾政府作出政治让步，并让国际社会逐渐接受中国所希望的结果。

“然而，中国的策略是空洞的，”他说。“因为它依赖台湾在没有真正被征服的情况下投降，依赖台湾作出让步。”

布莱尔认为，台湾能否抵御北京要求其放弃主权的压力，最终取决于台湾是否具备在战争中阻止中国取得海空控制权的能力，而不是取决于解放军在和平时期能够派出多少舰艇和军机。

“台湾抗拒中国要求其交出主权的能力，取决于它能否在战时阻止中国控制海域和空域，”他说。“这并不取决于中国在和平时期的行动。”

**以“陆战思维”处理海洋问题**

布莱尔用中世纪欧洲军队围城作为类比。他说，古代军队通常包围城市、挖掘壕沟并逐步接近城墙，迫使守城一方相信防线终将被突破，从而选择投降。

但他认为，这种围城思维不适用于台湾，因为台湾周围是海洋，中国的军机和舰艇在附近活动，并不等同于陆军实际占领了台湾管辖的土地或突破了台湾防线。

“中国目前的灰色地带策略不是由水兵设计的，而是由陆军设计的，”布莱尔说。“陆军并不了解海洋环境，而是以陆战概念看待问题。”

他表示，解放军舰艇和军机数量增加并更加靠近台湾，固然可能引发警觉，但距离台湾更近也可能使它们在战争爆发时更加容易遭到攻击。

“我知道，看到数量更多的解放军舰艇和军机比过去更靠近台湾，可能令人不安，”他说。“但对一名职业海军军官来说，它们越靠近台湾，一旦战争爆发，也就越容易被摧毁。”

这些看法是布莱尔个人的军事判断。其他美国和台湾安全专家警告，解放军频繁在台湾附近活动，也可能缩短台湾方面的预警时间、消耗其防务资源，并使外界更难判断北京何时会从演习转向实际军事行动。

**防范演习突然转为攻击**

布莱尔承认，台湾和其他海洋国家不能因此忽视中国的行动。解放军近年来在台湾周边演练导弹及空中攻击、海上封锁等军事行动，台湾必须防范北京利用演习部署发动突袭。

“从军事角度而言，台湾必须警惕中国可能从演习状态转为攻击行动，”他说。

布莱尔表示，每当中国举行大规模海空演习时，台湾都应提高整体战备水平，周边国家的武装力量也应加强警戒，以免措手不及。

他认为，关键问题并不是解放军在和平时期能够派出多少兵力，而是台湾能否在友好国家支持下，于战时击败或阻止承担攻击任务的解放军部队。

“如果台湾有信心依靠自身能力，并在朋友支持下击败中国的战时侵略，那么中国的灰色地带声明和行动，就只能产生经过媒体放大的表面恫吓效果，”他说。

**加强监控、执法和公共外交**

布莱尔建议台湾密切监视中国在周边海域的军方、海警、科考和民用船只活动，审慎配置执法资源，并运用无人系统、卫星、雷达和社交媒体等工具，及时向国内外公布相关活动。

他说，如果中国舰艇或飞机接近台湾领海或领空，应受到警告和伴随监视；如果实施发射武器、派遣突击队登陆，或侵害台湾民众和财产等敌对行为，则应受到制止，必要时可以使用武力。

布莱尔还呼吁台湾加强公共外交，用持续且具有新意的方式向国际社会说明中国行动的性质。

“台湾不能允许中国在国际公众认知中建立一个‘新常态’，”他说。最重要的是，台湾应强化并展示其军队和社会在战时反制中国海空攻击的能力。

布莱尔也肯定台湾近年来将“汉光演习”从以军方为主的演练，扩大为包含民防和全社会韧性的防卫演习。他认为，台湾展现保卫自身的决心和能力，有助于争取理念相近国家在危机发生时提供支持。

**中国扩大台湾东部海域活动**

布莱尔发表上述评论之际，中国军方、海警、科考船和其他公务船近年来持续扩大在台湾周边的活动。

路透社上星期援引台湾民营航空公司安捷航空(Apex Aviation)的监控报告说，该公司一架侦察机今年8月在台湾花莲海岸约50公里外，发现被台湾方面认定为中国海上民兵船的“闽福鼎渔07902”，与中国海警2502舰及“向阳红03号”科考船在同一区域活动。这是已知中国海上民兵船首次出现在台湾东部海域。相关船只当时均在台湾所称的“限制水域”以外。

台湾国防部指责中国以执法和科研为掩护扩大非冲突状态下的行动范围，试图制造拥有“事实管辖权”的假象。中国国台办和国防部没有回应路透社就这起事件提出的置评请求。

美国国务院随后对美国之音表示，中国在台湾以东的行动“深度破坏稳定”，只会加剧紧张局势。美国敦促北京停止对台湾施压，转而与台湾民选当局展开有意义的对话。

北京主张台湾是中国领土的一部分，并表示不排除使用武力实现统一。台湾政府拒绝北京的主权声索，强调台湾的未来只能由台湾人民决定。

title: Liberia: IMF Urges African Govts to Shield Vulnerable Citizens From Economic Shocks
summary: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) has urged African governments to strengthen measures to protect vulnerable citizens from economic shocks, warning that global uncertainties, energy supply disruptions and declining foreign aid could pla
content:
The International Monetary Fund (IMF) has urged African governments to strengthen measures to protect vulnerable citizens from economic shocks, warning that global uncertainties, energy supply disruptions and declining foreign aid could place additional pressure on households and economies across the continent.

Speaking during the IMF's annual meetings in Bangkok, Thailand, Zeine Zeidane, Director of the IMF's African Department, emphasized the need for governments to balance economic stability with targeted social protection, particularly as countries confront rising external pressures and uncertain global economic conditions.

Zeidane said economic reforms implemented in several African countries have helped strengthen macroeconomic stability, citing subsidy and exchange rate reforms in Ethiopia and Nigeria, as well as structural reforms in South Africa.

However, he cautioned that the resilience demonstrated by African economies should not be mistaken for immunity to further shocks.

According to him, countries have adapted to changes in global energy supplies through rerouting shipments, drawing down inventories and adjusting business operations. Nevertheless, he warned that renewed disruptions to energy supplies and other external developments could undermine these efforts.

The impact of global economic pressures also varies across countries. Some commodity-exporting economies have benefited from higher prices for oil, copper and gold, while countries with less resource-intensive economies are experiencing slower growth and widening external deficits.

Zeidane also highlighted the continued decline in bilateral aid, which the IMF projects will fall by another 12 percent this year following a steep reduction in the previous year. The decline could further constrain governments' ability to finance development programs and provide essential services.

He identified renewed energy supply disruptions, increased global risk aversion, a strong El Niño weather pattern, and continuing conflict and insecurity as potential risks to Africa's economic outlook.

Against this backdrop, the IMF official urged governments to prioritize targeted assistance for vulnerable households rather than adopt broad and costly interventions that could place additional pressure on public finances.

He pointed to measures such as school feeding programs and temporary price relief as possible ways to support households facing rising living costs. Such interventions, he stressed, should be transparently financed, carefully targeted, capped and time-bound to ensure that assistance reaches those who need it most without undermining fiscal stability.

The IMF also called on governments to protect essential public services and productive investment while pursuing policies that safeguard economic stability.

Get the latest in African news delivered straight to your inbox

For commodity-exporting countries benefiting from higher prices, the Fund emphasized the importance of saving part of the additional revenue and using available resources to repay expensive debt. This would help governments build financial buffers against future shocks rather than commit temporary windfalls to permanent spending.

Countries facing high import bills, meanwhile, may need to continue fiscal adjustment while protecting critical services and investments necessary for long-term development.

Zeidane further underscored the importance of exchange rate flexibility in countries whose monetary frameworks allow it, alongside stronger debt transparency and improved public debt management.

Beyond immediate economic challenges, the IMF urged African governments to pursue structural reforms capable of generating sustainable growth, attracting investment and creating employment opportunities.

Priority areas include improving electricity supply, expanding digital connectivity, strengthening workforce skills and establishing a more predictable business environment for businesses and investors.

The Fund said these reforms could help African economies close productivity gaps, improve competitiveness and strengthen their ability to withstand future external shocks.
