# [China-Linked Hackers Exploited BeyondTrust Zero-Day to Take Over Remote Support Servers](https://thehackernews.com/2026/10/china-linked-hackers-exploited.html)

__ Ravie Lakshmanan __ Oct 16, 2026 Zero-Day / Vulnerability

[![Image 7](https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEic5zD5GBvYxe93igsDOMdwS6eyfDORIWio42Z9UY0enK0XKWYcQlLB9RLx3iO_V1xm8vqBxMVZ_R8Lt-xxOumO5_RIFN3hgB-yZyGGlVMypRx5lm2GJq-1c9cbzfRcjrMAIfBI67L4QUI-MwjjQjKL1RcgPnzFdYuAF3k1y2Ev-ppSmiG8sdQ5dbJkbjKR/s1700-nu-rw-lo-l85-e365/beyond.jpg)](https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEic5zD5GBvYxe93igsDOMdwS6eyfDORIWio42Z9UY0enK0XKWYcQlLB9RLx3iO_V1xm8vqBxMVZ_R8Lt-xxOumO5_RIFN3hgB-yZyGGlVMypRx5lm2GJq-1c9cbzfRcjrMAIfBI67L4QUI-MwjjQjKL1RcgPnzFdYuAF3k1y2Ev-ppSmiG8sdQ5dbJkbjKR/s1700-nu-rw-lo-l85-e365/beyond.jpg)

The China-nexus cyber espionage group tracked as **Armory Castle** (previously UNC5221 or Warp Panda) exploited a newly disclosed security flaw in BeyondTrust Remote Support (formerly Bomgar) as a zero-day in late August 2026.

The vulnerability, tracked as **[CVE-2026-102764](https://www.beyondtrust.com/trust-center/security-advisories/bt26-05)** (CVSS score: 9.3), is a case of improper origin validation in an internal messaging component that could be exploited by a remote attacker to perform file operations on an affected appliance.

"The vulnerability exists within internal components of Remote Support," BeyondTrust said in a Thursday alert. "The components did not adequately validate the origin of the messages it received. Under the right conditions, this could be used to perform file operations on the appliance."

Patches for the flaw have been pushed to all Remote Support SaaS customers as of October 9, 2026. Self-hosted customers of Remote Support running versions from 24.3.1 through 26.2.3 are advised to manually update to BT26-05-RS patch. Customers running a version older than 24.3.1 will be required to upgrade to a newer version to apply the fix.

[![Image 8: Cybersecurity](https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEjVYuoalvwUlwvLZFDideJ8jW4rz-IodX0Lwi7uyP7Ab0wiDeu_BqVhPDdejQQ65MC3p9Xc4MApnHz56NJ5SDc1HMg0DvozkkGYv9TGtDLCh26v1yD5-GyzQxnA5-6A6B4beW96H_6FyrByq22cvU5JDF-i8e5GIfV4wg1SpCvjwAJt74FaqkAb2gzqE7ll/s728-nu-rw-lo-l85-e365/core-d.png)](https://thehackernews.uk/growth-ai-control-d)

According to a [timeline of events](https://www.beyondtrust.com/blog/entry/bt26-05) shared by BeyondTrust, Armory Castle is said to have exploited the flaw as a zero-day on a single self-hosted Remote Support appliance on August 29, 2026. Then, on September 27, 2026, "successful exploitation of another security device provider [became] public," it added, prompting it to initiate an investigation to hunt for similar activity.

Armory Castle has a [history](https://thehackernews.com/2025/09/unc5221-uses-brickstorm-backdoor-to.html) of [exploiting](https://thehackernews.com/2025/12/cisa-reports-prc-hackers-using.html) zero-day vulnerabilities in Citrix NetScaler ([CVE-2023-4966](https://thehackernews.com/2025/04/critical-ivanti-flaw-actively-exploited.html)) and Ivanti Connect Secure ([CVE-2023-46805, CVE-2024-21887](https://thehackernews.com/2024/02/warning-new-malware-emerges-in-attacks.html), and [CVE-2025-0282](https://thehackernews.com/2025/01/ivanti-flaw-cve-2025-0282-actively.html)) appliances to break a wide range of sectors, including legal services, SaaS providers, business-process outsourcers, technology, and governments, for long-term intelligence collection. It's known to be active since October 2023.

"The actor uses a zero-day selectively against chosen targets, and once the vulnerability is public, the actor typically moves to broad exploitation of every instance still unpatched," BeyondTrust said. "Our working assessment is that this actor selects high-value software targets in advance and keeps a working model of the products the actor targets in an AI context that it uses on an ongoing basis to develop exploit chains."

[![Image 9](https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEhLfMw0HvD7xBNyWNPi2keqpAiWhQNzpvhDZZJXvgbev2m5S7rRPlOMcOrjd5kma4o4X837CKgYAK1wahxDSnXfF6BKbzm8_FtGkDSywV0HQVYbsGQMpwuiY3QMGDdCcNiS1z09qK4DK3CdV_sezo1hNe9xXj8r7s2BYhHt52EHcc4arESMcmbWJUAreKW5/s1700-nu-rw-lo-l85-e365/ARMORY.jpg)](https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEhLfMw0HvD7xBNyWNPi2keqpAiWhQNzpvhDZZJXvgbev2m5S7rRPlOMcOrjd5kma4o4X837CKgYAK1wahxDSnXfF6BKbzm8_FtGkDSywV0HQVYbsGQMpwuiY3QMGDdCcNiS1z09qK4DK3CdV_sezo1hNe9xXj8r7s2BYhHt52EHcc4arESMcmbWJUAreKW5/s1700-nu-rw-lo-l85-e365/ARMORY.jpg)

Google-owned Mandiant, which shared additional details related to the exploitation activity, said a successful compromise is followed by the deployment of a lightweight PHP web shell codenamed SAWFLY for interactive remote access and bidirectional encrypted command-and-control (C2) communication.

The operator makes use of commercial VPN exit nodes and compromised home and small-office routers to blend into regular traffic, and then leverages the web shell as a conduit to escalate privileges, obtain full administrative control of the appliance, and establish persistence in a manner that survives reboots.

[![Image 10: Cybersecurity](https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEjVV2rRkX8tRMF6gCzemvQNpwFwGxRWxY1cJEYfoLLSj1EZYJOlj5WTR77t0i6kELXujYcaHTpRDqTjCbVHH5Pnh7wzxUiKP5j4dsDkWIMlp2bmpZsL0jeAsA_19pHH5UPtyBvNkZdyGEULOAsXPcraMP5CYjQRFefhXRSdEjYkrdcpUnc4ILcvcdEfAauE/s728-nu-rw-lo-l85-e365/tl-d.jpg)](https://thehackernews.uk/network-defense-d)

The intrusion is characterized by efforts to facilitate credential theft by reading the appliance's stored secrets and abusing the administrative access to reach downstream systems and enable lateral movement. Details of the [post-exploitation actions](https://cloud.google.com/blog/topics/threat-intelligence/armory-castle-exploits-beyondtrust/) undertaken by the threat actor are listed below -

*   Gaining root-level control of the appliance host by copying the system shell executable (/bin/sh) to the file "/usr/bin/dbus-authd" and modifying its ownership to root and enabling Set User ID (SUID) permissions, causing it to be executed with the privileges of the file's owner.
*   Attempting to harvest credentials directly from the appliance's native secrets management database by using the proprietary "/ns/sbin/bt-secrets" Command Line Interface (CLI) utility to manage, store, and retrieve passwords, API keys, and endpoint credentials.
*   Targeting the BeyondTrust configuration templates to obtain passwordless root privileges to the site service account and
*   Pivoted into the BeyondTrust Remote Support application to perform reconnaissance via compromised administrator credentials and then launch remote sessions to downstream systems populated within the appliance's [Jump Item list](https://docs.beyondtrust.com/pra/v24.3/docs/wac-jump-items).
*   Abusing the elevated administrative privileges to establish a remote support session to target internal endpoints and obtain full file-system access to those systems with an aim to download and exfiltrate sensitive internal documents for network reconnaissance.
*   Tunneling traffic through the BeyondTrust device via BARECLAW, a C-based custom SOCKS5 proxy tunneler that relays TCP connections between a remote client and destinations.
*   Modifying "/ns/config/haproxy.conf" file to ensure BARECLAW is accessible directly from the internet.
*   Hindering detection efforts by systematically deleting system, web server, and application-level logs.

"Throughout the intrusion, Armory Castle leveraged a deep understanding of BeyondTrust appliance internals, as evidenced by their abuse of proprietary CLI utilities, startup configuration templates and local reverse-proxy routing," Google Threat Intelligence Group (GTIG) and Mandiant researchers Jayson Frost, Bryce Greathouse, Brian Meyer, John Palmisano, Rajesh Rajeshirke, Steve Rasch, and John Wolfram said.

"Any appliance that was reachable from the internet on a vulnerable version during the exploitation window should be treated as potentially compromised until it has been reviewed."

香港时间 2026 年 10 月 16 日 14:53 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

政府宣布，由政务司副政务司长卓永兴领导的发展旅游热点工作小组将于今年第四季起陆续推出下一阶段的四个项目，为旅客提供更多元化、更独特的香港旅游体验。

卓先生表示，首期9个旅游热点项目的反应良好，得益于跨部门的加强协调和社会各界的贡献。今年年底起，工作组将分阶段推出新项目，涵盖工业品牌、微缩艺术、宗教文化、街区风光等主题，展示我市独特的文化遗产和城市风貌。
四个项目包括香港工业品牌旅游二期，新增景点包括九龙巴士车厂、港铁“Ride & See”铁路展览、北京同仁堂香港产研基地等。参观者将可以有组织地参观这些品牌设施，了解它们的历史和生产流程。

第二个项目是香港微型城市展览。香港杜莎夫人蜡像馆将于第四季度起在山顶广场重现展示，加入精雕细琢的微缩艺术品，从三个维度呈现香港的地标、风土人情和生活方式。

三是推进宗教文化深度游。华人庙宇委员会正在其管理的寺庙加强数字化和文化推广，包括安装二维码标牌和移动应用程序，让游客以互动方式了解寺庙文物并交换文化纪念品。政府将进一步研究将寺庙与各地区具有历史文化意义的建筑物和古迹联系起来，创建寺庙遗产步行路线。
第四个项目由元朗民政事务处牵头，联同地区团体推出“元朗好时节”，鼓励游客全年按主题探索该区，例如天后节期间到市中心观看盛大游行，或秋冬季节到自然景点观赏红叶和候鸟。该项目包括制作旅游地图、建立主题网站以及在城乡地标附近增加信息标志，预计从第四季度到明年第一季度分阶段推出。

Hong Kong
Hong Kong will roll out four new tourism projects from the fourth quarter, including visits to KMB depots, a railway exhibition, a miniature city display, temple heritage trails and seasonal tours of Yuen Long. The initiatives aim to showcase local culture and urban features.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

16 Oct 2026 at 14:53 HKT · 2 min read

The government announced that the Working Group on Developing Tourism Hotspots, led by Deputy Chief Secretary for Administration Cheuk Wing-hing, will progressively launch the next phase of four projects from the fourth quarter of this year, offering visitors a wider range of distinctive Hong Kong tourism experiences.

Cheuk said the first phase of nine tourism hotspot projects had been well received, thanks to strengthened cross-departmental coordination and contributions from across the community. From the end of this year, the working group will roll out new projects in phases, covering themes such as industrial brands, miniature art, religious culture and district scenery, to showcase the city's unique cultural heritage and urban landscape.

The four projects include the second phase of Hong Kong industrial brand tourism, with new attractions covering Kowloon Motor Bus depots, the MTR's "Ride & See" railway exhibition, and Beijing Tong Ren Tang's Hong Kong production and research base. Visitors will be able to tour these brand facilities in organised groups to learn about their histories and production processes.

The second project is a Hong Kong miniature city exhibition. Madame Tussauds Hong Kong will recreate the display at The Peak Galleria from the fourth quarter, adding finely crafted miniature artworks that present the city's landmarks, local customs and lifestyle in three dimensions.

The third project promotes in-depth religious culture tours. The Chinese Temples Committee is enhancing digitalisation and cultural promotion at its managed temples, including installing QR code signage and a mobile app that lets visitors interactively learn about temple relics and exchange for cultural souvenirs. The government will further study linking temples with historically and culturally significant buildings and monuments across districts to create temple heritage walking routes.

The fourth project, led by the Yuen Long District Office with district groups, is "Yuen Long Good Seasons", encouraging visitors to explore the district by theme throughout the year, such as watching the grand procession during Tin Hau Festival in the town centre, or visiting natural attractions in autumn and winter to see red leaves and migratory birds. The project includes producing tourist maps, setting up a themed website and adding information signs near urban and rural landmarks, with phased rollout expected from the fourth quarter to the first quarter of next year.

title: Taiwan economic growth in 2026 to be highest in 39 years: CIER - Focus Taiwan

content:
中新社台北10月16日电 中华经济研究院(CIER)周五预测，在内需和出口的双重支持下，台湾经济将在2026年以39年来最快的速度增长。

该智库将2026年经济增长预期上调至12.16%，比7月份预测的10.35%提高了1.81个百分点。

根据政府统计数据，如果预测准确，台湾经济增长速度将是自1987年12.75%以来最快的。

据《自由时报》报道，CIER 总裁连贤明在发布会前对记者表示：“今年是非常强劲的一年，国内外需求都表现良好。”

根据 CIER 的介绍，国内需求预计将贡献总体预计年度增长的 55%，而海外净需求将占剩余的 45%。

该智库表示，经济增长动力在很大程度上继续受到对人工智能相关产品的强劲需求的推动，这支持了强劲的出口增长以及更强劲的投资和消费者支出。

根据 CIER 的数据，其对 7 月份增长的上修主要是由于对内需增长而不是出口增长的预期。

在内需方面，连恩表示，全球云服务提供商持续扩大资本支出，带动本土制造商增加产能。
Lien 表示，产能的增长，加上非科技行业对自动化投资的增加，导致 CI​​ER 预计 2026 年私人投资将增长 10.77%。

该智库表示，私人消费预计增长 4.94%。

CIER 预测 2025 年整体增长将轻松超过台湾 8.76% 的增长，尽管季度增速预计将在年底放缓。

该智库预计第三季度增长率为 12.73%，第四季度增长率为 8.20%，因为较高的比较基数影响了同比数据。

第四季度预测较 7 月份预测的 6.04% 上调。该智库引用的政府数据显示，台湾第一季度和第二季度的增长率分别为15.43%和12.93%。

台湾的高预期增长率与全球经济活动放缓的预期形成鲜明对比。

CIER 援引标准普尔全球 9 月份的预测指出，预计今年世界经济增长将从 2025 年的 2.90% 放缓至 2.41%，这是自 COVID-19 大流行以来的最弱表现。

在评估台湾的前景时，CIER 强调了主要云服务提供商资本支出的持续扩张，但指出潜在融资需求的不确定性和现金流表现的差异是值得关注的问题。
报告还指出，主要经济体的货币政策变化、金融市场走势、国内投资、地缘政治风险和海峡两岸关系都可能拖累台湾的高增长环境。

在物价方面，CIER预测年度通胀率为2.06%，略高于7月份预测的2.02%和去年1.66%的通胀率。第四季度通胀率预计为 2.42%。

对于 2027 年，该机构将增长预测从 7 月份的 3.71% 上调至 5.97%，表明经济将继续以更为温和的速度扩张。

（赵彦祥摄）

【原文 English Original】
Taipei, Oct. 16 (CNA) Taiwan's economy will grow at its fastest pace in 39 years in 2026, supported by both domestic demand and exports, the Chung-Hua Institution for Economic Research (CIER) forecast on Friday.

The think tank raised its growth forecast to 12.16 percent for 2026, up 1.81 percentage points from its previous forecast of 10.35 percent made in July.

If the forecast is accurate, the pace of growth would be the fastest since Taiwan's economy grew 12.75 percent in 1987, according to government statistics.

"This is a very strong year, with both domestic and external demand performing very well," CIER President Lien Hsien-ming (連賢明) told reporters before the presentation, according to the Liberty Times.

Domestic demand is expected to contribute 55 percent of the overall projected annual growth, while net overseas demand would account for the remaining 45 percent, according to the CIER's presentation.

Much of the economic momentum continues to be driven by strong demand for AI-related products, which has supported robust export growth and stronger investment and consumer spending, according to the think tank.

Based on the CIER's figures, its upward revision of growth from July was largely due to expectations of higher growth in domestic demand rather than exports.

In terms of domestic demand, Lien said global cloud service providers were continuing to expand capital expenditures, leading local manufacturers to increase capacity.

That rise in capacity, combined with increased investment in automation by non-tech industries, led the CIER to project private investment to grow 10.77 percent in 2026, according to Lien.

Private consumption is forecast to grow 4.94 percent, the think tank said.

The CIER's projection of overall growth would easily surpass Taiwan's 8.76 percent growth in 2025, though the quarterly pace is expected to ease at the end of the year.

The think tank estimated third-quarter growth of 12.73 percent, followed by 8.20 percent in the fourth quarter as a higher base of comparison weighs on the year-over-year figure.

The fourth-quarter forecast was raised from July's estimate of 6.04 percent. Taiwan recorded growth of 15.43 percent and 12.93 percent in the first and second quarters, respectively, government data cited by the think tank showed.

Taiwan's high projected growth rate contrasts with expectations of moderated economic activity globally.

Citing S&P Global's September projections, the CIER noted that world economic growth was expected to slow to 2.41 percent this year from 2.90 percent in 2025, marking the weakest performance since the COVID-19 pandemic.

In assessing Taiwan's outlook, the CIER highlighted continued expansion in capital spending by major cloud service providers, but pointed to uncertainties over potential financing requirements and diverging cash flow performance as issues to watch.

It also cited monetary policy changes in major economies, financial market movements, domestic investment, geopolitical risks and cross-Taiwan Strait relations as potential drags on Taiwan's high-growth environment.

On prices, the CIER forecast annual inflation of 2.06 percent, slightly above its July estimate of 2.02 percent and last year's inflation rate of 1.66 percent. Fourth-quarter inflation was projected at 2.42 percent.

For 2027, the institute raised its growth forecast to 5.97 percent from 3.71 percent in July, pointing to continued expansion at a more moderate pace.

(By Chao Yen-hsiang)

# China’s Rare Earth Strategy and the Future of the South China Sea

The rise of seabed mining will add new complexity to the South China Sea disputes.

By **Chen Wangwanyu**

October 16, 2026

[](https://www.linkedin.com/shareArticle?url=https%3A%2F%2Fthediplomat.com%2F2026%2F10%2Fchinas-rare-earth-strategy-and-the-future-of-the-south-china-sea%2F&title=China%E2%80%99s+Rare+Earth+Strategy+and+the+Future+of+the+South+China+Sea "Share on LinkedIn")[](https://www.facebook.com/sharer.php?u=https%3A%2F%2Fthediplomat.com%2F2026%2F10%2Fchinas-rare-earth-strategy-and-the-future-of-the-south-china-sea%2F "Share on Facebook")[](https://bsky.app/intent/compose?text=China%E2%80%99s+Rare+Earth+Strategy+and+the+Future+of+the+South+China+Sea%0Ahttps%3A%2F%2Fthediplomat.com%2F2026%2F10%2Fchinas-rare-earth-strategy-and-the-future-of-the-south-china-sea%2F "Share on Bluesky")[](https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?text=China%E2%80%99s+Rare+Earth+Strategy+and+the+Future+of+the+South+China+Sea&url=https%3A%2F%2Fthediplomat.com%2F2026%2F10%2Fchinas-rare-earth-strategy-and-the-future-of-the-south-china-sea%2F "Share on X")

Credit: [Shutterstock](https://www.shutterstock.com/image-photo/underwater-scene-depicting-colorful-tropical-fish-2673584851?trackingId=2751c271-a520-4408-bc95-de66b4ee3108&listId=searchResults)

In August 2026, Japan and the United States [worked together to explore](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/features/2026-08-12/us-japan-plan-world-s-deepest-undersea-mine-to-challenge-china) extracting rare-earth-rich mud from the seabed near Minamitorishima. It offered a glimpse into the next phase of critical minerals competition. The race for rare earths is no longer confined to land mines and export control policies. As deep-sea minerals become part of national security planning, maritime spaces that were once mainly discussed in terms of sovereignty, shipping lanes, and fisheries may acquire a new layer of strategic value.

The South China Sea is not currently central to China’s rare earth advantage, but it may become increasingly relevant to how Beijing and its competitors think about the future geography of critical minerals security.

For now, China’s rare earth strategy and its South China Sea strategy remain largely distinct. China’s leverage in rare earths comes less from pure geology than from the country’s dominant position in refining, separation, and magnet production, combined with regulatory instruments that allow Beijing to manage outward flows of selected minerals. The [April 2025 export control measures](https://english.mofcom.gov.cn/Policies/AnnouncementsOrders/art/2025/art_0dd87cbee7b045bf93fabe6ab2faceee.html) on several medium and heavy rare-earth-related items underscored how critical minerals have become part of China’s national security toolbox.

By contrast, the South China Sea has traditionally been discussed and understood through a different strategic vocabulary: sovereignty claims, maritime jurisdiction, military presence, fisheries, hydrocarbons, and sea lanes of communication. This kind of separation, however, may not hold indefinitely, because the critical minerals competition is acquiring an increasingly prominent maritime dimension.

As governments search for ways to reduce dependence on existing rare earth supply chains, attention is gradually shifting toward deep-sea muds, polymetallic nodules, cobalt-rich crusts, and other seabed resources. These resources are not immediate substitutes for today’s land-based mines and processing systems, but they are entering strategic planning and industrial policy. Once critical minerals are imagined not only as terrestrial commodities but also as seabed resources, the boundary between resource security and maritime security begins to blur.

The South China Sea disputes have always had a strategic dimension, in addition to the sovereignty disputes alone. Yet oil, gas, fisheries, and shipping are the dominant drivers of maritime competition; seabed resources have thus far remained a less developed part of the story. [Studies of Fe-Mn crusts and polymetallic nodules in the South China Sea](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0169136817300100) have identified the presence of cobalt, nickel, rare earth elements, yttrium, and other critical materials.

That does not mean that the South China Sea is about to become a commercially viable rare earth mining zone. But as deep-sea mineral technologies and governance frameworks mature, the South China Sea’s significance may be reinterpreted through the language of critical minerals security.

That shift, if it occurs, would not replace the existing logic of South China Sea competition but add another layer to it. Critical minerals could make seabed mapping, marine scientific research, environmental regulation, and deep-sea mining rules more politically sensitive. Activities that once appeared primarily scientific or commercial could come to be viewed through the lens of supply chain resilience and national security.

China is especially well placed to think across these domains because it already possesses capabilities on both sides of the equation. It is not only a central actor in the rare earth supply chain, but also an active participant in deep-sea exploration and seabed governance. [China adopted a national law](https://www.mee.gov.cn/ywgz/fgbz/fl/202303/t20230314_1019565.shtml) on deep seabed resource exploration and development in 2016. title: IRRI-BASF project probes rice methane emissions
summary: **LOS BAÑOS, Philippines** — Cutting methane emissions from rice fields is possible. But what does it do to the soil that farmers depend on for the next planting? That is the question now being asked by the International Rice Research Insti
content:
**LOS BAÑOS, Philippines** — Cutting methane emissions from rice fields is possible. But what does it do to the soil that farmers depend on for the next planting?

That is the question now being asked by the International Rice Research Institute (IRRI), based here, as it starts the second phase of its joint research with German agricultural company BASF.

IRRI and BASF formally launched on Oct. 1, 2026 Phase 2 of Optima, short for Optimizing Management for Reduction of GHG in Rice, according to IRRI.

*   [BSP: ‘Prepare for the worst’Amid El Niño threat on prices, supplies](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/15/business/top-business/bsp-prepare-for-the-worstamid-el-nio-threat-on-prices-supplies/2445893)

Optima Phase 1, IRRI said, showed that three practices combined — direct-seeded rice instead of transplanted, better fertilizer management, and alternate wetting and drying (AWD) — can reduce water use and methane emissions without lowering yield. Under AWD, a rice field is left dry for a few days in between flooding, instead of keeping it flooded all season.

IRRI also tested its computer model for rice growth, called Otyza — named after Oryza sativa, the scientific name for rice — and found it can track how water moves in the field and predict how much methane will be released. IRRI said this makes the model useful for counting greenhouse gas (GHG) reductions and for future carbon farming programs.

**Looking deeper into the issue**

Phase 2, IRRI said, looks deeper into the issue.

IRRI explained that soil organic carbon — the organic matter that makes soil fertile — changes depending on how often farmers plant, how they manage rice straw, and whether they add organic materials.

*   ![Image 1: Pangilinan seeks reversal of ruling on Duterte’s dropped charges](https://miopia.newsroom.bi/statics/i/ps/manilatimes.net/manilatimes/uploads/images/2026/10/14/1258438.jpg?width=113&crop=113:85)
[Pangilinan seeks reversal of ruling on Duterte’s dropped charges](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/14/news/pangilinan-seeks-reversal-of-ruling-on-dutertes-dropped-charges/2445025)

When a flooded field is dried, soil microbes get oxygen and become more active. They break down organic matter faster and release carbon dioxide. Over many seasons, IRRI noted, this could mean soil carbon built up over years might slowly be lost.

[![Image 2: IRRI and BASF have launched the second phase of a project to advance low-emission rice technologies including direct-seeded rice, improved nutrient management, and alternate wetting and drying. IRRI PHOTO](https://manilatimes.net/manilatimes/uploads/images/2026/10/14/1259000.jpg)](https://manilatimes.net/manilatimes/uploads/images/2026/10/14/1259000.jpg)
IRRI and BASF have launched the second phase of a project to advance low-emission rice technologies including direct-seeded rice, improved nutrient management, and alternate wetting and drying. IRRI PHOTO

That trade-off matters, IRRI said, because methane reduction can be seen quickly, but soil carbon loss is slow and hard to notice — yet it affects fertility and long-term harvests.

*   ![Image 3: Marcos’ impeachment plot backfires](https://miopia.newsroom.bi/statics/i/ps/manilatimes.net/manilatimes/uploads/images/2026/10/13/1258203.jpg?width=113&crop=113:85)
[Marcos’ impeachment plot backfires](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/14/opinion/columns/marcos-impeachment-plot-backfires/2444878)

"Optima 1 has established that the Oryza model is a useful tool to quantify climate benefits of AWD. Our next step is to understand what its effect is in the long term on the system's long-term sustainability, particularly for soil health and soil carbon dynamics,” said Ligia Bacchereti Azevedo, Senior Sustainability Manager for Agricultural Solutions of BASF, during the kickoff meeting for the joint initiative.

“Optima 2 will help us examine whether low emissions practices can support long-term sustainability, while considering potential trade-offs," the BASF official said.

IRRI said the new two-year study will compare different ways of doing AWD and see how straw management and biochar — charcoal-like material added to soil — interact with it to affect yield and carbon storage.

The institute said it will also improve the Oryza model so it can simulate these effects over the short, medium, and long term. To do this, IRRI will use data from its Long-Term Continuous Cropping Experiment in Los Baños, one of Asia's longest-running rice experiments that has tracked soil changes for decades.

*   ![Image 4: Laguna mayors rally behind Aragones](https://miopia.newsroom.bi/statics/i/ps/manilatimes.net/manilatimes/uploads/images/2026/10/14/1257533.jpg?width=113&crop=113:85)
[Laguna mayors rally behind Aragones](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/14/regions/laguna-mayors-rally-behind-aragones/2444954)

"The continuation of this partnership is a testimony of the alignment of BASF and IRRI vision in ensuring transformation of rice systems towards low-emissions systems are supported by science-based evidence and farmers will be equipped with the best combinations of technologies optimized for productivity, profitability and sustainability," said Virender Kumar, Research Director of IRRI's Sustainable Impact through Rice-based Systems Department.

IRRI said Optima 2 starts this wet season of 2026. The goal, according to IRRI, is to give clearer, field-based evidence on how to lower GHG emissions, especially methane, without harming the soil that sustains rice farming — so that low-emission practices can be promoted at scale with confidence for both climate and farmers.

title: Oligarcho-political urbanism: How wealth and power hijack our cities
summary: OLIGARCHO-POLITICAL urbanism as a self-reinforcing cycle in which economic and political actors shape urban development priorities, increasing land values and private profits while producing significant social and spatial consequences. I us
content:
OLIGARCHO-POLITICAL urbanism as a self-reinforcing cycle in which economic and political actors shape urban development priorities, increasing land values and private profits while producing significant social and spatial consequences.

I used to think that urban planners were the dominant shapers of cities. I would read about land use planning, transportation and other infrastructure planning. I also would study the strategic environmental assessment and public consultation processes. All of this gave me the impression that there were processes and structures for planning in a democratic state.

However, the more I practiced architecture and urban design, the more I became uncertain about the process of urban planning. Important urban planning decisions are made a long time before any consultation processes. By the time the public is allowed to give their opinions, important planning decisions have already been made. The public is rarely consulted in a process that gives them real decision-making power.

*   [39 impeachment days: Takeaways](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/15/opinion/columns/39-impeachment-days-takeaways/2445742)

This realization led me to an uncomfortable question: “Who are the real urban planners?”

[![Image 1: No Image](https://manilatimes.net/manilatimes/uploads/images/2026/10/14/1259972.png)](https://manilatimes.net/manilatimes/uploads/images/2026/10/14/1259972.png)

Get the latest news
 delivered to your inbox

Sign up for The Manila Times newsletters

By signing up with an email address, I acknowledge that I have read and agree to the [Terms of Service](https://manilatimes.net/terms-of-service "Terms of Service") and [Privacy Policy](https://manilatimes.net/privacy-policy "Privacy Policy").

Textbooks lead us to believe urban planning is a collaborative effort to integrate planning and design with the goals and objectives of the state and citizens. The projects that really influence the region and shape the metropolis are usually the result of big business, political clout and planning integration.

Jane Jacobs’ thesis is that the rapid growth and expansion of cities is organic. Cities should be designed with and for the people who inhabit them, so they may have the means to lead a productive life. Healthy cities should not be designed from above, but grow from the bottom up.

*   ![Image 2: 44% expect Sara Duterte’s conviction in impeachment trial — survey](https://miopia.newsroom.bi/statics/i/ps/manilatimes.net/manilatimes/uploads/images/2026/10/14/1258812.jpeg?width=113&crop=113:85)
[44% expect Sara Duterte’s conviction in impeachment trial — survey](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/14/news/44-expect-sara-dutertes-conviction-in-impeachment-trial-survey/2445251)

When looking at the Philippines’ cities, it’s difficult to see the impact the average person has on their urban environment.

Let’s think about how cities grow. The government creates a big plan to improve city infrastructure. The price of land goes up. Developers buy land. Businesses open. More improvements to city infrastructure are needed. Sometimes, the growth of a city seems natural, but it can be a series of investments by a few people that leads to a change in infrastructure.

Of course, a city needs businesses and a thriving economy. The problem is when a small group of people is able to control and change the goals of the public.

This is what I call “oligarch urbanism.” It doesn’t include illegal activities. It occurs when a small group of people, usually in the economy, is able to control the ways in which a city changes and grows. In our case, some of the largest businesses of the country are part of the real estate, toll ways, logistics, construction and commercial businesses of the nation.

*   ![Image 3: Laguna mayors rally behind Aragones](https://miopia.newsroom.bi/statics/i/ps/manilatimes.net/manilatimes/uploads/images/2026/10/14/1257533.jpg?width=113&crop=113:85)
[Laguna mayors rally behind Aragones](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/14/regions/laguna-mayors-rally-behind-aragones/2444954)

Oligarch urbanism doesn’t focus on the illegal activities that business people and political families do. Instead, it is about how the goals of improving cities are determined and changed by these people.

This has certainly advantaged some cities in the country to become more productive, but at the expense of others, especially the middle income and the poor, to become more competitive, particularly in infrastructure that favors the market and the economy. Roads are constructed at the expense of parks. Spaces are planned and developed to commercially facilitate the free flow of capital and goods to the detriment of the free flow of people, especially the poor and the vulnerable. The building of houses is giving way to the construction of malls and other commercial and financial centers to the point that providing facilities for the basic needs of the poor is quite a challenge, and it is difficult for the poor to access public services and use public spaces.

It is sad to say that leisure, sports and social activities have been relegated to shopping malls and commercial centers. Privately owned commercial space has largely replaced, and even absorbed, the functions and services once provided by, and located in, civic and public spaces. Fun and games have been privatized and commercialized. Mall owners even charge an entrance fee just to use their commercial space!

The city, and especially commercial and financial centers, should provide places where children play, people relax, gather, and enjoy the city and its public spaces.

*   ![Image 4: Pangilinan seeks reversal of ruling on Duterte’s dropped charges](https://miopia.newsroom.bi/statics/i/ps/manilatimes.net/manilatimes/uploads/images/2026/10/14/1258438.jpg?width=113&crop=113:85)
[Pangilinan seeks reversal of ruling on Duterte’s dropped charges](https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/10/14/news/pangilinan-seeks-reversal-of-ruling-on-dutertes-dropped-charges/2445025)

As an urban planner and architect, I evaluate the success of urban areas differently than most. I focus on the quality of life of the people living in an urban area instead of the monetary worth of the land or the cost of the infrastructure.

Jane Jacobs noted that urban areas provide a wide range of opportunities and benefits for the population because of the diversity and choices offered by a large urban center. However, the existence of abundant choices in a large urban area depends on the participation of the entire population.

Are the largest and most prominent urban areas in the Philippines still designed for the participation of the majority, or are they designed by the upper class and the elite?

If decisions that affect the design of a city are made by an exclusive few, the city will eventually be planned and designed for the few and unjustly privileged. In the process, it will lose its ability to offer various possibilities and choices for the majority and will ultimately fail to serve the urban population.

Louwie Gan is the first Filipino architect and urban planner to be accredited by international green building institutions. He is an award-winning designer and internationally accredited sustainability expert who advocates for care-centric urbanism and regenerative development. He has worked as a sustainability and urban planning consultant for the government and international organizations.

卢比奥回到会议地点，里根拒绝向苏联放弃他的天基导弹防御系统的愿景，并提醒世界，高北地区对于美国的权力和利益仍然很重要。卢比奥与冰岛外交部长并肩站在一起，指出该地点仍然是“监视秘密行为和威慑我们对手的重要前哨基地”。当记者问他美国是否可能扩大在那里的军事足迹时，他没有承诺具体计划，但强调这样做需要冰岛的同意。谈判将继续进行，尽管他没有提到俄罗斯或中国的名字，但这些国家现在对美国及其盟国构成严重威胁。雷克雅未克之行是在最近与丹麦王国达成具有里程碑意义的协议之后进行的。这份协议确保美国能够阻止中国在北极建立其惯常的计划。该协议的批评者表示，考虑到中国尚未进入格陵兰岛，华盛顿和哥本哈根之间的谈判“无事生非”。这没有抓住重点。随着冰层融化，北极航线变得越来越通航，创造了新的海上通道（从而形成了咽喉要道），这将影响未来几十年的全球航运和军事态势。
该协议赋予华盛顿阻止非北约在格陵兰岛的商业和军事存在的权力，在筛选和加速关键领域的外国投资、飞越、导弹防御通道和不受限制地进入格陵兰岛领海的外国投资方面发挥直接作用。至关重要的是，该协议尊重格陵兰岛的主权，这对丹麦来说是一个不容谈判的问题，同时无论格陵兰岛是否会独立，该协议都将永久有效。通过这样做，该协议澄清了 1951 年条约中没有提及的地方。驳回这项协议，或许是因为想要否认特朗普政府的功劳，也辜负了丹麦人真正的让步和不满。

Rubio Push on Greenland Delivers a Huge Diplomatic Win for US Against China bbert@hudson.org Thu, 10/15/2026 - 11:38 SVG Commentary Oct 15, 2026 Fox News Rubio Push on Greenland Delivers a Huge Diplomatic Win for US Against China Rebeccah L. Heinrichs Senior Fellow and Director, Keystone Defense Initiative Rebeccah L. Heinrichs Commentary Caption Secretary of State Marco Rubio speaks during a joint press conference with Iceland's prime minister at the House of Collections in Reykjavik on October 6, 2026. (Getty Images) Toggle Table of Contents Contents Contents Share to Twitter Twitter Share to Facebook Facebook Share to LinkedIn LinkedIn Share to E-mail E-mail Print Print China seeks to replace the United States as the leading global superpower and key to its strategy is securing critical sea lanes. The country that can control the fate of sea lanes will have leverage over markets and the kind of system on which global trade will rely, access to limited natural resources and a significant ability to project power far from its shores. Secretary of State Marco Rubio has been planning and executing a diplomatic sweep from Panama to Greenland, and now Iceland, to box out China, protect its access and interests and establish an American advantage over the long term. About 40 years ago, President Ronald Reagan and Soviet leader Mikhail Gorbachev met in Reykjavík, Iceland, and initiated the start of the thaw of Cold War tensions. Rubio returned to the site of the meeting where Reagan refused to surrender his vision of a space-based missile shield to the Soviets and reminded the world that the High North still matters for American power and interests. Standing side by side with Iceland’s foreign minister, Rubio noted that the location remains a "critical outpost for monitoring clandestine behavior and deterring our adversaries." When a reporter asked him if the United States may expand its military footprint there, he didn’t commit to plans but emphasized that doing so would require Icelandic consent. The negotiations will continue, and, though he didn’t mention Russia or China by name, those are the nations now posing acute threats to the United States and its allies. The Reykjavík visit follows the recently secured landmark deal with the Kingdom of Denmark. This deal ensures that the United States can prevent the Chinese from establishing its habitual scheme in the Arctic. Critics of the deal have said that the negotiations between Washington and Copenhagen were "much ado about nothing," considering that China isn’t (yet) in Greenland. This misses the point. As the ice melts, Arctic shipping routes are becoming increasingly navigable, creating new sea lanes (and thus choke points) that will shape global shipping and military posturing for decades to come. The agreement gives Washington the authority to block non-NATO commercial and military presence in Greenland, a direct role in screening and accelerating foreign investment in critical sectors, overflight, missile defense access and unrestricted undersea access across Greenland’s territorial waters. Critically, the deal honors Greenland’s sovereignty, a non-negotiable issue for Denmark, while remaining in force in perpetuity, regardless of if Greenland were to ever become independent. In doing so, the deal clarifies where the 1951 treaty was silent. Dismissing the deal, perhaps due to a desire to deny the Trump administration credit, also shortchanges the Danes’ very real concessions and diplomatic skill. Furthermore, the deal came just in time for NATO, whose steadfast solidarity is key as Russia ramps up its campaign of terror attacks across the alliance to collapse support for Ukraine. For years, both the Chinese and Panamanian governments denied China was taking over the Panama Canal. But the president said that the Chinese had illegally stationed soldiers to operate the canal, and a Chinese-owned company was illegally charging for passage to the disadvantage of the United States, which has paid billions to maintain the canal, of which 72% of all vessels (according to the U.S. government) are transiting to or from an American port. For years, the U.S. was asleep at the wheel, allowing China’s incremental, commercial expansion to dominate the canal. After Rubio’s discussions with the Panamanians, a Panamanian court ruled that the contract to operate the container terminals at the canal’s Pacific and Atlantic entrances violated the constitution, and it ended the contract. Some have praised President Donald Trump’s "Art of the Deal" for these diplomatic successes. That is, making maximalist demands, including threats of aggression against trusted allies in the hopes of getting a deal somewhere short of the opening threat, but close to it. But that is the wrong lesson to learn here. Trump’s threats to seize Greenland by force did not help the United States achieve this deal with the Danes, who have been good allies. Instead, it created panic across NATO, which undermined the administration’s efforts to update and strengthen the alliance. Progress toward the deal only began once Trump stopped making threats in response to the blowback. On Jan. 21, in the lead-up to the Davos World Economic Forum, Trump’s threats contributed to a sharp decline in financial markets. Polling showed 91% of U.S. voters opposed taking Greenland by military force, and Congress was decisively against it, too. As articulated by Rubio, the Trump administration believes the security of the United States remains linked to Europe’s and that the U.S. must make sure that NATO is strong so that it can continue to be a "deterrent against hostility" which makes "our nations and our continents safer from foreign threats and more secure for our people." The threats were a distraction; foresight and effective diplomacy are the real story. And, on that front, Rubio won for the president and the country with significant gains over the Chinese and the Russians. Read in Fox News. Enjoyed this analysis? content:
澳大利亚珀斯——想象一下，一辆无人驾驶地面车辆足够大，可以在战场上运载一个 20 英尺的集装箱，并且拥有足够的动力来运行雷达或发射一连串导弹。

泰雷兹澳大利亚公司表示，它已经制造出了这样的机器人。

10 月 6 日，即在西澳大利亚珀斯举行的 Land Forces 2026 展览会开幕日，该公司推出了 BladeHaul 超大型重型 UGV。

BladeHaul 看起来类似于飞机拖船，它依赖于泰雷兹澳大利亚公司广受欢迎的 Bushmaster 4x4 防护机动车辆的底盘和传动系统，该车辆在澳大利亚陆军中广泛使用。

据其设计师介绍，这款无人驾驶飞行器“经过精心设计，在有效载荷能力和操作灵活性方面优于所有现有和计划中的同类产品。”

官方规格列出了这款货运 UGV 的有效负载能力为 10 吨以上，行驶里程可与 Bushmaster 的 600 多公里相媲美。

Bushmaster 的原始机械装置已被泰雷兹澳大利亚合作伙伴 3ME Technology 的混合能源和电池存储解决方案所取代。

3ME Technology 在采矿领域拥有丰富的经验，此前曾开发过混合动力大毒蛇车辆。

泰雷兹澳大利亚公司和 3ME Technologies 于 10 月在西澳大利亚珀斯举行的 2026 年陆军大会上推出了 BladeHaul UGV。 （戈登·阿瑟）

该公司为 BladeHaul 组装了一个 660V 电源系统，可提供 110kWh 的电力。
3ME Technology 首席执行官贾斯汀·贝恩 (Justin Bain) 表示：“与泰雷兹澳大利亚公司的合作汇集了澳大利亚最优秀的创新技术，将 3ME Technology 的系统工程和平台开发能力与 Bushmaster 久经考验的性能和成熟的制造基地相结合。在沿海环境对物流和远程供电解决方案的需求不断增长的背景下，我们共同推出了一款全新的 XL-UGV。”

泰雷兹澳大利亚公司设想了 BladeHaul 的三个潜在用例： 作为有争议的物流区域的货物搬运车；作为其他设备的移动且持久的电源；并作为传感器和效应器的高度移动平台。

因此，该车辆可以用于诸如携带沿海反舰导弹、作为反无人机系统、安装空中监视雷达、重新装载弹药或探测地雷等任务。对于后一项任务，它可以在前面安装一个扫雷机或滚筒。

制造商表示，该车辆的应用仅受用户想象力的限制。例如，一名官员告诉《防务新闻》，它可以携带集装箱导弹系统或发射无人机群。

或者，它可以为野战医院、指挥所发电和供电，或者只是充当独立的发电机。它提供1MW的功率。从这个角度来看，1MW 可以同时为 1,000 个家庭供电。
为了增加其多功能性，BladeHaul 4x4 UGV 可以安装在 C-130 和 A400M 等运输机上。

然而，BladeHaul 尚未准备好投入使用。该项目的工作于 18 个月前开始，在过去六个月中进展确实在加速，但它尚未建立工作自主系统。

泰雷兹澳大利亚公司在 Land Forces 2026 上与迪肯大学签署了一份谅解备忘录，以开发其自主套件。这将建立在泰雷兹今年早些时候推出的小型守护天使无人车上使用的套件的基础上。它将能够远程、完全

【原文 English Original】
PERTH, Australia — Imagine an unmanned ground vehicle large enough to cart a 20-foot container around the battlefield, as well as possessing sufficient power to run a radar or launch a barrage of missiles.

Thales Australia says it has built just such a robot.

The company unveiled its BladeHaul extra-large, heavy-duty UGV on Oct. 6, the opening day of the Land Forces 2026 exhibition being held in Perth, Western Australia.

Looking something akin to an aircraft tug, the BladeHaul relies on the chassis and driveline of Thales Australia’s popular Bushmaster 4x4 protected mobility vehicle that is in widespread Australian Army use.

According to its designer, this uncrewed vehicle “is engineered to outperform all existing and planned counterparts in payload capacity and operational flexibility.”

Official specs list a payload capacity of 10-plus tons for this cargo UGV, and a driving range comparable to that of the Bushmaster’s 600-plus kilometers.

The Bushmaster’s original mechanicals have been replaced by a hybrid energy and battery storage solution from 3ME Technology, Thales Australia’s partner in the effort.

3ME Technology has extensive experience in the mining sector, and it previously developed a hybrid-engined Bushmaster vehicle.

Thales Australia and 3ME Technologies unveiled the BladeHaul UGV at Land Forces 2026 in Perth, Western Australia, in October. (Gordon Arthur)

For the BladeHaul the company has assembled a 660V power system that offers 110kWh of power.

Justin Bain, CEO of 3ME Technology, said: “Working with Thales Australia brings together the best of Australian innovation, combining 3ME Technology’s systems engineering and platform development capabilities with the Bushmaster’s proven performance and established manufacturing base. Together we’re delivering an entirely new XL-UGV at a time when demand for contested logistics and remote power solutions for littoral environments is present and growing.”

Thales Australia envisages three potential use cases for the BladeHaul: as a cargo mover in zones of contested logistics; as a mobile and enduring power source for other equipment; and as a highly mobile platform for sensors and effectors.

The vehicle could therefore find utility in tasks such as carrying coastal anti-ship missiles, as a counter-drone system, mounting an air surveillance radar, reloading munitions or detecting mines. For the latter mission, it could have a mine plow or rollers mounted on the front.

The manufacturer says the vehicle’s applications are limited only by the imagination of the user. For example, it could carry containerized missile systems or launch drone swarms, one official told Defense News.

Alternatively, it could generate and supply power for a field hospital, a command post or simply act as a standalone generator. It offers a 1MW of power. To put that in perspective, 1MW could simultaneously power 1,000 homes.

To add to its versatility, the BladeHaul 4x4 UGV can fit in transport aircraft like the C-130 and A400M.

The BladeHaul is not yet ready for action, however. Work on the project began 18 months ago, with progress really accelerating over the past six months, but it does not yet have a working autonomy system.

Thales Australia signed a memorandum of understanding with Deakin University at Land Forces 2026 to develop its autonomy suite. This will build upon the suite used on the smaller Guardian Angel UGV unveiled by Thales earlier this year. It will be capable of remote, fully autonomous or follow-me operations, for example.

Thales Australia said in a statement: “By integrating advanced autonomy that enables human-machine teaming, hybrid technology, heavy payload capacity and power generation within a single platform, Thales Australia and 3ME Technology are delivering a next-generation solution that enhances operational readiness and supports Australia’s commitment to sovereign defense innovation.”

The BladeHaul is aimed at the Australian Army, but its appeal extends to any land force, according to the manufacturer.

The vehicle has no V-shaped hull to protect against underbody blasts, as there is no crew aboard. However, ballistic protection could be added to it depending on the function.

Bain said there is interest in a UGV version able to carry a 40-foot container too. “If there’s sufficient demand, we may look at that.”

Gordon Arthur is an Asia correspondent for Defense News. After a 20-year stint working in Hong Kong, he now resides in New Zealand. He has attended military exercises and defense exhibitions in about 20 countries around the Asia-Pacific region.

title: China’s Trade Surplus Goes Vertical
summary: _Thank you for subscribing to my posts. If you’re not yet a paying supporter, please consider becoming one. That’ll allow you to DM me with questions and comments. Your contribution will help cover the cost of the data I use in my posts, wh
content:
_Thank you for subscribing to my posts. If you’re not yet a paying supporter, please consider becoming one. That’ll allow you to DM me with questions and comments. Your contribution will help cover the cost of the data I use in my posts, which I fund out of my own pocket. Thanks so much for your support and feedback!_

Back in my Goldman days, I wrote a report on currency manipulation in Asia. For obvious reasons, I had to be careful in how I wrote things up - many countries in the region were also clients - and the report was published only after careful review. For example, the final draft eschewed words like _“intervention”_ or _“manipulation,”_ so there was lots of self-censoring before the report ever saw the light of day. I got in trouble anyway. The Chinese government complained loudly to senior management and the upshot was that I had to do a conference call with various government officials who yelled at me for an hour about how awful my report was.

I learned a lot about China on that conference call. After all, if a country puts so much energy into intimidating a nerd like me, that’s in my mind a sign of profound fragility. China depends desperately on its export sector for growth, which makes US tariffs an existential threat. Beneath its calm demeanor, China is working furiously to reduce its exports to the US in case the trade war flares up again. I showed the massive ramp-up in China’s exports to emerging markets (EM) that’s a symptom of this in yesterday’s [post](https://robinjbrooks.substack.com/p/how-china-is-reinventing-its-export). Today’s post looks at how this shows up in China’s overall trade balance.

[![Image 1](https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!zGnl!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Fe598c90d-5341-4485-a52f-6a9bdc10e8b8_460x432.png)](https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!zGnl!,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Fe598c90d-5341-4485-a52f-6a9bdc10e8b8_460x432.png)

China publishes seasonally adjusted export and import data for its biggest trading partners. I use those to construct China’s bilateral trade surplus with the US, which is the black line in the chart above, and its trade surplus with fourteen other countries, which is the blue line. China’s trade surplus with the US is back to pre-2025 levels, but it’s the surplus with the fourteen other countries that looks like it’s going vertical. As the fourteen countries are mostly advanced economies and a few of the bigger EMs, this doesn’t even cover what I talked about in yesterday’s [post](https://robinjbrooks.substack.com/p/how-china-is-reinventing-its-export), which was about the massive rise in China’s exports across all of EM.

[![Image 2](https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!_vP3!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Fec69ac89-bc4e-403c-bac3-e4ade759a2d6_477x432.png)](https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!_vP3!,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Fec69ac89-bc4e-403c-bac3-e4ade759a2d6_477x432.png)

The chart above looks at China’s trade surplus with all countries around the world (not just the countries in the top chart, which are China’s principal trading partners). Since these data aren’t seasonally adjusted, I show January through September totals for every year, which you can think of as a crude seasonal adjustment. It’s clear that something very unusual is going on in the last two years. The chart below shows that the ramp-up in exports is even bigger than meets the eye. That’s because imports are also growing, so the rise in the trade surplus isn’t about import compression. Instead, China’s export sector is firing on all cylinders.

[![Image 3](https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!CUyK!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F0a91de5b-aa6d-498b-aa1b-662dac0dffbf_477x432.png)](https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!CUyK!,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F0a91de5b-aa6d-498b-aa1b-662dac0dffbf_477x432.png)

As the chart below shows, the rise in exports is very recent and about a furious orientation away from the US. In China’s recent history, there’s nothing remotely similar, so this feels like state intervention to cut its US export dependence. This isn’t a freebie for China. If you want to export to new markets, you have to discount what you’re selling, so it’s likely this export shift is hitting margins and profitability among China’s exporters. It’s therefore a [deflationary](https://robinjbrooks.substack.com/p/why-us-tariffs-are-deflationary-for) shock. But unlike Western countries, China’s leadership is playing the long game and has clearly decided it’s worth taking a short-term hit to reduce vulnerability to US tariffs over the medium term.

[![Image 4](https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!Yjtp!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F63df0b4a-ee73-45b7-acf0-9fe1696310f5_476x427.png)](https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!Yjtp!,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F63df0b4a-ee73-45b7-acf0-9fe1696310f5_476x427.png)

All of this is massively destabilizing for the global economy. It obviously snuffs out much of the growth potential for US and European goods in EM. It also means that all the EMs being targeted in this export surge are getting roped into a dependence on China that’s bad for them and bad for the West. There’s an urgent need for the US and Europe to get on the same page with respect to all of this.

title: Hong Kong Monetary Authority unveils 'ART' framework for responsible AI use in banking
zh_title: 香港金融管理局推出“ART”框架，促进银行业负责任地使用人工智能
summary: 香港金融管理局推出了“ART”框架，指导银行负责任地采用人工智能，重点关注问责制、弹性和信任。措施包括更新监管指南、人工智能培训数据共享平台以及 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 治理咨询 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 10 月 15 日2026 at 14:30 HKT · 2 分钟阅读 香港金融管理局（HKMA）周四（10 月）公布
content:
香港
香港金融管理局推出了“ART”框架，指导银行负责任地采用人工智能，重点关注问责制、弹性和信任。措施包括更新监管指南、人工智能培训数据共享平台以及治理咨询

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

2026 年 10 月 15 日 14:30 香港时间 · 阅读 2 分钟

香港金融管理局（金管局）周四（10月15日）宣布推出“ART”框架，支持银行业负责任地采用人工智能（AI），旨在建立一个负责任、有弹性和值得信赖的人工智能银行生态系统。

金管局表示，随着人工智能系统变得更加自主，可以调动更多数据、工具和工作流程，该框架旨在帮助银行抓住人工智能机遇，同时保持良好的治理和运营弹性。该框架下的具体措施包括发布关于负责任的人工智能应用的最新监管指南，其中纳入了生成人工智能（GenAI）沙箱第二阶段的见解。
金管局还与数码港和香港大学合作建立人工智能培训数据共享平台，以数据质量保证为核心设计原则。此外，“GenA.I.Sandbox++”将进一步测试代理人工智能应用，并将发布关于代理人工智能治理拟议监管框架的讨论文件，探索基于意图的问责安排、重要人工智能代理的登记册和有效的干预机制。

金管局与数码港合办「金融+人工智能」 10月15-16日的论坛，标志着第二阶段GenAI沙盒技术测试圆满结束。超过 60% 的用例涉及探索代理 AI，反映了业界对复杂 AI 系统的积极进步，例如在授权和受控边界内自动规划和执行多步骤任务。

金管局副总裁袁国强表示：“人工智能从生成型向代理型的演变代表了银行业创新的一个重要新阶段。在‘金融科技2030’框架下，金管局推出了‘ART’框架，代表问责制、弹性和信任，为银行负责任地开发和部署人工智能提供明确的基础。通过将创新、明确的问责安排、弹性运营模式和有效的人力监督相结合，银行可以充分利用人工智能的优势，同时保持信任和银行的稳定性。香港的金融体系。”

【原文 English Original】
Hong Kong
The Hong Kong Monetary Authority has launched an 'ART' framework to guide banks in responsibly adopting artificial intelligence, focusing on accountability, resilience and trust. Measures include updated regulatory guidance, an AI training data sharing platform, and a consultation on governance for

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

15 Oct 2026 at 14:30 HKT · 2 min read

The Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) announced on Thursday (October 15) an "ART" framework to support the responsible adoption of artificial intelligence (AI) in the banking sector, aiming to build an AI-enabled banking ecosystem that is accountable, resilient and trustworthy.

As AI systems become more autonomous and can mobilise more data, tools and workflows, the HKMA said the framework is designed to help banks seize AI opportunities while maintaining sound governance and operational resilience. Specific measures under the framework include issuing updated regulatory guidance on responsible AI application, which incorporates insights from the second phase of the Generative AI (GenAI) sandbox.

The HKMA is also partnering with Cyberport and the University of Hong Kong to build an AI training data sharing platform, with data quality assurance as a core design principle. In addition, the "GenA.I. Sandbox++" will further test agentic AI applications, and a discussion paper will be published on a proposed regulatory framework for agentic AI governance, exploring intent-based accountability arrangements, a register of significant AI agents, and effective intervention mechanisms.

The HKMA and Cyberport co-hosted the "Finance + A.I." forum on October 15 and 16, marking the successful conclusion of the second-phase GenAI sandbox technical testing. More than 60 per cent of use cases involved exploring agentic AI, reflecting the industry's active advancement of sophisticated AI systems, such as automatic planning and executing multi-step tasks within authorised and controlled boundaries.

Arthur Yuen, Deputy Chief Executive of the HKMA, said: "AI's evolution from generative to agentic represents an important new phase in banking innovation. Under 'Fintech 2030', the HKMA has launched the 'ART' framework, which stands for accountability, resilience and trust, to provide a clear foundation for banks to develop and deploy AI responsibly. By combining innovation, clear accountability arrangements, resilient operating models and effective human oversight, banks can fully harness the benefits of AI while maintaining trust and the stability of Hong Kong's financial system."

## 中國浙大清華發現石墨烯膜新結構並發表 標榜高強度輕量化

2026-10-15 13:36 中央社／ 上海15日電  清華大學

中國媒體今天報導，中國[**浙江大學**](https://udn.com/search/tagging/2/%E6%B5%99%E6%B1%9F%E5%A4%A7%E5%AD%B8)與北京[**清華大學**](https://udn.com/search/tagging/2/%E6%B8%85%E8%8F%AF%E5%A4%A7%E5%AD%B8)研究團隊發現石墨烯膜新結構，昨天深夜艸並在國際學術期刊「自然」（Nature）線上發表研究成果，號稱高強度、高韌性與高彈性，可望為航空航太結構輕量化、增強衝擊防護裝備提供材料基礎。

新浪科技報導，這項研究是在石墨烯膜中發現「層間折疊卡扣」的新結構與新機制，首次實現石墨烯膜的高強度、高韌性與高彈性三合一的性能突破。

[Video 14](https://content1.avplayer.com/5b59760c073ef46a2e6b8f13/videos/69d8bed5fc5b3e8a960d2c4e/hls/video.m3u8?AV_TAGID=6814930766b0cc5c3d0ead4d&pid=615ac1a77d20d4235b6a596a&cid=68149208c94d744b4a057116&AV_TEMPID=681494bbf2ab4be52e0614da&AV_PUBLISHERID=615ac1a77d20d4235b6a596a&av_qd1=6818a0d1ee249970a60232b2&videoId=69d8bed5fc5b3e8a960d2c4e)![Image 1: Udn_Video_2_100426](https://content1.avplayer.com/5b59760c073ef46a2e6b8f13/videos/69d8bed5fc5b3e8a960d2c4e/6dc70f9c-b20f-46a4-8d31-74fe6890d6f8.webp)

新華社報導，石墨烯膜的力學性能提升長期以來面臨強度與韌性難以兼顧的瓶頸。傳統方法有的是透過提高石墨烯片層排列的規整程度，或是增強片層之間的結合力以改善性能。

新研究突破傳統「平面堆疊」設計思路，構築出層間相互咬合的「折疊卡扣結構」石墨烯膜。

新浪科技報導，與傳統平直堆疊不同，折疊結構能夠在層間形成軟的「機械卡扣」，使材料在受力時能夠發生可逆的彈性形變，且有效阻止層間滑移失效，實現強度、韌性和彈性的協同提升，打破傳統層狀材料力學性能的紀錄。

這項研究成果是浙江大學長聘副教授許震、教授高超和[**北京清華大學**](https://udn.com/search/tagging/2/%E5%8C%97%E4%BA%AC%E6%B8%85%E8%8F%AF%E5%A4%A7%E5%AD%B8)教授徐志平團隊合作，浙江大學博士後王利丹、清華大學博士後廖楊超為論文共同第一作者。

高超表示，這項研究有望為航空航太輕量化結構、抗衝擊防護裝備等領域的發展提供材料基礎。

[浙江大學](https://udn.com/search/tagging/2/%E6%B5%99%E6%B1%9F%E5%A4%A7%E5%AD%B8)[清華大學](https://udn.com/search/tagging/2/%E6%B8%85%E8%8F%AF%E5%A4%A7%E5%AD%B8)[北京清華大學](https://udn.com/search/tagging/2/%E5%8C%97%E4%BA%AC%E6%B8%85%E8%8F%AF%E5%A4%A7%E5%AD%B8)

title: RTHK to air Asian Para Games live with sign language, public viewings
zh_title: 香港电台将以手语直播亚洲残疾人运动会并供公众观看
summary: 香港电台TV31将于明日至10月24日直播亚洲残疾人运动会小组赛和重要赛事，并配有手语翻译。香港将派出约80名运动员参加10个项目，并在18个地区和商场进行公众观看。 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 2026 年 10 月 15 日 06:00 HKT · 2 分钟阅读 RTHK TV31将在香港独家直播亚残运小组赛及重要赛事开赛
content:
香港
香港电台 TV31 将于明天至 10 月 24 日直播亚洲残疾人运动会小组赛和重要赛事，并配有手语翻译。香港将派出约80名运动员参加10个项目，并在18个地区和商场进行公众观看。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

2026 年 10 月 15 日 06:00 香港时间 · 阅读 2 分钟

香港电台 TV31 宣布，将于明日至 10 月 24 日在香港为亚洲残疾人运动会小组赛和重要赛事提供独家现场直播，并配备同步手语翻译，以促进社会共融。

报道将使公众能够为国家队和香港队的残疾人运动员加油。香港电台高级执行制片人余恭蕙指出，自香港电台在 2021 年东京残奥会期间首次播放大型残疾人体育赛事以来，收到了积极的社会反馈。

于补充说，今年的制作，电视台已经动员了专门的人力，并强调直播时间表可能需要实时调整，以跟踪运动员的进度和即将举行的比赛的时间表。她说，还必须协调深入的背景研究，以便为主持人向观众提供更多背景信息。
加入转播团队的还有曾在2024年巴黎残奥会上为香港夺得轮椅羽毛球银牌的陈浩源。去年十五运会首次担任东道主的这位运动员，希望能够分享残奥运动员在面对不同对手时的励志故事或准备工作。

第五届亚洲残疾人运动会的现场报道将在香港电台TV31、香港电台YouTube频道、其网站和“RTHK On the Go”应用程序上进行直播。康乐及文化事务署辖下18区的「亚运焦点场地」及多个商场亦会安排公众观赏。

香港将派出约80名运动员组成的代表团参加本届运动会，参加10个大项的比赛。在周一的启动集会及加油活动中，文化体育及旅游局副局长刘俊赞扬残奥运动员体现了坚韧不拔、永不放弃的香港精神，并称体育是团结社会的重要桥梁。

手语翻译梁凯欣对香港电台提供的热心翻译服务深表谢意，称这是让听障观众充分沉浸在体育运动中的重要“窗口”。自东京残奥会以来一直为香港电台翻译体育赛事的梁先生表示，如果没有实时手语翻译，听障人士无法完全理解运动员的表现。
她指出，体育赛事直播口译面临着独特的挑战，需要进行大量准备，因为口译员必须事先深入研究每个学科。梁女士表示，网上网友称赞口译员迷人且精准的面部表情，她相信这种关注有助于推广手语并提高公众意识。

[![图片3：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

【原文 English Original】
Hong Kong
RTHK TV31 will broadcast Asian Para Games group stages and key events live from tomorrow to October 24 with sign language interpretation. Hong Kong will send about 80 athletes across 10 sports, with public viewings at 18 districts and shopping malls.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

15 Oct 2026 at 06:00 HKT · 2 min read

RTHK TV31 will provide exclusive live broadcast in Hong Kong for the Asian Para Games group stages and key events starting tomorrow through October 24, featuring simultaneous sign language interpretation to promote social inclusion, the broadcaster announced.

The coverage will enable the public to cheer on para athletes from both the national team and the Hong Kong team. Senior Executive Producer at RTHK, Christine Yu, noted the positive social feedback received since RTHK's first major para-sports broadcast during the 2021 Tokyo Paralympics.

Yu added that the broadcaster has mobilised dedicated manpower for this year's production, stressing that the live broadcast schedule may need to be adjusted in real time to track the progress of the athletes and the schedules of their upcoming matches. Intensive background research must also be coordinated to provide the hosts with more context for the audience, she said.

Joining the broadcast team is Daniel Chan Ho-yuen, who won a silver in wheelchair badminton for Hong Kong at the 2024 Paris Paralympics. Having debuted as a host during last year's 15th National Games, the athlete expects to share the inspiring backstories or preparations of the para athletes when facing different opponents.

Live coverage of the 5th Asian Para Games will stream on RTHK TV31, RTHK's YouTube channel, its website, and the "RTHK On the Go" app. Public viewings will also be set up at the Leisure and Cultural Services Department's "Asian Games Focal Sites" across 18 districts, as well as in various shopping malls.

Hong Kong will send a delegation of approximately 80 athletes to compete across 10 sports at the Games. During the launch rally and cheering event on Monday, Under Secretary for Culture, Sports and Tourism Raistlin Lau Chun praised the para athletes for embodying the resilient, never-give-up Hong Kong spirit, calling sports a vital bridge that unites the community.

Sign language interpreter Leung Hoi-yan expressed deep gratitude to RTHK for providing dedicated translation services, calling it a vital "window" that allows hearing-impaired audiences to fully immerse themselves in sports. Leung, who has been interpreting live sporting events for RTHK since the Tokyo Paralympics, said hearing-impaired individuals cannot fully comprehend athletes' performances without real-time sign language interpretation.

She noted that interpreting live sports presents unique challenges requiring extensive preparation, as interpreters must deeply study each discipline beforehand. Leung shared that online netizens have praised the interpreters' engaging and precise facial expressions, and she believes this attention helps promote sign language and raises public awareness.

很多人健身後，會喝無糖豆漿來補充蛋白質，看似少負擔，不過，營養師蔡正亮表示，無糖豆漿的脂肪含量其實不低，若與低脂鮮奶相比，特濃無糖豆漿的脂肪含量，約是低脂鮮奶的2至3倍。

蔡正亮在臉書粉專[「蔡正亮營養師專欄教室」](https://www.facebook.com/nutrition12345/posts/pfbid0URBtHzNVH1Z9unF6MsoTBZnUuKWS1opyeVtV5wK6xdw4Vqev7ZpKgKd6nFVJ9mACl)發文指出，說到豆漿，大家想到的通常就是高蛋白、低熱量、沒有膽固醇，但真相是無糖豆漿的脂肪含量，沒有大家想像中那麼低，甚至有些高蛋白濃豆漿，脂肪含量已接近全脂鮮奶。

蔡正亮指出，一般全脂鮮奶，每100c.c大約含3至4公克脂肪；低脂鮮奶約1至1.5公克，一般市售無糖豆漿，每100c.c大約含1.5至2.5公克脂肪，部分濃無糖豆漿甚至達3公克以上，如果跟低脂鮮奶相比，濃無糖豆漿的脂肪含量，反而是低脂鮮奶的2至3倍。

蔡正亮表示，濃無糖豆漿深受健身族青睞，因為使用更多黃豆原料，但蛋白質增加的同時，脂肪含量也會跟著提高。舉例來說，一瓶400c.c的濃無糖豆漿，如果每100c.c含有2.5公克脂肪，整瓶喝完就攝取了10公克脂肪，光是脂肪就提供90大卡熱量，這還不包括蛋白質及碳水化合物的熱量。

蔡正亮表示，黃豆本身沒有膽固醇，能提供植物性蛋白質，對於想增加植物性食物攝取的人來說，是不錯的選擇。但豆漿裡面的脂肪，每公克仍有9大卡熱量，如果正在減脂，且平時三餐攝取已相當充足，一天喝好幾瓶濃豆漿，仍可能導致全天總熱量超出需求，影響減脂成效。

title: Hong Kong election committee nominations close; 31 of 36 sectors oversubscribed
zh_title: 香港选举委员会提名结束； 36个行业中的31个行业获得超额认购
summary: 香港选举委员会界别分组选举提名已于 10 月 20 日结束，36 个当选界别分组中有 31 个获得超额认购。共收到1,115份候选人提名和40份团体提名。 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 2026 年 10 月 20 日香港时间 10:51 · 2 分钟阅读 提名2026 年选举委员会界别分组一般选举已于星期二（10 月 20 日）结束。截至最后一个工作日，返乡人员
content:
香港
香港选举委员会界别分组选举的提名已于10月20日结束，36个当选界别分组中有31个获得超额认购。共收到1,115份候选人提名和40份团体提名。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

香港时间 2026 年 10 月 20 日 10:51 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

2026 年选举委员会界别分组一般选举提名已于周二（10 月 20 日）截止。根据官方数字，截至最后一个工作日，相关界别分组的选举主任已收到1,115份候选人提名表格和40份指定团体提名表格。

选举委员的36个界别分组中，有31个界别分组获得超额认购，其余5个界别分组的候选人人数与议席完全相同。在第一板块，所有18个分板块均出现超额认购。第二界别分组中，10个界别分组中有8个出现超额认购，其中竞争最激烈的是社会福利界别分组，有25名候选人角逐15个议席，以及医疗卫生界界别分组，有23名候选人角逐15个议席。

在第三部门，渔业和基层组织分部门均超额认购。渔业界别分组有72名候选人，争夺60个议席；基层组织界别分组有75名候选人，争夺60个议席。
第四组别分组中，代表港九区委员会、扑灭罪案委员会及消防安全委员会委员的界别分组有88名候选人，争夺76个议席；新界界别分组则有93名候选人，争夺80个议席。

五个界别分组拥有相同数目的候选人及议席：教育界；体育、表演艺术、文化和出版分部门；同乡会界别分组；劳工分部门；代表国家机构香港成员的界别分组。若所有候选人均获确认符合资格，且无人退出，则该界别分组无需投票，候选人将自动当选。

选举委员会选举定于 11 月 22 日举行，届时将选出一个由 1,500 名成员组成的新选举委员会。五个界别各有300个议席，其中982个界别分组选举议席、156个指定团体提名议席和362个当然议席。

[![图片3：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

主编

负责 CLB.org.hk 报道和编辑标准的主编。

【原文 English Original】
Hong Kong
Nominations for Hong Kong's Election Committee subsector elections ended on 20 October, with 31 of 36 elected subsectors oversubscribed. A total of 1,115 candidate nominations and 40 group nominations were received.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

20 Oct 2026 at 10:51 HKT · 2 min read

Nominations for the 2026 Election Committee subsector ordinary elections closed on Tuesday (20 October). As of the last working day, returning officers in the relevant subsectors had received 1,115 candidate nomination forms and 40 designated group nomination forms, according to official figures.

Of the 36 subsectors that elect committee members, 31 are oversubscribed, while the remaining five have exactly the same number of candidates as seats. In the first sector, all 18 subsectors are oversubscribed. In the second sector, eight of ten subsectors are oversubscribed, with the most competitive being the social welfare subsector, where 25 candidates are vying for 15 seats, and the medical and health services subsector, where 23 candidates are contesting 15 seats.

In the third sector, both the fisheries and grassroots organisations subsectors are oversubscribed. The fisheries subsector has 72 candidates for 60 seats, while the grassroots organisations subsector has 75 candidates for 60 seats.

In the fourth sector, the subsector representing members of the Hong Kong and Kowloon district committees, fighting crime committees, and fire safety committees has 88 candidates for 76 seats, while the equivalent New Territories subsector has 93 candidates for 80 seats.

Five subsectors have an equal number of candidates and seats: the education subsector; the sports, performing arts, culture and publishing subsector; the fellow townsmen associations subsector; the labour subsector; and the subsector representing Hong Kong members of national bodies. If all candidates are confirmed as qualified and no one withdraws, these subsectors will not require a vote and candidates will be declared elected automatically.

The Election Committee election is scheduled for 22 November, when a new 1,500-member Election Committee will be chosen. Each of the five sectors holds 300 seats, with 982 seats elected by subsectors, 156 seats nominated by designated groups, and 362 ex-officio seats.

[![Image 3: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

# Taiwan, Philippines sign animal husbandry research pact

10/19/2026 07:26 PM

Photo courtesy of Taiwan's Ministry of Agriculture

Taipei, Oct. 19 (CNA) Taiwan and the Philippines have signed a memorandum of understanding (MOU) to strengthen cooperation in animal husbandry research, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MOFA) said in a press statement Monday.

The MOU was signed by Taiwan's representative to the Philippines, Wallace Chow (周民淦), and his Philippine counterpart, Corazon Avecilla-Padiernos, at the end of the 13th meeting of a technical group on agricultural cooperation in Cebu, the Philippines, on Friday, MOFA said.

The annual meeting has been held since the two countries signed an agreement in 2005 to promote agricultural and fisheries cooperation, MOFA said.

In a separate press release, the Ministry of Agriculture (MOA) said Deputy Agriculture Minister Tu Wen-jane (杜文珍) and Livestock Research Institute Director Huang Chen-fang (黃振芳) traveled to Cebu for Friday's meeting.

In addition to signing the MOU, Taiwanese representatives held talks with their Philippine counterparts on the potential export of Taiwan's atemoya and animal products to the Philippines, the MOA said.

(By Joseph Yeh)

We have a state of emergency declared in Virginia!

And right now we’re seeing what looks like a massive police state closing in on the state capitol where there will be a huge rally on Monday.

This is a very divisive issue that’s generating a lot of media spin and disinformation. And chaos could break out in Richmond.

It is crucial that there be independent, on-the-ground reporting in Richmond, especially given what happened in Charlottesville — where many people argue police actually instigated some of the violence and things definitely got out of hand.

In the past, when massive Yellow Vests protests were taking place in Paris, I was there [reporting on the ground](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hTzwJqUPeqk) and risking safety as protesters were losing eyes due to police brutality. I have also been to places like [Somalia,](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UooepLs3Fqs)[Venezuela](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UOQb7Y5QVO8) and[Cheran](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=r3qRm3sXVRU), once the most violent, dangerous area in Mexico. And more recently, I reported on the ground amid huge protests in Hong Kong.

Now lots of people are asking me to go to Richmond, so they can get the truth about what’s happening there.

So I’ve decided to go, if we can raise enough funds for it.

A trip to Virginia isn’t as expensive as going to Hong Kong, where I provided you in-depth, on-the-ground reports on one of the world’s most important protest movements.

But it’s not free either. I still need to cover airfare/gas, hotel and equipment expenses. And I’m planning on hiring a cameraman and video editor. I estimate this will cost around $1,500.

If you value reporting on the events in Virginia that is free of spin and manipulation and provides a real, honest look at what is happening, then your support is essential.

Thank you so much for funding independent media and for allowing me to continue doing the job I love!

# Legal Defense for Hong Kong Democracy Activists

The Lantos Foundation for Human Rights & Justice stands with the people of Hong Kong on the front lines of the fight for freedom & democracy.Courageous Hong Kong democracy activists have been protesting for months against a dangerous Chinese extradition bill that would have undermined their independence and freedom. Though the bill has now been formally withdrawn, the fight is not over. Since June, thousands of protesters have been attacked and injured by police and mainland gangs and over 1,100 people have been detained. Those arrested for peacefully protesting have been charged with offenses that could put them in jail for many years.Hong Kong Democracy protesters have won the first huge victory in the court of public opinion, but the next victories will need to be won in the courts of law.Just a few months ago, the Lantos Foundation was proud to give our highest award to the most recognizable leader of the democracy movement – Joshua Wong. While such leadership is important, all of the brave democracy crusaders deserve more than our admiration. We must equip them to defend themselves against the crushing apparatus of the Chinese communist state. This legal defense fund aims to support Joshua and his compatriots as they defend themselves against false accusations that could land them in prison for years to come.Our hope is that we can match their courage and determination in the form of financial support that will ensure they have fair representation. It is critical that the rule of law be upheld at this pivotal moment in Hong Kong's history. The eyes of the world may be on Hong Kong, but the eyes of history will be on those of us enjoying our own freedom and democracy - let us match our words and good wishes with the resources to defend those on the front lines of this fight for freedom.These legal defense funds will be officially disbursed through the Lantos Foundation's Front Line Fund grant program.

# Fund Independent Reporting In HONG KONG

Fund Independent Reporting In HONG KONG You know something big is happening in Hong Kong!! The protests have been massive, and they may be the biggest geopolitical event of the year. Will China get its way and stomp out dissent? Might covert U.S. aid allow the protesters to sustain their momentum? Needless to say, there is a lot at stake and lots of speculation!!And because of that it’s important for there to be independent, on-the-ground reporting about the events in Hong Kong. When massive Yellow Vests protests were taking place in Paris, We Are Change was there reporting on the ground and risking safety as protesters were losing eyes due to police brutality. # 2 suspects in Kaohsiung homicide case brought back from South Korea

10/18/2026 05:11 PM

A suspect who allegedly fled to South Korea with another after taking part in a fatal assault in Kaohsiung last month is escorted by authorities upon arriving at Taoyuan International Airport. Photo courtesy of Kaohsiung City Police Department's Criminal Investigation Corps.

Kaohsiung, Oct. 18 (CNA) Two suspects who allegedly fled to South Korea after taking part in a fatal assault in Nanzih District, Kaohsiung, last month have been brought back to Taiwan and taken into custody, police said Sunday.

The suspects, a 25-year-old used-car dealership owner surnamed Lin (林) and a 23-year-old employee surnamed Liu (劉), arrived at Taiwan Taoyuan International Airport on Saturday, where they were arrested by a special team investigating the case, according to the Kaohsiung City Police Department's Criminal Investigation Corps.

South Korean police apprehended the two after Taiwan's Criminal Investigation Bureau requested assistance through its liaison officer in South Korea, according to the corps.

Investigators suspect that Lin orchestrated the assault and that Liu took part in beating the victim. Both men have denied any wrongdoing, and the investigation is ongoing.

The case involving Lin and Liu came to light on Sept. 30, when a 22-year-old man surnamed Mu (穆) called the Nanzih Precinct of the Kaohsiung City Police Department to report that he had accidentally beaten a coworker to death.

Mu later drove the victim's body to the police station and turned himself in.

Prosecutors allege that Mu, Liu and several others assaulted a coworker surnamed Chang (張) at Lin's used-car dealership at around 1 a.m. on Sept. 30, striking his head, buttocks and limbs with hot-melt glue sticks and clubs.

Mu told police the attack stemmed from a dispute over NT$100,000 (US$3,079) the victim allegedly owed.

Police had initially questioned Lin and Liu before releasing the pair on Oct. 1, but investigators subsequently gathered more evidence linking them to the case. According to police, prosecutors later identified the two as key suspects.

When authorities could not locate the two for further questioning, they discovered that the pair had flown to South Korea on Oct. 2. Prosecutors then issued warrants for both men's arrest.

Mu and three other suspects surnamed Wu (吳), Yeh (葉) and Chen (陳) have been ordered detained on suspicion of murder after prosecutors argued they were flight risks and could coordinate their accounts or tamper with evidence.

A juvenile surnamed Huang (黃) has been referred to juvenile court.

(By Chang Yi-lien and Evelyn Kao)

 非洲足球 / 非洲足球协会联合会（CAF-Confédération Africaine de Football）冠军联赛（Ligue des champions de la CAF）的冠军奖金金额现已增加200万美元，攀升至600万美元。 Image d'archive / RFI Afrique Foot : La Ligue des champions de la CAF - Confédération Africaine de Football passera à 6 millions de dollars, soit une augmentation de 2 millions de dollars. [非洲](https://www.rfi.fr/cn/%E9%9D%9E%E6%B4%B2/)足球协会联合会（CAF-Confédération Africaine de Football）冠军联赛（[Ligue des champions de la CAF](https://www.rfi.fr/fr/tag/ligue-des-champions-caf/)）的冠军奖金金额现已增加200万美元，攀升至600万美元。
