# M1A2T tanks to roll into Taiwan's Lien Yung military drill next month

10/19/2026 02:11 PM

[](jsvscript:)[](jsvscript:)[](javascript:void(0))[Listen](javascript:)

[Link](javascript:)[Whatsapp](javascript:)[Reddit](javascript:)[Line](javascript:)[Email](javascript:)

To activate the text-to-speech service, please first agree to the privacy policy below.

A M1A2T Tank. CNA file photo

Taipei, Oct. 19 (CNA) American-made M1A2T Abrams tanks will participate in a major Taiwan military exercise for the second time, when Lien Yung drills begin next month, a military source told CNA on Monday.

The Army's 584th Armored Brigade, which operates the American-made tanks, has already transported them to the Joint Operations Training Base in Pingtung County for the upcoming Lien Yung drill (聯勇操演), scheduled for late November through December, according to the source.

During the month-long joint military exercise in southern Taiwan, the tanks will test combat coordination, said the source, who asked not to be named.

The M1A2T Abrams tanks were included in a major Taiwan military drill for the first time when the country held its annual Han Kuang exercises in August.

The nationwide Han Kuang exercises, which include live-fire drills, are Taiwan's major military exercise, while the Lien Yung drills are the second-largest.

Held in southern Taiwan, the Lien Yung exercises serve as a major test of coordination among the three branches of the country's armed forces -- the Army, Navy and Air Force -- in jointly repelling an invading enemy.

Conscripts serving their mandatory one-year military service will also participate in this year's Lien Yung drills, the source said.

Su Tzu-yun (蘇紫雲), director of the Division of Defense Strategy and Resources at the Institute for National Defense and Security Research (INDSR), told CNA on Monday that the M1A2T Abrams tanks are currently operated only by volunteer soldiers, not conscripts.

Su Tzu-yun, director of the Division of Defense Strategy and Resources at the Institute for National Defense and Security Research. CNA file photo

However, it is important for conscripts to participate in large-scale live-fire exercises such as the Lien Yung drill to receive more advanced training, Su added.

Under a deal approved by Washington in 2019, Taiwan has procured 108 M1A2T Abrams tanks from the United States at a cost of about US$1.45 billion (NT$40.5 billion).

Of the 108 Abrams tanks, 38 were commissioned by the Taiwan Army's 584th Armored Brigade in late October 2025, and 42 in April this year. The other 28 are still being tested and prepared for service.

For the second time, the Army will use the Abrams tanks in a major military drill, when the Lien Yung exercises get underway in southern Taiwan next month.

(By Matt Yu and Joseph Yeh)

title: Recovering from Religion Support Group Meeting - South Carolina Chapter, Wed, Oct 28, 2026, 6:30 PM   | Meetup
summary: The South Carolina Chapter Recovering from Religion support group will meet the fourth Wednesday or each month at 6pm Eastern. **This meeting will be held in-person at the We Are Family community room located at 3265 North Carolina Avenue,
content:
The South Carolina Chapter Recovering from Religion support group will meet the fourth Wednesday or each month at 6pm Eastern. **This meeting will be held in-person at the We Are Family community room located at 3265 North Carolina Avenue, Suite 202 in North Charleston.** Attendees are welcome to share, but may also decide to remain anonymous if they so choose.

Light refreshments will be provided. Please contact one of the event hosts if you have any questions or concerns ahead of the meeting.

The primary focus of a Recovering from Religion support group is to provide ongoing support to individuals as they let go of their religious beliefs. This transitional period is an ongoing process that can result in a range of emotions, as well as a ripple effect of consequences throughout an individual’s life. As such, the support meetings are safe and anonymous places to express these doubts, fears, and experiences without biased feedback or proselytizing.
 We are here to help each other through this journey.

There is no cost to attend this support group but, if you feel so inclined, donations can be made at [www.recoveringfromreligion.org/donate](http://www.recoveringfromreligion.org/donate)

If you'd like to provide confidential feedback for this meeting, click here [https://forms.gle/yhC7frShmyrRS56G7](https://forms.gle/yhC7frShmyrRS56G7)

If you find you need to talk with someone before the next support meeting, RfR has a hotline and online chat for that express purpose. Call [844-368-2848](http://tel:+18443682848/) to speak with someone. To chat online, go to [www.recoveringfromreligion.org](http://www.recoveringfromreligion.org/) and click on the green chat bubble in the lower left corner of the site.

If you are in need of professional help, we can recommend the Secular Therapy Project to provide options to connect with a professional therapist. All therapists have been thoroughly vetted by our organization and offer only evidence-based and non-religious treatment. Connect with them at [www.seculartherapy.org.](http://www.seculartherapy.org./)

Like what RfR does? Why not volunteer! There are quite a few options. Head over to [RfR Volunteer Form](https://www.recoveringfromreligion.org/volunteer) for more info.

I have a condition called Osteogenesis Imperfect (OI Brittle Bones). When I was younger I would break my bones all the time. They would break so easily that the I would cough or sneeze my ribs would break. Each year, my bones became stronger because of all the medication and rodding surgeries. Thanks to Shriners Children’s Hospital. I have not broken anything since I was in 8th grade. My parents Keith and Cheryl Wyse adopted my twin and me from Taiwan. I was 21 months old when we came to the United States. When I was little doctors told my parents that I would not be able to sit up, walk with crutches, or do anything for myself. Today I am able to do all those and even drive. I am grateful they gave me a second chance at a wonderful life.Being able to drive to work and drive to school independently is one of my many dreams I wish to achieve. # China announces export controls for tunnel boring machines

Key piece of equipment for construction in neighboring India deemed dual-use item

Workers inspect a tunnel boring machine at a workshop of Jinan Heavy Machinery in Jinan,China, on May 11, 2019. Starting Nov. 18, the construction equipment will be subject to China's export control rules. © Reuters

October 19, 2026 17:37 JST

[](https://twitter.com/share?text=China+announces+export+controls+for+tunnel+boring+machines&url=https%3A%2F%2Fasia.nikkei.com%2Feconomy%2Fchina-announces-export-controls-for-tunnel-boring-machines&via=NikkeiAsia)[](https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=https%3A%2F%2Fasia.nikkei.com%2Feconomy%2Fchina-announces-export-controls-for-tunnel-boring-machines)[](https://api.whatsapp.com/send?text=China+announces+export+controls+for+tunnel+boring+machines+https%3A%2F%2Fasia.nikkei.com%2Feconomy%2Fchina-announces-export-controls-for-tunnel-boring-machines)[](https://t.me/share/url?text=China+announces+export+controls+for+tunnel+boring+machines&url=https%3A%2F%2Fasia.nikkei.com%2Feconomy%2Fchina-announces-export-controls-for-tunnel-boring-machines)[](mailto:?subject=China%20announces%20export%20controls%20for%20tunnel%20boring%20machines&body=https%3A%2F%2Fasia.nikkei.com%2Feconomy%2Fchina-announces-export-controls-for-tunnel-boring-machines)

BEIJING (Reuters) -- China's Commerce Ministry said on Monday it would set export controls on tunnel boring machines, a key piece of equipment for construction in neighboring India.

India remains heavily dependent on imported tunnel boring machines, underscoring the country's long-standing struggle to build domestic manufacturing capacity. China is among the key suppliers of tunneling and other boring equipment used in metro rail and highway construction.

China's Commerce Ministry said export operators would need to apply for a license in accordance with provisions of export control law and regulations on the export control of dual-use items.

Advertisement

The restrictions go into effect on Nov. 18.

It also said it would adjust export control measures for drone-related items and dredgers, part of updates to the country's dual-use items exports list.

title: Australia gets the ball rolling on medium-range air defense
zh_title: 澳大利亚在中程防空方面取得进展

content:
澳大利亚珀斯——为了保护整个大陆，澳大利亚只有一个团的 NASAMS 短程防空系统。堪培拉认识到这还不够，因此为澳大利亚陆军启动了中程陆基防空解决方案的正式招标。国防部于 10 月 13 日启动了该项目的行业招标，命名为 Project Land 6504。这一潜在交易已经引起了全球的兴趣，来自欧洲、以色列、韩国、土耳其和美国的供应商都关注着澳大利亚的需求。填补澳大利亚国防缺口的一个主要动机是中国不断增强的军事实力。令许多人震惊的是，中国人民解放军于 2025 年初派出海军特混舰队绕行澳大利亚，然后中国于今年 7 月向南太平洋发射了一枚洲际弹道导弹。由于中国拥有世界上最多样化的导弹库，澳大利亚知道它需要更好的防御。因此，Land 6504 正在寻找一种防御系统，能够在飞行末期击落弹道导弹，并应对亚音速吸气威胁。
《2026 年国防战略》将导弹防御列为优先事项，呼吁“通过投资导弹发射器和弹药，并将其与澳大利亚国防军的指挥和控制系统集成，加速引入中程、陆基、主动导弹防御。”招标书中写道，这个设想的现成系统预计将具有“经过验证的能力”，为国家综合系统做出贡献。然而，资金是一个长期存在的问题，因为 AUKUS 核动力潜艇吸收了可用的国防资金。但也许最大的风险是这个澳大利亚项目的进展速度之快。供应商的最终选择将于 2027 年底完成。解决方案是在 2029 年中期在护身军刀演习中进行实弹射击，并在 2030 年代初期实现初步作战能力。重要的是，远征防空系统必须与 CEA Technologies 的雷达以及澳大利亚洛克希德·马丁公司正在开发的联合空战管理系统集成。由于时间限制，堪培拉正在同时寻求直接商业销售和美国对外军售（FMS）途径。招标的时机可能会增加非美国导弹供应商的机会，因为美国在与伊朗的冲突中消耗了大量导弹后，正在努力解决弹匣耗尽的问题。国会研究服务部最近的一份报告警告说：“有限的美国
工业基础产能需要在满足 FMS 订单和补充美国库存之间进行权衡。 FMS 交付延迟可能会导致取消，从而可能影响美国和合作伙伴的互操作性和集成。”不过，还有其他选择。例如，澳大利亚可以在其现有的 NASAMS 中添加 AMRAAM-ER 增程导弹。康斯伯格澳大利亚公司董事总经理约翰·弗莱告诉《防务新闻》：“我们肯定对该计划感兴趣。我认为 NASAMS 架构的伟大之处在于康斯伯格和雷神公司正在将其发展为全谱防空系统。”在其他地方，澳大利亚洛克希德·马丁公司于 6 月利用“宙斯盾”作战系统和 CEA 雷达从拖车发射器发射了一枚 SM-2 导弹。这展示了混合防空系统如何利用澳大利亚现有的组件。

【原文 English Original】
PERTH, Australia — To protect a whole continent, Australia has only a regiment’s worth of NASAMS short-range air defense systems. Recognizing this is not nearly enough, Canberra has launched a formal tender for a medium-range, ground-based air defense solution for the Australian Army. The Department of Defence launched an industry solicitation for the project, christened Project Land 6504, on Oct. 13. The potential deal has already attracted interest globally, with vendors from Europe, Israel, South Korea, Turkey and the United States eying the requirement Down Under. A primary motivation for filling the gaping hole in Australian defenses is China’s rising military prowess. Alarming many, the People’s Liberation Army sent a naval task group to circumnavigate Australia in early 2025, and then China fired an intercontinental ballistic missile into the South Pacific in July this year. With China possessing the world’s most diverse missile arsenal, Australia knows it needs better defenses. Land 6504 is therefore looking for a defensive system capable of shooting down ballistic missiles in their terminal phase of flight, as well as address subsonic air-breathing threats. The National Defence Strategy 2026 prioritized missile defense, calling for “accelerated introduction of medium-range, ground-based, active missile defense through investment in missile launchers and munitions and integrating them with the Australian Defence Force’s command-and-control systems.” This envisioned off-the-shelf system is expected to be a “proven capability,” contributing to a national, integrated system, the solicitation reads. Money is a perennial problem, however, as AUKUS nuclear-powered submarines soak up available defense funds. But perhaps the greatest risk is the lightning speed at which this Australian project is moving. Final selection of the vendor is to occur by the end of 2027. The solution is to perform live-firing in Exercise Talisman Saber in mid-2029, and an initial operational capability achieved in the early 2030s. Importantly, the expeditionary air-defense system must integrate with radars from CEA Technologies and the Joint Air Battle Management System being developed by Lockheed Martin Australia. Because of the time constraints, Canberra is pursuing direct commercial sale and U.S. Foreign Military Sales (FMS) avenues simultaneously. The timing of the tender may boost the chances of non-American missile suppliers, as the U.S. grapples with depleted magazines after expending large amounts of missiles in its conflict with Iran. A recent Congressional Research Service report warned , “Finite U.S. industrial base capacity introduces trade-offs between filling FMS orders and replenishing U.S. stockpiles. FMS delivery delays may result in cancellations, potentially affecting U.S. and partner interoperability and integration.” Other options are available, however. For example, Australia could add AMRAAM-ER extended-range missiles to its existing NASAMS. John Fry, managing director of Kongsberg Australia, told Defense News : “We’re definitely interested in that program. I think the great thing with the NASAMS architecture is Kongsberg and Raytheon are evolving that into full-spectrum air defense.” Elsewhere, Lockheed Martin Australia fired an SM-2 missile from a trailer launcher in June, utilizing the Aegis combat system and a CEA radar. This demonstrated how a hybrid air defense system can make use of components already available in Australia.

### Questions

[Is this donation tax deductible?](javascript:;)
Special Olympics Michigan is a 501(c)3 tax-exempt organization and your donation is tax-deductible within the guidelines of U.S. law. To claim a donation as a deduction on your U.S. taxes, please keep your email donation receipt as your official record. We'll send it to you upon successful completion of your donation.

[Can I submit donations via check?](javascript:;)
Yes! Please make checks payable to Special Olympics Michigan (SOMI). Donation checks may be mailed to: Special Olympics Michigan, Attn: Polar Plunge, Central Michigan University, Mt. Pleasant, MI 48859. Please be sure to include the plunger or team name and plunge location with the check so the donation can be credited to the correct plunger or team.

[Who do I contact with questions, comments, concerns?](javascript:;)
Please email us at plunge@somi.org with any questions, concerns, or comments.

[What if a plunge is cancelled?](javascript:;)
Special Olympics Michigan (SOMI) reserves the right to delay, shorten, or in rare circumstances, cancel the event due to inclement weather or a natural disaster. The safety of participants, spectators, and volunteers is our top priority. Event staff will partner with the National Weather Service (NWS) and local law enforcement agencies to ensure conditions are safe. SOMI will make all possible attempts by email, website, and social media to inform participants of any updates or changes.

## Details

Hello fellow maniacs of horror and welcome to Omaha Horror Community: Fright Club!

Happy Halloween my Ghosts and Ghouls! It's the most glorious time of the year and the weather finally matches the spooky season we live and love year round. The theme for this month will be Universal horror movies and the films on the chopping block this month are a mystery but will still be up for a vote on the day of the event!

The movie viewing will be preceded by themed trivia with prizes to be won and I’ll be ordering pizza and bringing snacks as well. Thirsty? Legend Comics and Coffee has an amazing selection of drinks for you to choose from!

For those interested, after the official event is over, we’ll head out into the Benson area to hang out some more.

This event is 18+ unless accompanied by an adult and please feel free to invite your friends!

title: HKEX pushes T+1 cash market settlement target to second half of 2028
zh_title: 香港交易所将T+1现货市场结算目标推迟至2028年下半年
summary: 香港交易及结算所已将现金市场实施T+1结算的目标由明年第四季度推迟至2028年下半年。此举是在征询了 109 份强烈支持的回复后采取的，并将采用三层实施框架 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编2026 年 10 月 16 日香港时间 18:01 · 更新于 10 月 17 日 04:24 · 1 分钟阅读香港交易及结算所 (0388) 于
content:
商务
香港交易及结算所已将现货市场实施T+1结算的目标从明年第四季度推迟至2028年下半年。此举是在征询了 109 份强烈支持意见后采取的，并将采用三层实施框架

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

2026 年 10 月 16 日，香港时间 18:01 · 更新于 10 月 17 日，04:24 · 阅读时间 1 分钟

香港交易及结算所(0388)周五表示，现货市场T+1结算周期目前的目标是在2028年下半年实施，推迟于明年第四季度，但须视市场准备情况和监管部门批准而定。

香港交易所运营商表示，已收到来自经纪商、托管人、投资管理人、行业协会、技术提供商、投资者和其他利益相关者对《香港现货市场加速结算咨询结论》的 109 份非重复回复。

香港交易所指出，受访者强烈支持向T+1结算过渡，认识到其在提高市场效率、降低结算风险、提高资本效率以及增强香港作为国际金融中心的竞争力方面的潜力。
在仔细考虑反馈意见并促进过渡后，香港交易所将采用三层实施框架，包括： 增强其自身的交易后基础设施和运营模式；开发有针对性的工作流程工具和服务；以及针对自身基础设施和运营模式之外的主题的市场实践和生态系统准备情况的全行业协调。

港交所表示，按照本土市场原则，港股通交易将继续遵循香港的结算安排，并推进至T+1。

报告称，稍后将进行全行业测试和准备评估，以帮助市场参与者熟悉新的和更新的安排。香港交易所补充说，将在监管部门批准和市场准备就绪的情况下适时宣布确切的过渡日期。

[![图片3：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

主编

负责 CLB.org.hk 报道和编辑标准的主编。

【原文 English Original】
Business
Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing has deferred the target for implementing T+1 settlement in the cash market to the second half of 2028, from the fourth quarter of next year. The move follows a consultation with 109 responses showing strong support, and will use a three-layer implementation framework

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

16 Oct 2026 at 18:01 HKT · updated 17 Oct, 04:24 · 1 min read

Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing (0388) said on Friday that the T+1 settlement cycle for the cash market now targets implementation in the second half of 2028, deferred from the fourth quarter of next year, subject to market readiness and regulatory approval.

The city's bourse operator said it received 109 non-duplicated responses from brokers, custodians, investment managers, industry associations, technology providers, investors and other stakeholders to The Consultation Conclusions on Accelerated Settlement for the Hong Kong Cash Market.

Respondents showed strong support for the transition to T+1 settlement, recognising its potential to enhance market efficiency, reduce settlement risk, improve capital efficiency and strengthen Hong Kong's competitiveness as an international financial centre, HKEX noted.

Following careful consideration of the feedback and to facilitate the transition, HKEX will adopt a three-layer implementation framework covering: enhancements to its own post-trade infrastructure and operating model; development of targeted workflow tools and services; and industry-wide coordination on market practices and ecosystem readiness for topics outside its own infrastructure and operating model.

Consistent with the home market principle, Southbound Stock Connect transactions will continue to follow Hong Kong's settlement arrangements and advance to T+1 as well, HKEX said.

Industry-wide testing and readiness assessments will be conducted at a later stage to help market participants familiarise themselves with the new and updated arrangements, it said. HKEX added that it will announce the exact transition date in due course, subject to regulatory approval and market readiness.

title: PetroChina on track for record trading profit as Iran war reshapes oil market
zh_title: 伊朗战争重塑石油市场，中石油有望实现创纪录的交易利润
summary: 由于伊朗战争扰乱了中东石油流动并提高了海外炼油厂的利润率，中石油预计今年将创下创纪录的贸易利润，其贸易部门PCI预计将超过200亿元人民币。截至 10 月初，其原油部门的盈利已比 2025 年增长一倍多 [![图片 1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 10 月 16 日2026 年 15:45 香港时间 · 2 分钟阅读 中石油 (0857) 全年营业利润有望创历史新高，五
content:
商务
由于伊朗战争扰乱了中东石油流动并提高了海外炼油厂的利润率，预计中石油今年将创下创纪录的贸易利润，其贸易部门PCI预计将超过200亿元人民币。截至 10 月初，其原油部门的 2025 年收益已增加一倍多

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

香港时间 2026 年 10 月 16 日 15:45 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

五名贸易高管表示，中石油(0857)今年的贸易利润有望创下历史新高，伊朗战争改变了中东石油买卖方式，在全球燃料市场吃紧的情况下，中石油(0857)在中国以外的炼油厂将获得丰厚的利润。

作为亚洲最大的石油和天然气生产商和中国第二大炼油厂，中石油正在从庞大的生产和供应组合以及广泛的炼油和零售网络中获利，这些网络有助于使其免受战争造成的破坏。

两名知情人士称，中国国有公司旗下交易平台中石油国际 (PCI) 的毛利润预计将在 2026 年突破 200 亿元人民币（234.7 亿港元），创历史新高。由于未获授权与媒体交谈，两位知情人士要求匿名。
两位贸易高管之一表示，到 10 月初，其原油部门（通常占 PCI 一半以上的利润）在 2025 年全年的盈利增加了一倍多，燃料产品和天然气部门也表现强劲。中石油没有立即回应置评请求。

这家中国炼油商并未在公开财务业绩中公布交易利润，8月份公布的上半年净利润约为146.5亿美元。 PCI 的业绩与整个石油行业的丰厚交易收益一致，欧洲主要石油公司 BP、壳牌和 TotalEnergies 的交易部门在伊朗战争的最初几个月赚取了数十亿美元。

董事长戴厚良今年3月表示，霍尔木兹海峡是受战争干扰的石油和天然气贸易流动的咽喉要道，仅占中石油系统原油和天然气需求的10%。相比之下，国内同行中石化（0386）是全球产能最大的炼油商，由于其大约一半的石油依赖中东，因此更容易受到供应中断的影响。
一位贸易高管表示，PCI 的原油交易收益是由实物货物利润推动的，因为中东生产商（不包括伊朗）降低了石油出口价格。套利贸易或地区之间的货物流动也为利润做出了贡献。由于伊朗战争和俄罗斯-乌克兰战争导致燃料市场收紧，中石油的海外炼油厂的大幅利润也支撑了中石油的交易。

伊朗战争促使以阿布扎比国家石油公司为首的海湾生产商部署穿梭船队穿越霍尔木兹海峡运送石油并通过现货招标出售，而生产商则纷纷降价以抵消不断飙升的运费。沙特阿拉伯国家石油公司 (Saudi Aramco) 最近将面向亚洲买家的官方售价降至六年来的最低水平，伊拉克国有石油销售商 SOMO 将其码头装货折扣加深至每桶 30 美元以上。中石油是在伊拉克生产石油的最大外国公司，也是在海湾地区装载伊拉克廉价石油的公司之一。

PetroChina is expected to post record trading profits this year, with its trading arm PCI projected to exceed 20 billion yuan, as the Iran war disrupts Middle East oil flows and boosts margins at its overseas refineries. Its crude division has already more than doubled 2025 earnings by early October

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

16 Oct 2026 at 15:45 HKT · 2 min read

PetroChina (0857) is poised for a record year in trading profits, five trading executives said, with its refineries outside China reaping bumper margins amid tight global fuel markets as the Iran war transforms the way Middle East oil is bought and sold.

PetroChina, Asia's largest oil and gas producer and China's second-biggest refiner, is cashing in on a large production and supply portfolio and an extensive refining and retail network that have helped insulate it from war-induced disruptions.

Gross profits at the state company's trading vehicle PetroChina International (PCI) are expected to top 20 billion yuan (HK$23.47 billion) for 2026, a record, two of the people briefed on the matter said, speaking on the condition of anonymity as they are not authorised to speak with media.

By early October, its crude oil division, which typically generates over half of PCI's profits, had more than doubled earnings for the whole of 2025, with fuel products and natural gas departments also performing strongly, one of the two trading executives said. PetroChina did not immediately respond to a request for comment.

The Chinese refiner, which does not break out trading profits in its public financial results, posted a first-half net profit of around US$14.65 billion for the whole group in August. PCI's performance was in line with bumper trading earnings across the petroleum sector, with trading desks at European majors BP, Shell and TotalEnergies earning billions of dollars in the early months of the Iran war.

The Strait of Hormuz, a chokepoint for oil and gas trade flows disrupted by the war, accounts for just 10 per cent of PetroChina's system requirements for both crude oil and natural gas, Chairman Dai Houliang said in March. In contrast, domestic peer Sinopec (0386), the world's biggest refiner by capacity, has been more vulnerable to the supply disruptions as it relies on the Middle East for roughly half its oil.

PCI's crude trading gains have been driven by profits made on physical cargoes as Middle Eastern producers, excluding Iran, cut prices to export oil, said one trading executive. Arbitrage trade, or cargo movements between regions, has also contributed to profits. PetroChina's trading is also supported by wide margins at its overseas refineries as both the Iran war and the Russia-Ukraine war have tightened fuel markets.

The Iran war has prompted Gulf producers led by Abu Dhabi National Oil Company to deploy shuttle fleets to ship oil across the Strait of Hormuz and sell via spot tenders, while producers have cut prices to offset soaring freight costs. Saudi Aramco recently lowered its official selling prices for Asian buyers to six-year lows, and Iraq's state oil marketer SOMO deepened discounts to more than US$30 a barrel for loading at its terminals. PetroChina, the largest foreign company producing oil in Iraq, is among those to have loaded discounted Iraqi oil inside the Gulf.

title: Meta推出新款开放权重AI模型 宣称可与中国匹敌
summary: （法新社旧金山15日电） Meta推出新款开放权重AI模型Muse Spark Open，宣称性能可与中国顶尖开发商匹敌，部分表现更胜一筹。 发表时间： 16/10/2026 - 08:01 6 分钟 浏览时间 Meta指出，此模型亦进一步针对苹果（Apple）先进的M5 Ultra晶片「最佳化」，外界认为这代表两大科技巨擘之间罕见的合作关系。 Meta今天推出新款开放权重（open-weight）AI模型，宣称可与中国主要开发商的同类产品较劲，部分情况下表现甚至更优。Met
content:
（法新社旧金山15日电） Meta推出新款开放权重AI模型Muse Spark Open，宣称性能可与中国顶尖开发商匹敌，部分表现更胜一筹。

发表时间： 16/10/2026 - 08:01

6 分钟 浏览时间

Meta指出，此模型亦进一步针对苹果（Apple）先进的M5 Ultra晶片「最佳化」，外界认为这代表两大科技巨擘之间罕见的合作关系。

Meta今天推出新款开放权重（open-weight）AI模型，宣称可与中国主要开发商的同类产品较劲，部分情况下表现甚至更优。Meta人工智慧长汪滔（Alexandr Wang）在X平台写道，Muse Spark Open「是迄今最强大的美国开放权重模型」。

有别于所谓封闭式模型，例如Anthropic的Claude或OpenAI的ChatGPT，开发者可下载开放权重模型的参数（即权重），再进行客制化。

过去几年，中国开发商已成为AI模型开放权重市场的主导者。

阿里巴巴（Alibaba）的通义千问（Qwen）、月之暗面（Moonshot AI）的Kimi K3，以及智谱（Z.ai）的GLM模型，长期以来被视为全球开放权重领域的领先者，但Meta宣称其新款开放模型如今已能在相近水准上竞争。

Meta在部落格贴文中说，Muse Spark Open「专为程式设计与代理工作打造」，「擅长长期任务、复杂软体工程与多步骤推理」，并补充新模型已整合「强大的安全防护措施」。

Meta执行长祖克柏（Mark Zuckerberg）在X平台写道，新模型「在新款Mac Studio上运行表现极佳，这要归功于」与苹果及其新任执行长特纳斯（John Ternus）的合作。

特纳斯于9月接替库克（Tim Cook）出任苹果掌门人，他回应说，「在桌上能以如此高效能执行Muse Spark Open此水准与规模的模型，真是太棒了。Mac Studio持续突破装置端AI的界限！」

不过，Muse Spark Open仍需要庞大算力。Meta表示，使用者可在两台搭载M5 Ultra晶片的Mac Studio运行此模型，在自己的桌面上打造一台「超级电脑」。

这项发表距离Meta宣布最新封闭式模型仅隔数天。

Meta已于12日发表名为Wonder与Wonder Full的两款新「前沿」模型，宣称可与最先进版本的ChatGPT和Claude相提并论。

Meta的AI发展最初聚焦于开放模型，但近来祖克柏已推动公司与OpenAI及Anthropic一较高下。

Meta于4月推出Spark模型，标志着与旗下开源模型Llama分道扬镳，后者表现落后于业界其他对手。

## Details

Volunteer to distribute food with Park Circle Cares. SHL will be supporting [Park Circle Cares](https://parkcirclecares.org/)’ monthly food distribution.

Park Circle Cares is a non-faith based, non-profit organization created in 2016 to assist people in the lowcountry who struggle with food insecurity. Park Circle Cares is a member agency with the Lowcountry Food Bank, and distributes 120-150 thousand pounds of food each year. What makes them unique among the many organizations working on the widespread problem of food insecurity in our community is that they only distribute healthy and nutritious foods, 75% of which is produce. Healthy dry goods and proteins make up the remainder.

Park Circle Cares is operated by an all-volunteer working board, and an enthusiastic group of volunteers who set up a farmers’ market style distribution at North Charleston High School on the third Saturday of each month.

summary: 香港当局正在审查广深高铁第二条南延线的三条初步路线，以连接香港北部都会区。该线路预计在“十五五”期间开工建设，将减少广州至 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编2026 年 10 月 15 日 13:30 香港时间 · 2 分钟阅读 第二条广深高铁开工建设
content:
香港
当局正在审查广深高铁第二条南延线的三条初步路线，以连接香港北部都会区。该线路预计在“十五五”期间开工建设，将减少广州至广州之间的出行。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

2026 年 10 月 15 日 13:30 香港时间 · 阅读 2 分钟

据当地媒体报道，第二条广深高铁预计将在“十五五”期间开始建设，当局目前正在评估其南延伸至香港北部都会区的三条初步路线选择。

报道称，深圳市发展和改革委员会去年8月启动了前期规划招标，正在评估南支线如何与北部城市融合。根据初步规划，正线起于广州北站，途经广州白云国际机场、广州黄埔、东莞市中心南城，终点为深圳机场东。
规划文件称，该铁路建成后，将实现广州与深圳核心城区之间30分钟直达，实现空铁联运无缝衔接，充分释放穗莞深港走廊一体化潜力。

对于南部延伸线，当局正在评估多条初步路线以及涵盖跨境通道、边境管制设施、客运量和项目成本的可行性评估。第一个方案是将高铁延伸至前海，旅客可在此转乘港深西铁跨境路段前往北方都会区。

第二个方案是南延线与港深西铁共享一条隧道走廊，两个系统在同一线路的不同轨道上运行，而新的高速支线则以洪水桥站为终点。第三条线路规划从深圳机场东向南延伸，经前海，然后通过地下隧道过境，到达北方都市的新高铁站。
香港特别行政区路政署表示，全长18.1公里的港深西铁将全在地下建设，包括长7.3公里的香港段和长10.8公里的深圳段。香港段设有洪水桥、厦村和流浮山三个车站，深圳段则设有深圳湾口岸和前海湾。

待筹备工作进展顺利后，香港段的招标工作可于明年展开，预计于2035年通车。立法会议员耀明建议，西铁线应探索向南延伸至香港国际机场，同时向北连接深圳宝安国际机场，形成空铁一体化网络。

Authorities are reviewing three preliminary alignments for the southern extension of the second Guangzhou-Shenzhen high-speed railway to connect with Hong Kong's Northern Metropolis. The line, expected to start construction during the 15th Five-Year Plan period, would cut travel between Guangzhou an

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

15 Oct 2026 at 13:30 HKT · 2 min read

Construction of the second Guangzhou-Shenzhen high-speed railway is expected to begin during the 15th Five-Year Plan period, with authorities now assessing three preliminary route options for its southern extension to link with Hong Kong's Northern Metropolis, according to local media reports.

The Shenzhen Municipal Development and Reform Commission launched pre-planning tender invitations last August and is evaluating how the southern spur can integrate with the Northern Metropolis, the reports said. The main line will start at Guangzhou North Station, pass through Guangzhou Baiyun International Airport, Guangzhou Huangpu and Nancheng in central Dongguan, and terminate at Shenzhen Airport East, according to the preliminary planning.

Upon completion, the railway will provide a 30-minute direct connection between the core urban areas of Guangzhou and Shenzhen, enable seamless air-rail intermodal transfers, and unlock the full integration potential of the Guangzhou-Dongguan-Shenzhen-Hong Kong corridor, the planning document stated.

For the southern extension, authorities are evaluating multiple preliminary routes alongside feasibility assessments covering cross-boundary passages, border control facilities, passenger volumes and project costs. The first option would extend the high-speed line to Qianhai, where travellers could interchange onto the cross-boundary segment of the Hong Kong-Shenzhen Western Rail Link to access the Northern Metropolis.

A second proposal would see the southern extension share a tunnel corridor with the Hong Kong-Shenzhen Western Rail Link, with the two systems running on separate tracks within the same alignment and the new high-speed spur terminating at Hung Shui Kiu station. The third routing plan extends south from Shenzhen Airport East through Qianhai, then crosses the border via an underground tunnel to a new high-speed rail station in the Northern Metropolis.

The Highways Department of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region said the 18.1-kilometre Hong Kong-Shenzhen Western Rail Link will be built entirely underground, comprising a 7.3-kilometre Hong Kong section and a 10.8-kilometre Shenzhen section. The Hong Kong section will feature three stations at Hung Shui Kiu, Ha Tsuen and Lau Fau Shan, while the Shenzhen section will include stops at Shenzhen Bay Port and Qianhaiwan.

Subject to preparatory progress, tendering works for the Hong Kong section may begin next year, with the line targeted to open in 2035. Lawmaker Yiu Ming suggested that the Western Rail Link should explore extending southward to Hong Kong International Airport while also connecting northward to Shenzhen Bao'an International Airport to form an integrated air-rail network.

title: Donate to Support the Contemporary Uyghur Anthology, organized by Uyghur Anthology
summary: The Contemporary Uyghur Anthology is a publication that platforms Uyghur (and anyone drawing their roots from East Turkistan) artists and writers in the diaspora by providing a space that is often inaccessible to those in our community. The
content:
The Contemporary Uyghur Anthology is a publication that platforms Uyghur (and anyone drawing their roots from East Turkistan) artists and writers in the diaspora by providing a space that is often inaccessible to those in our community. There are no other projects of its kind in the English language, and with two volumes already published, we hope to take this project to the next level. It's a rare look at Uyghur expression in an environment where all our stories are told by people pushing their own narratives without the intimate knowledge of our lived experiences.

<"Manifesto" by Sumayah Jurad from Vol. II>

We asked ourselves these questions - why wait for others to invite us to the table when we can pull up a chair and introduce ourselves? Why let others speak for us without trying first to speak? Our broken English can only be improved with audacity, and world literature is only enriched by the presence of new voices.

All-in-all, our efforts have been met with support from our community and pleasant surprise from those who did not know what they did not know.

Somewhat unprecedented is that we publish the authors' original language alongside the translation. Our book is filled with Uyghur, Latin, Cyrillic, and Chinese script to encapsulate as much of our community's experience as we can.

**Our Story**

There are many publications in diaspora communities that platform East and South Asians, SEA, MENA, and more. Central Asia is often underrepresented in world literature or Asia-specific publications, and occupied territories even less so. Uyghurs themselves have been a relatively new diaspora community in English-speaking countries, and haven't had the opportunities to grow their literary or artistic communities. Many don't have the tools to nurture their talents, or knowledge of creative networks or opportunities, even when many journals seek work from underrepresented groups. In instances where they are aware, it's difficult to be published in this competitive field without the education and styles that publications look for. There are only a handful of literary translators translating from Uyghur to English, and not many Uyghurs who have had the chances to develop their creative language when learning English.

To sum up, the issues were:

*   No spaces for Uyghur writers and artists to develop their skills
*   A disconnect from artist communities, be it local or online
*   Lack of awareness of opportunities
*   No bridge between our native tongue and English, and in turn, world literature

So, we put together a small group at the Tarim Network to take on this challenge. Completely volunteer-run; the very essence of a passion project. We did a call-out for anything and all. New writers, established writers, any language, any genre, whatever we could print in a book. And here we were, the first book of its kind, created to speak for ourselves without outsider voices, without a publishing house, raw and straight from the source.

<From the launch of Vol. I at Harvard University>

The blurb from our first volume:

_"The Contemporary Uyghur Anthology is a collection of Uyghur reflections in diaspora. Weaving together memories of the homeland, experiences of displacement, and transitions of identities, this anthology is a creative reflection of the beauty and complexities of the Uyghur experience._

_By centering Uyghur voices at the forefront, this anthology serves as a form of living memory in a pivotal moment of Uyghur history. The title Under the Mulberry Tree refers to a story from the Uyghur literary classic Ana Yurt, where youthful Nuri faces terrible injustices, separation, and turmoil; but for one moment in the Charbagh, his love for Sebihe and his own family is full, ripe, and sweet, like the mulberries from the ancient tree. In a similar way that the mulberry tree offered comforts in Nuri’s time of need, we hope this volume offers a place of reflection and celebration of Uyghur culture."_

We'd partnered with a member from a Jewish organisation to run writing workshops and explain editorial processes, as we had never worked on something like this before. After that collaboration, we decided to publish a revised edition on our own. This time, we added editors' notes to the pages to explain certain terms and historical and cultural contexts - mainly for our own youth, who don't always have access to cultural education. We translated more pieces from Uyghur and Chinese. Our contributors spanned 13 countries, at all levels of experience.

Was this work sustainable? Equipped with the tools, experience, and outpouring of support from our first volume, we spent the next two years saying yes. Our first book was now in libraries, there were articles and academic papers that mentioned it, and most of all, we reaffirmed the need for this sort of work. Not only were we accepting submissions, we worked one-on-one with emerging writers and artists to edit their pieces. We also helped first-time translators have their first publications with help from more experienced translators, as well as connecting them with the original authors.

Our second volume was even better than the last. From the blurb:

"How do we respond to the unexpected, and how does it influence perceptions of ourselves or the environments in which we exist? As a diaspora population, unexpected encounters can shape and transform what it means to be Uyghur as we build a new life outside of the homeland. Encounters Under the Mulberry Tree takes on the literal, abstract, and expanded renditions of these moments. We feature contemporary and historical works, including art, poetry, and prose in five languages with contributors based in a dozen countries, from established writers like award-winning author and filmmaker Tahir Hamut Izgil, to emerging artists, writers and translators of all ages. This book is a library of vignettes that grapple with intersections and how we make sense of it all."

Our stats:

*   44 pieces in total by 36 contributors
*   Five languages (Uyghur, English, Chinese, Russian, Turkish)
*   All work translated into English
*   11 translators
*   Contributors based in over 10 countries

<Vol. II showcased at a college hosted by Rawan Mentorship>

**Volume 3**

Now we embark on our third volume. The three of us do this while maintaining full time jobs, academic careers, and other side projects. We all live in different countries and have only met in person once. But it's something that we need to do, for our community and for ourselves. Our contributors have gained so much from this experience and we want to extend this opportunity to more people. This needs to survive in order for similar initiatives to be born.

**How we'd like to proceed**

*   **Supporting the editors -** all expenses so far have been paid out-of-pocket or through book sales. We do not have any donors or sponsors (yet!).
*   **Supporting our contributors -** we cannot afford to pay any of our contributors. Despite this, we have given free copies of the book to contributors, but this is definitely leaving a dent in our pockets.
*   **Recruiting more people -** paid internships or remuneration for one-off work would help volunteers spend more time on this project in this economy.
*   **Enhance our level of expertise -**we want to improve. Workshops or courses for our editors and contributors, professional feedback, the works. Unfortunately there is no one who speaks Uyghur and who is involved in Western publishing or English literature on a professional or academic level. We would appreciate connections with professionals from any language background, or the funding to level up.
*   **Expand our network -**we'd love to promote our work at literary festivals, go to conferences, do book events, establish ourselves in the public eye, provide reader copies to reviewers, and so on. However, there is a funding barrier to overcome to be able to attend these events, organise, or pre-order books.

<Vol. I on display at the Mosquers Film Festival, 2025>

**Who we are**

**Munawwar Abdulla** is an Uyghur advocate, poet, and scientist born on unceded Kaurna land (Australia) and based in Massachusetts. She co-founded The Tarim Network, runs Uyghur Collective, and collaborates on projects with Uyghur rights organisations around the world. Her writings and literary translations have been published in places such as Modern Poetry in Translation, Asymptote, the Margins, the Georgia Review, and others.

**Sonya Imin** is a mixed Uyghur American scholar and multi-disciplinary creative who has worked on art and film projects across the US, Europe, and Central Asia. Growing up between the borderlands of the Uyghur homeland, broader Central Asia, and the midwestern United States, interrogations of belonging, home, and displacement influence the nature of her work. Currently based in Brussels, she is working on her doctoral research on Uyghur artistic production in the diaspora.

**Maidina Kadeer**is a mixed Uyghur-Hui writer and editor, born in Ghulja and currently based in Montreal (Tiohtià:ke), Canada. She holds a BA in English Literature and Law and Society from Concordia University, with a focus on post- and neo-colonial literature. Her work explores Uyghur identity, history, and culture through cuisine, agriculture, and neo-colonialism. She has contributed to projects such as a poem, NinetySix, in Slavs and Tatars’ Contest of the Fruits (2021) and participates in panels and interviews on Agriculture and Food History to raise awareness about Uyghur culture.

title: Donate to Nepal- Tibet Floods: Help a Mountain Guide's Wife & Children, organized by Yangkey Gangshar
summary: Our family is heartbroken by the devastating floods that swept through communities along the Nepal–Tibet border, destroying homes, livelihoods, and taking many precious lives—including our beloved first cousin, Cho Cho Dawa Dakpu Lama Taman
content:
Our family is heartbroken by the devastating floods that swept through communities along the Nepal–Tibet border, destroying homes, livelihoods, and taking many precious lives—including our beloved first cousin, Cho Cho Dawa Dakpu Lama Tamang.

Who We Are & Our Connection

We are Yangkey, Choenyi, Tsering, and members of the Gangshar family whose roots are deeply connected to the communities affected by this tragedy. We are raising these funds for our first cousin, Cho Cho Dawa’s wife and their two young children, who are now facing an unimaginable loss and an uncertain future.

“Cho Cho” is an endearing Tibetan term for an older brother. To our family, Cho Cho Dawa was a beloved husband, father, son, brother, nephew, cousin, and friend.

A Father Who Gave Everything for His Family

At 45 years old, Cho Cho Dawa worked as a mountain guide in Nepal’s Langtang region, providing for his wife and two children. His work often took him away from home for weeks or months at a time, but he took great pride in what he did. He was known for his warmth, kindness, generosity, and joyful spirit.

Tragically, the mountains he knew so well and worked in to support his family became the place where he lost his life.

He leaves behind his wife and two young children—a daughter, 11, and a son, 7. They are now facing not only the devastating loss of their husband and father, but the uncertainty of rebuilding their lives without the person who provided for their family.

The picture attached captures Cho Cho Dawa with his family dressed in our traditional Tibetan attire while celebrating Losar, the Tibetan New Year.

Our Family’s Connection to This Community

Our connection to this region goes back generations.

Our father and his family originally came from Kyidong (Kyirong, སྐྱིད་གྲོང་) in Tibet, a place now often referred to as Gyirong in international news. In 1959, our grandparents and relatives were forced to flee Tibet and eventually found refuge and a new home in the border regions of Nepal.

Our father and his siblings grew up in the Syabru besi and Briddhim communities, where they went to school, formed lifelong friendships, and began rebuilding their lives after leaving Tibet. These communities became an important part of our family’s history and home in Nepal.

The school where our father and his siblings once studied was among the places devastated by the floods.

Yangkey was fortunate to visit Syabru besi and Briddhim in March 2014 and again with Choenyi in November 2025. During those visits, she spent time with Cho Cho Dawa, his wife, mother, and brother and was warmly welcomed into their home. The pictures included here were taken during those visits and are now incredibly meaningful to our family.

The pictures also show places we saw and experienced during our November 2025 visit. One shows a hydropower facility along the road to Syabru besi which has been damanged and another shows the homes, guesthouses, and local businesses in Syabru besi, many of which have since been washed away.

Our family was once forced to leave our homeland in Tibet and found a place in Nepal where generations of our family could rebuild their lives. Now, that same community has been devastated by another unimaginable tragedy.

What took generations to build was swept away in moments. But the lives, memories, and stories connected to these places remain.

We Are Grieving Many Losses

Cho Cho Dawa is not the only loss our family is mourning.

His brother, Cho Cho Tsering, is also facing unimaginable grief, as members of his wife’s family were among those tragically swept away.

We are also mourning the many precious lives lost in this devastating tragedy, including relatives, friends, and members of the Tibetan community.

Behind every life lost is a family now facing a future without someone they love.

How the Funds Will Be Used

We are raising funds to directly support Cho Cho Dawa’s wife and two children as they begin rebuilding their lives without him.

The funds will be used specifically for:

*   Food and daily necessities
*   Shelter, rent, and household expenses
*   Clothing and essential supplies
*   School-related expenses and future education costs for the children
*   Medical and other essential family needs that may arise
*   Long-term support to help the family regain stability and rebuild their lives

100% of the funds raised through this GoFundMe will go directly toward supporting Cho Cho Dawa’s family and, if we are fortunate enough to raise more than is needed for Cho Cho Dawa’s immediate family, additional funds will be used to help other affected families in the Tibetan community of Syabru besi who have lost loved ones, homes, or their livelihoods as a result of this disaster.

Bringing the Help Directly to Nepal

Yangkey will be traveling to Nepal in approximately two weeks and plans to personally deliver the funds raised directly to the affected families. The funds will be used solely for the relief, essential needs, and family-support purposes described above.

We want to make sure the support reaches those who need it most and provides meaningful help during this incredibly difficult time.

Every donation, no matter the amount, can make a meaningful difference.

If you are unable to donate, please consider sharing this fundraiser with your friends, family, coworkers, and community. A share may help this story reach someone who is able to help.

Thank you for taking the time to hear Cho Cho Dawa’s story and for standing with his wife and children, our family, and the communities affected by this devastating tragedy.

From our family to yours, thank you for your kindness, compassion, love, and support.

With gratitude,

Yangkey, Choenyi, Tsering & Gangshar Family

“The basic foundation of humanity is compassion and love.”

— His Holiness the 14th Dalai Lama

KIMA Network is raising funds to support school-age children from Syabru Besi, Setang, Timure, and surrounding communities affected by the flooding.

Because search and rescue efforts are still ongoing, we do not want to make assumptions about any child's family situation. We continue to hope that missing parents and loved ones will be found and reunited with their families.

Our action plan: We collected data from 5 boarding schools in Kathmandu and identified 41 students who are orphaned or have lost a parent, and who have no sponsor or only partial sponsorship. We have decided to sponsor all 41 students for this year and the upcoming so they can stay safe, supported, and in school. The schools are:

• Namgyal Higher Secondary School

• Srongtsen Bhrikuti Boarding High School

• Namgyal Middle Boarding School

• Marshyangdi Boarding High School

• North Valley English Secondary Boarding School

We still have a waiting list of children who need a sponsor. Please reach out to us or support through GoFundMe to help the children of Rasuwa.

We want to be there for them not only in the immediate aftermath, but in the months and years that follow.

For any child who is ultimately left without parental care, surviving the disaster will only be the beginning. They will need stability. They will need an education. They will need a safe place to live. And, most of all, they will need the reassurance that they have not been forgotten.

Funds raised will help provide:

• Safe housing, food, clothing, and everyday necessities

• School tuition, uniforms, books, and educational expenses

• Ongoing living and caregiving support

• Longer-term assistance for children left without parents or stable caregivers

Our commitment is not only to help these children through the immediate crisis, but to give them the stability, education, and support they need to move forward.

You do not have to be from Nepal to make a difference. Whether you are able to donate any amount ($) or simply share this fundraiser, every act of support can help us reach a child who may need care for years to come.

Please keep the families of Rasuwa in your thoughts, and if you are able, please stand with the children whose lives may be changed forever by this disaster.

**Craig De Meillon**

Donation protected

 My name is Craig De Meillon, and I am based in Miami, Florida. I work in safety and emergency management and am a trained firefighter and EMT with professional experience responding to disasters, emergencies, and humanitarian situations.

 I am raising these funds as an independent volunteer to support my deployment to the areas affected by the recent mudslides and flooding in Nepal near the China border. I am not a family member or representative of anyone affected by the disaster, nor am I collecting these funds on behalf of a government agency or other organization. I am responding independently based on my emergency-response experience and my ability to bring useful communications and search equipment into the field.

 The funds raised will be used primarily to cover the direct costs of my deployment and emergency-response work. This includes my airfare and ground transportation to and within the affected region, accommodation and essential field logistics, food and other necessary expenses while deployed, and emergency-response equipment and supplies.

 A significant part of the funding will also be used for search and communications capabilities. This may include purchasing or renting drones that can be used to conduct aerial searches, assess inaccessible areas, locate people who may be stranded or missing, and help response teams understand conditions on the ground. Funds will also be used for satellite communications equipment and associated Starlink service costs so that I can maintain reliable communications in areas where local telecommunications infrastructure may be damaged, unavailable, or overloaded.

 Where practical, I may purchase essential supplies locally rather than transporting them from the United States. This allows funds to be used more efficiently and can also support local businesses and responders.

 The primary beneficiary of this fundraiser is me, Craig De Meillon, because the funds are being raised to cover the actual expenses I incur while independently deploying and carrying out this emergency-response work. The money is not being raised for personal profit or general living expenses. It is intended to offset the costs directly associated with the mission, including travel, equipment, communications, transportation, and necessary field expenses.

 Once on the ground, I will coordinate as appropriate with local emergency responders, humanitarian organizations, community leaders, and other response personnel to determine where my skills, equipment, and communications capabilities can be most useful. My role and activities may change depending on the needs identified in the affected areas and the accessibility and safety of the region.

 I will keep records of mission-related expenses and provide updates throughout the deployment so donors can understand how the funds are being used and what work is being carried out on the ground.

 Thank you to everyone who contributes, shares this fundraiser, or supports the response in any way. Every contribution helps make it possible for me to get the equipment, communications, and resources needed to reach affected areas and assist where I can. Flood

# Support Cecilia’s Over Seas Detention Release

Help Bring Cecilia Home: Urgent Legal Support for US Citizen Detained in China My name is I. Denise Torres, and I'm reaching out with an urgent request to help my daughter Cecilia, a US-born citizen currently detained in China. Our family faces mounting legal expenses that are far beyond our financial means, and time is critical. Our Immediate Need Following the guidance of the US Consulate, we must retain specialized legal representation in China who is specifically an English speaking attorney that can navigate the Chinese legal system on Cecilia's behalf. Legal representation for international clients in criminal matters in China can range from several thousand to hundreds of thousands of yuan China Legal Experts depending on case complexity and duration. For families like ours, working-class Americans with limited resources, these costs are insurmountable without help. The US Consulate has recommended a qualified law firm experienced in representing foreign nationals. Cecilia has not been formally charged at this time and the funds are intended solely to support the current legal process related to her detention. However, we need to secure their services immediately, which requires: Attorney retainer and representation fees for an English-speaking Chinese defense lawyer Communication and translation services to facilitate family contact Personal care expenses for Cecilia during detention, including medical necessities Ongoing legal advocacy through the completion of her case Why Legal Representation Is Critical Cecilia is alone in a detention facility with severely limited communication rights and no phone calls, no family visitation, and no direct contact with us. The US Consulate has been extraordinarily supportive, but they can only conduct welfare checks once per month and cannot intervene in China's legal proceedings. A private attorney is her only opportunity for: Regular advocacy visits (every two weeks, as permitted) Direct communication link between Cecilia and our family Professional legal representation through required proceedings Monitoring of her wellbeing and medical needs The Medical Urgency Cecilia manages diabetes requiring three insulin injections daily. She experiences related complications including severe stomach issues and pain. Ensuring she receives proper medical care during detention is essential, and legal representation is critical to advocating for her health needs. The Process and Timeline Under guidance from the US Consulate, I cannot share specific details about the circumstances of Cecilia's detention, as doing so could compromise the legal process. What I can share is that we're working through official channels and following all recommended procedures to bring her home safely. Both Cecilia and I are US-born citizens. She is a compassionate, selfless young woman who would help anyone in need. Now she needs us to help her. Our goal is to cover estimated attorney fees for legal representation, communication services that allow us to stay connected with our daughter, and personal care expenses during her detention. Legal fees in China vary significantly based on lawyer experience, case complexity, and whether specialized English-language services are required Lawzana. International representation for US citizens detained abroad requires substantial financial resources that our working-class family simply doesn't have. Every Day Counts Without proper legal representation, Cecilia faces this situation alone—unable to communicate with her family, uncertain about the process ahead, and managing a serious medical condition in a foreign country. Every contribution, no matter the size, brings us closer to securing the legal help she desperately needs. How You Can Help Donate any amount you can afford—every dollar helps Share this campaign widely across your networks Keep Cecilia in your thoughts—this support means everything to our family The US Consulate continues monitoring her welfare, but only an attorney can advocate for her case, facilitate our communication, and work toward her safe return home. Our Gratitude Thank you for taking time to read Cecilia's story. Your generosity during this incredibly difficult time gives us hope. As a mother watching my daughter face this ordeal from thousands of miles away, your support is a lifeline. With deep gratitude and hope, Irma Denise Torres

title: iPhone Duo launch triggers wave of credit card fraud in Hong Kong
zh_title: iPhone Duo 推出引发香港信用卡诈骗浪潮
summary: 香港 苹果可折叠 iPhone Duo 的推出在香港引发了一波信用卡诈骗浪潮，用户报告每人未经授权收取的费用高达 34,998 港元。专家指责苹果缺乏 3D Secure 验证，敦促持卡人禁用在线支付并立即举报欺诈行为。 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 2026 年 10 月 17 日香港时间 12:23 · 阅读 2 分钟Apple 推出首款可折叠设备 iPhone Duo
content:
香港
苹果可折叠 iPhone Duo 的推出在香港引发了一波信用卡诈骗浪潮，据用户报告，每张未经授权的收费高达 34,998 港元。专家指责苹果缺乏 3D Secure 验证，敦促持卡人禁用在线支付并立即举报欺诈行为。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

2026 年 10 月 17 日 12:23 香港时间 · 阅读 2 分钟

据当地报道，备受期待的苹果首款可折叠设备 iPhone Duo 于周五晚间推出，不仅引发了热切科技爱好者的预订热潮，还引发了香港各地广泛的信用卡欺诈浪潮。

当地社交媒体平台上出现了多起来自用户的报告，他们声称自己的信用卡在购买高级商品时被欺诈性收费，尽管他们从未访问过苹果商店。在网上的投诉中，有网友分享的截图显示，他们的信用卡被扣款高达五次，每张港币34,998元，与新发布的两款高端256GB存储版本的价格相当。
随着网络恐慌的加剧，受影响的持卡人分享了他们对试图拨打紧急客户服务热线的挫败感。一名受害者表示，他们至少被指控四次，并花了两个多小时拨打银行热线，但没有人接听。作为回应，精明的互联网用户开始分享如何保护个人财务的技巧。许多人建议其他人主动关闭银行应用程序中的无卡或在线交易功能，以保护他们的账户。其他人指出，由于苹果公司只在实物发货离开仓库之前才对信用卡进行收费，因此，一旦发现未经授权的待处理费用，受害者应立即终止并更换信用卡以停止付款。

针对突然激增的金融诈骗事件，香港资讯科技商会名誉会长方宝侨解释说，核心问题在于苹果的交易安全。为了确保在高流量发布期间为顾客提供完全无缝且快速的购物体验，Apple 官方结账系统不强制要求使用 3D Secure (3DS) 一次性验证码。
Fong 表示，这一安全漏洞使得持有泄露信用卡数据库的犯罪集团能够使用自动化软件快速下达大宗高价值电子产品订单，这些产品可以轻松转售换取现金。他将这一过程描述为欺诈者的概率游戏。尽管银行或警报持卡人阻止或逆转了绝大多数此类欺诈交易，但犯罪分子只需要一小部分订单就可以在不被注意的情况下成功发货，从而赚取巨额利润。

Fong敦促公众通过确保通过银行应用程序打开所有即时交易通知警报来保护自己。他强调，持卡人一旦收到未经授权的交易通知，必须立即联系发卡银行冻结信用卡并启动争议程序以确保退款。

[![图片3：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

【原文 English Original】
Hong Kong
The launch of Apple's foldable iPhone Duo sparked a wave of credit card fraud in Hong Kong, with users reporting unauthorised charges of up to HK$34,998 each. Experts blame Apple's lack of 3D Secure verification, urging cardholders to disable online payments and report fraud immediately.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

17 Oct 2026 at 12:23 HKT · 2 min read

The highly anticipated launch of Apple’s first foldable device, the iPhone Duo, on Friday evening triggered not only a rush of pre-orders from eager tech enthusiasts but also a widespread wave of credit card fraud across Hong Kong, according to local reports.

Multiple reports surfaced on local social media platforms from users who claimed their credit cards were fraudulently charged for premium purchases despite never visiting the Apple Store. Among the online complaints, some netizens shared screenshots showing their credit cards being charged up to five times for HK$34,998 each, which matches the price of two high-end 256GB storage versions of the newly released device.

As online panic grew, affected cardholders shared their frustrations about trying to reach emergency customer service lines. One victim stated they were charged at least four times and spent over two hours on hold with their bank’s hotline without anyone answering. In response, savvy internet users began sharing tips on how to protect personal finances. Many advised others to proactively turn off card-free or online transaction functions in their banking apps to secure their accounts. Others pointed out that because Apple only charges cards right before the physical shipment leaves the warehouse, victims who notice unauthorised pending charges should immediately terminate and replace their credit cards to halt the payments.

Addressing the sudden surge in financial scams, Francis Fong Po-kiu, honorary president of the Hong Kong Information Technology Federation, explained that the core issue lies in Apple's transactional security. In order to ensure a completely seamless and rapid shopping experience for customers during high-traffic launches, Apple’s official checkout system does not mandate the use of 3D Secure (3DS) one-time verification codes.

According to Fong, this security gap allows criminal syndicates holding leaked credit card databases to use automated software to quickly place massive bulk orders for high-value electronic goods that can easily be resold for cash. He described this process as a game of probability for fraudsters. Even though banks or alert cardholders block or reverse the vast majority of these fraudulent transactions, criminals only need a tiny fraction of the orders to go unnoticed and successfully ship to make a massive profit.

Fong urged the public to protect themselves by ensuring all instant transaction notification alerts are turned on through their banking applications. He emphasised that the moment a cardholder receives an unauthorised transaction notification, they must immediately contact their card-issuing bank to freeze the credit card and initiate a dispute process to secure a refund.

content: 延宕十余年的新鸭绿江大桥周四正式通车，连接中国丹东与朝鲜新义州。此次通车距朝俄公路桥开通约一个月。分析人士认为，大桥有望提振双边贸易，也反映北京希望恢复对朝鲜的独特影响力。 延宕十余年的新鸭绿江大桥周四正式通车，连接中国丹东与朝鲜新义州。 （德国之声中文网）周四（10月15日），一座连接中国和朝鲜的新大桥在延宕十多年后正式开通，标志着两国关系进一步加深。 据中国官媒新华社报道，新鸭绿江大桥通车仪式当天举行。官媒中国新闻社发布的网络视频显示，大桥上停着等候通行的卡车，桥上装饰着中朝两国国旗。 这座双向四车道大桥全长3公里，连接中国东北城市丹东和朝鲜城市新义州。北京预期，大桥将进一步促进双方的经济、贸易和"人文"交流。 据新华社报道，中国国务院总理李强在仪式上发表视频致辞说："中朝关系正在进入新阶段，开启新篇章。" 新华社称，李强表示大桥将成为象征两国传统友谊的新地标。他希望双方以大桥开通为契机，继续加强互联互通，挖掘边境地区的合作潜力。 朝鲜内阁总理朴泰成也发表了视频致辞。 专家认为，这座大桥或许无意中会成为观察双边关系的一扇窗口 承载七成以上双边贸易的老桥松了口气 观察人士表示，新桥可能会提振双边贸易，提高物流效率。它预计将减轻丹东—新义州线路上一座老旧大桥的负担。这座老桥承担着两国70%以上的官方贸易。这座已有数十年历史的大桥既通火车，也通汽车和卡车，但车辆一次只能单向通行。 "新桥可能会为违反联合国制裁的贸易提供便利，但与跨境走私相比，桥上的通行可能更加透明，也更易于接受海关监管，"首尔梨花女子大学教授伊斯利（Leif-Eric Easley）对美联社记者说。 延宕12年：朝方迟迟未动工 这座大桥原本预计于2014年投入使用。当时，中方显然已完成本国一侧的建设，但朝鲜方面并未开展相应的配套工程。 新义州一侧迟迟没有实质性施工，引发外界种种猜测：平壤可能担心在经济上更加依赖中国，或者不满北京投票支持因朝核计划而加强国际制裁的联合国决议。一些观察人士还认为，朝中双方在大桥选址上也存在分歧。 大桥受阻一事，曾促使中共党报旗下的《环球时报》罕见地发表措辞尖锐的报道。报道援引丹东居民的话，表达了他们对工程延误的不满——他们原本希望大桥能为这座边境城市带来经济红利。 一个月之前朝俄大桥通车 新鸭绿江大桥通车前约一个月，朝鲜和俄罗斯刚刚开通了一座公路桥，作为双方巩固关系努力的一部分。 专家表示，中国官员对那座大桥的开通可能感到不安。 长期以来，中国一直是朝鲜最大的贸易伙伴和经济命脉。但近年来，朝鲜领导人金正恩与莫斯科的关系格外热络，向俄罗斯派出大量士兵和常规武器，支持普京对乌克兰的战争，以换取军事和经济援助。 近来，金正恩又与中国走近，意在改善本国经济，并构筑对抗美国的阵线。中国方面，则希望恢复其对朝鲜的独特影响力。 2025年，朝鲜约98%的对外贸易是与中国进行的。韩国政府去年表示，在长达1400多公里、管控松散的朝中边境上，至少有17条正在使用的公路和铁路通道。 "在经济上，中国对朝鲜依然不可或缺，这是俄罗斯无法替代的。如果未来桥上的往来明显中断，这座大桥或许无意中会成为观察双边关系的一扇窗口，"伊斯利对美联社说。

title: ONSITE Reiki OR Access Bars WellBEing Session w/ Lisa Helmly, Mon, Oct 26, 2026, 6:00 PM   | Meetup
summary: **6:00 - 7:00 pm (EST) AND 7:15 - 8:15 pm (EST), weekly on Monday in the HEALING room at bliss, 1007 Johnnie Dodds Blvd, The Mezzanine Suite 228 in Mt. Pleasant. We have a NEW dedicated space for private WellBEing sessions in the HEALING ro
content:
**6:00 - 7:00 pm (EST) AND 7:15 - 8:15 pm (EST), weekly on Monday in the HEALING room at bliss, 1007 Johnnie Dodds Blvd, The Mezzanine Suite 228 in Mt. Pleasant. We have a NEW dedicated space for private WellBEing sessions in the HEALING room at bliss available M-SU 8AM-8PM. We have implemented an in-house scheduling calendar that Practitioners may reference to determine an available mutually beneficial time if the recommended time below is not convenient for you.**

**This is a private 1-hour session. Please RSVP directly to the Practitioner to book the session time and then go to [givetobliss.com](http://givetobliss.com/) to make a $33 donation via VENMO (no fees), PayPal or credit card. Thank you!**

**Reiki** is a Japanese energy healing technique developed in the early 1900’s by Mikao Usui to stimulate health and vitality through channeling life force energy. While promoting a deep state of relaxation, Reiki therapy may reduce stress, anxiety, and pain through gentle touch and transferring of energy. The practitioner delivers this energy through their hands to assist in improving the recipients biofield flow and balance on the physical, emotional, mental, and spiritual levels. By having a tranquil effect on the mind and body, Reiki promotes healing and restoration while having a favorable influence on the parasympathetic and autonomic nervous systems.

**Access Bars** was developed by Gary Douglas as a set of tools and processes applied to facilitate more consciousness. As a restorative modality, Access Bars involves the practitioner connecting with 32 points on participants head through gentle touch. This contact facilitates the release of negative energetic thought forms, ideas, beliefs, emotions, and considerations that create barriers. As energetic blockages are discharged, a rebalancing occurs making room for improved thought patterns. Results may include a more peaceful mind, relaxed body, improved outlook, stress relief, more energy, and feeling replenished. Measurements of electrical activity of the brain conducted after an Access Bars treatment were shown to have literally calmed brain activity down.

**Facilitator: Lisa Ann Helmly,MS,RDN,LDN, [lisa@lisahelmly.com**](http://lisa@lisahelmly.com**/)

*   Holy Fire III/Karuna Reiki Master
*   Certified Kundalini Reiki Practitioner
*   Certified Access Bars Practitioner
*   Passionate about inspiring people to optimize their health and wellbeing.
*   Small changes yield big results.

As a Low Country Native, Lisa is enthused to share complimentary integrated healing and restorative modalities to promote optimal health and well-being. Holding a Bachelor of Arts in Business Administration equipped Lisa to gain experience in the corporate environment, flip residential housing properties, and continue managing her rental property business. Completing a Master of Science in Nutrition as a Registered Dietitian Nutritionist prepared Lisa for working in the medical sector assisting patients with a variety of illnesses, disease states, and conditions. During this time to the present, Lisa pursued further studies in alternative and integrative health practices attaining multiple credentials. While working in these areas, Lisa continued serving in her roles as a mother, daughter, sister, and friend.

**Sounds Productive Right? Does Being More Productive Support Health and Well-Being?**

“Getting busier does not necessarily make you better…affectively managing your stress does!”

You really didn’t think all of that activity was done perfectly with complete ease and grace, did you? Of course not. As Lisa was stressed out creating elevated levels of cortisol and adrenaline, this lack of balance was in opposition to a positive state of health and well-being. How ironic is that behavior? Lisa more fully understands how stress and being out of balance can have a negative impact on the mind and body. Sometimes the vehicle that drives a person to do, may eventually run them over. Hypothetically speaking, imagine being in a hit and run accident driven by yourself in your very own car. Can you relate now? The coping mechanism of burning the candle at both ends is comfortable because it is familiar. However, the candle may eventually burn out.
 If there is one commonality that we all have in this human experience, it’s managing our own life stressors. Add a dose or two of trauma along the way and what do you get…**Amplified Stress with Triggers.** The well-being sessions are offered here for interested participants to explore complementary and integrative approaches on processing and managing stress to ultimately feel and function better. You are invited to take this peaceful exploration on optimizing your own health and happiness.

# Stop Canceling Plans — Why Hiding at Home Is Ruining Your Vibe

[![Image 7: Photo of the user Feel The Vibe ](https://secure.meetupstatic.com/photos/member/3/a/e/4/thumb_325395076.jpeg?w=96) ![Image 8: Badge for Feel The Vibe ](https://secure.meetupstatic.com/next/images/avatar/super-organizer.webp?w=48) Hosted by Feel The Vibe . and jadahearl Feel The Vibe . is a Super Organizer](https://www.meetup.com/feel-the-vibe-meetup/events/317046502/attendees/)

[![Image 9: Photo of Feel The Vibe group](https://secure.meetupstatic.com/photos/event/c/e/1/2/event_529732754.jpeg?w=3840) ### Feel The Vibe](https://www.meetup.com/feel-the-vibe-meetup/)

## Details

You know the feeling. Thirty minutes before you’re supposed to leave, you type out “so sorry, something came up” and hit send. And for a second, it’s incredible. The couch gets softer. Your shoulders drop. You did it. You’re safe.

That relief doesn’t last long. By tomorrow it’s quietly turned into something else. A slightly smaller world. One more Saturday spent exactly where you started. A calendar that’s getting emptier every time you choose the couch over the door.

Here’s the part nobody tells you: that relief isn’t proof you made the right call. It’s just your brain rewarding you for dodging something uncomfortable, with zero regard for how the isolation compounds later.

You don’t need to fix this by forcing yourself through every single plan from now on. You just need one rule that makes showing up feel possible again. Something like, go for twenty minutes, and if it’s still too much, you’re allowed to leave. Most of the time, the dread fades faster than expected, and the twenty minutes turns into the whole night without you even noticing.

This Online Meetup is for anyone who’s been canceling more than showing up lately. We’re talking about the relief trap, why the version of tonight in your head is almost always worse than the real thing, and how to rebuild a little trust with yourself, one small, low stakes plan at a time.

Come for twenty minutes. See what happens.

韩国李明博表示必须尽早重新夺回战时作战控制权 2.N.K.领导人的妹妹称南部边境局势“非常不稳定” 3. 朝鲜称赞与俄罗斯的军事关系“无敌” 4. 随着新桥的开通，朝中贸易关系势头强劲 5. 中国 APEC 峰会提升了特朗普与金正恩会谈的前景 6. 美国司令的非军事区言论引发韩国主权争端 7. 据朝中社报道，朝鲜金与正表示正在考虑向首尔广播 8. 总统间接批评驻韩美军司令关于潜在的作战指挥过渡延迟的言论 9. 美国对韩国对驻韩美军指挥官言论的不安表示“理解”：消息来源 10. 美国指挥官关于韩国领土范围的言论在首尔引起了关注 11. 在韩国岛上发现了另一枚朝鲜地雷，为上个月的第四枚 12. 国防部长、日本特使同意扩大防务领域的双边交流 13. 随着边境监视转向陆军，陆军计划建立通用前哨安全部队人工智能 14. [封面故事] 韩国专注于人工智能专业，而全球大学改写教育规则 2026 年 10 月 19 日的《国家安全》和《韩国新闻与评论》首先发表在亚利桑那州立大学的《小战争杂志》上。

title: Taiwan Coast Guard to Acquire MARTAC Devil Ray T24 USVs
zh_title: 台湾海岸警卫队将采购 MARTAC Devil Ray T24 USV
summary: 台湾海岸警卫队与 MARTAC 签署协议，根据美台合作生产防务协议购买 Devil Ray T24 自主水面舰艇。 MARTAC 新闻稿 美国领先的全自动无人水面舰艇 (USV) 供应商海事战术系统公司 (MARTAC) 今天宣布，台湾海岸警卫队管理局 (CGA) 正在采购数量不详的 Devil Ray T24 自主水面舰艇。此次销售是迄今为止美国制造的无人水面航行器最重要的国际采购之一，突显了全球对先进无人管理器的需求不断增长
content:
台湾海岸警卫队与 MARTAC 签署协议，根据美台合作生产防务协议购买 Devil Ray T24 自主水面舰艇。 MARTAC 新闻稿 美国领先的全自动无人水面舰艇 (USV) 供应商海事战术系统公司 (MARTAC) 今天宣布，台湾海岸警卫队管理局 (CGA) 正在采购数量不详的 Devil Ray T24 自主水面舰艇。此次销售是迄今为止美国制造的无人水面航行器最重要的国际采购之一，突显了全球对先进无人海上能力不断增长的需求。这一机会是通过 MARTAC、国立中山科学技术研究院 (NCSIST) 和儒学股份有限公司在 2025 年台北航空航天与国防技术展览会 (TADTE) 期间签署的三方谅解备忘录 (MOU) 实现的。 MARTAC 在台湾的当地合作伙伴孔儒和台湾国有国防研究与发展机构 NCSIST 是推动这一计划从框架协议到采购的关键合作伙伴。该交易条款涉及联合生产模式，其中多艘无人水面航行器将在 MARTAC 战略合作伙伴之一位于佛罗里达州埃奇沃特的工厂生产，其余部分则由台湾儒学制造。
这一合作生产安排反映了双方致力于加强台湾国内工业基础，同时利用 MARTAC 成熟的设计和制造专业知识的承诺。MARTAC 首席增长官 Seamus Flatley 表示：“台湾海岸警卫队的这一追求对于 MARTAC 以及印度-太平洋地区采用无人水面舰艇来说是一个里程碑式的时刻。” “此次多船收购的规模验证了我们系统的运营能力和可靠性，并展示了我们与 NCSIS 和 Confucian 建立的合作伙伴关系的战略价值。” MARTAC Devil Ray T24 USV 采用 Mantas T12 作为有效载荷。玛塔克图片。 “除了MARTAC领先的技术之外，台湾政府选择MARTAC的最重要原因之一是该公司从一开始就愿意在台湾建立联合制作，”孔儒首席执行官李詹姆斯说。 “这是台湾海岸警卫队的第一个无人水面舰艇（USV）计划，使其成为具有重大国家意义的项目，并引起了政府高层领导的密切关注。” Devil Ray T24 是一艘长 27.5 英尺（8.4 m）的高性能自主水面舰艇，突发速度超过 50 节。 T24 旨在支持海岸警卫队和军事组织在复杂的海洋环境中执行各种任务。
该交易的联合生产部分预计将为美国和台湾创造劳动力发展机会，促进供​​应链整合并促进符合原始谅解备忘录条款的技术共享计划。此次出售进一步巩固了MARTAC作为盟国USV解决方案领先供应商的地位，并强化了美国制造的自主海事平台在支持印太地区合作伙伴的安全和海域意识需求方面的重要性。 – 完 – 台湾海岸警卫队将采购 MARTAC Devil Ray T24 USV 的消息首先出现在《海军新闻》上。

【原文 English Original】
Taiwan’s Coast Guard signs an agreement with MARTAC to acquire Devil Ray T24 autonomous surface vessels under a U.S.-Taiwan co-production defense deal. MARTAC press release Maritime Tactical Systems, Inc. (MARTAC), a leading U.S. provider of fully autonomous unmanned surface vessels (USVs), today announced that the Taiwan Coast Guard Administration (CGA) is acquiring an undisclosed number of Devil Ray T24 autonomous surface vessels . The sale represents one of the most significant international purchases of U.S.-manufactured USVs to date, underscoring the growing global demand for advanced unmanned maritime capabilities. The opportunity was made possible through the tripartite Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) signed by MARTAC, the National Chung-Shan Institute of Science and Technology (NCSIST), and Confucian Co., Ltd. during the 2025 Taipei Aerospace & Defense Technology Exhibition (TADTE). Confucian, MARTAC’s local partner in Taiwan, and NCSIST, Taiwan’s state-owned defense research and development institution, have served as key partners in advancing this initiative from a framework agreement to procurement. The terms of the deal involve a co-production model, with a number of USVs to be manufactured at one of MARTAC’s strategic partner’s facility in Edgewater, Florida, with the remainder built by Confucian in Taiwan. This co-production arrangement reflects the partnership’s commitment to strengthening Taiwan’s domestic industrial base while leveraging MARTAC’s proven design and manufacturing expertise. “This pursuit by the Taiwan Coast Guard represents a landmark moment for MARTAC and for the adoption of unmanned surface vessels in the Indo-Pacific region,” said Seamus Flatley, Chief Growth Officer, MARTAC. “The scale of this multi-vessel acquisition validates the operational capability and reliability of our systems and demonstrates the strategic value of the partnership we established with NCSIST and Confucian.” MARTAC Devil Ray T24 USV featuring a Mantas T12 as a payload. MARTAC picture. “In addition to MARTAC’s leading technology, one of the most important reasons the Taiwan government selected MARTAC was the company’s willingness, from the very beginning, to establish co-production in Taiwan,” said Confucian’s Chief Executive Officer James Lee. “This is the Taiwan Coast Guard’s first Unmanned Surface Vessel (USV) program, making it a project of significant national importance that has attracted close attention from senior government leadership.” The Devil Ray T24 is a 27.5 foot (8.4 m) high-performance autonomous surface vessel capable of burst speeds exceeding 50 knots.  The T24 is designed to support a  wide range of missions  for coast guard and military organizations operating in complex maritime environments. The co-production element of the deal is projected to create workforce development opportunities in both the United States and Taiwan, foster supply chain integration and facilitate technology-sharing initiatives consistent with the terms of the original MOU. The sale further solidifies MARTAC’s position as a leading provider of USV solutions to allied nations and reinforces the importance of U.S.-manufactured autonomous maritime platforms in supporting the security and maritime domain awareness needs of partners across the Indo-Pacific. – End – The post Taiwan Coast Guard to Acquire MARTAC Devil Ray T24 USVs appeared first on Naval News .

summary: 香港一名九岁男孩因侵袭性肺炎球菌疾病入院一天后死亡。香港大学儿科医生表示，自2024年8月开始使用的15价疫苗可以更好地控制血清型3，并建议有需要的儿童补充剂量。 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 2026 年 10 月 19 日香港时间 10:35 · 1 分钟阅读 A 以前健康九岁男孩入院一天后死于侵袭性肺炎球菌疾病
content:
香港
一名九岁男孩因侵袭性肺炎球菌疾病入院一天后死亡。香港大学儿科医生表示，自2024年8月开始使用的15价疫苗可以更好地控制血清型3，并建议有需要的儿童补充剂量。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

2026 年 10 月 19 日，香港时间 10:35 · 阅读时间 1 分钟

一名原本健康的九岁男孩因并发症入院一天后死于侵袭性肺炎球菌疾病。据香港电台报道，该男童在潜伏期内没有出国旅行。

香港大学儿科及青少年医学名誉临床副教授关日华医生在香港电台千禧年节目中表示，侵袭性肺炎球菌疾病是一种严重的细菌感染，尤其影响儿童和长者。并发症可能包括脑膜炎，可能导致死亡或永久性残疾；细菌进入血液可导致多器官衰竭；溶血性尿毒症综合征（红细胞自发分解）可导致急性肾衰竭。
关医生指出，侵袭性肺炎球菌疾病的病例相对较少，因为自2009年以来，政府已为在香港出生的婴儿接种疫苗，并敦促65岁及以上的人士接种疫苗。当病例零星发生时，需要进行调查以确定原因，包括患者是否接种过疫苗以及免疫系统是否存在问题。

关医生表示，侵袭性肺炎球菌有超过90种血清型，其中以3型血清型最为可怕，因为它很容易导致病情突然恶化和并发症。他表示，之前的13价疫苗未能很好地控制血清型3，而自2024年8月起，香港已改用15价疫苗，预计将有助于控制疾病。他补充说，有需要的个别儿童可以接种补充剂量的 15 价疫苗。

关博士还表示，侵袭性肺炎球菌是通过飞沫传播的，并敦促公众勤洗手并戴口罩作为预防措施。

Hong Kong
A nine-year-old boy died a day after hospital admission from invasive pneumococcal disease. A Hong Kong University paediatrician said the 15-valent vaccine, in use since August 2024, better controls serotype 3 and advised children in need to get top-up doses.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

19 Oct 2026 at 10:35 HKT · 1 min read

A previously healthy nine-year-old boy has died from invasive pneumococcal disease, a day after being admitted to hospital with complications. The boy had not travelled abroad during the incubation period, according to RTHK.

Dr Kwan Yat-wah, honorary clinical associate professor of paediatrics and adolescent medicine at the University of Hong Kong, said on the RTHK programme _Millennium_ that invasive pneumococcal disease is a serious bacterial infection that particularly affects children and the elderly. Complications can include meningitis, which can cause death or permanent disability; bacteria entering the blood can lead to multiple organ failure; and haemolytic uraemic syndrome, in which red blood cells break down spontaneously, can cause acute kidney failure.

Dr Kwan noted that cases of invasive pneumococcal disease are relatively rare because since 2009 the government has vaccinated infants born in Hong Kong and has urged people aged 65 and above to get vaccinated. When cases occur sporadically, investigations are needed to determine the cause, including whether the patient had been vaccinated and whether their immune system had problems.

There are more than 90 serotypes of invasive pneumococcus, Dr Kwan said, with serotype 3 the most frightening because it can very easily cause a sudden deterioration and complications. He said the previous 13-valent vaccine did not control serotype 3 well, and since August 2024 Hong Kong has switched to the 15-valent vaccine, which is expected to help control the disease. Individual children who need it can receive a top-up dose of the 15-valent vaccine, he added.

Dr Kwan also said invasive pneumococcus is transmitted through droplets, and urged the public to wash hands frequently and wear masks as preventive measures.
